text: 那颗「流星」应该是飞向了前方……再往前找找好了。
text_loc: That "shooting star" must have landed somewhere up ahead... let's keep looking.

text: 咦，这就是入学要搭乘的飞艇吗，怎么看上去……破破的？
text_loc: So... this is the airship to the academy. It looks like it's held together with wishes.

text: ……前方的楼梯下面，突然传来了什么叫声——？！！
text_loc: Up ahead, from somewhere beneath the boardwalk, there's a struggle. Someone calls for help.

title: 神秘的猫头鹰
text: 救命！救命咕！——路过的小洛克阁下！！赶紧帮帮忙！
text_loc: Help! Help, hoo! You there, Young Roco! Please, I need a hand!

title: 神秘的猫头鹰
text: 救命！救命咕！——路过的小洛克阁下！！赶紧帮帮忙！
text_loc: Help! Help, hoo! You there, Young Roco! Please, I need a hand!

title: 神秘的猫头鹰
text: 来不及解释了，快赶走后面那只……发疯追我的「凶狠胖鸭」好吗！！
text_loc: No time to explain! Chase off that deranged Duckiji behind me, I'm begging you! I'm a sitting duck if you don't help me right now!

text: 我要怎么做？
text_loc: How do I do that?

title: 神秘的猫头鹰
text: 那边的箱子里就有能帮到你的「东西」，还劳烦阁下尽快动手！
text_loc: Check that suitcase! There's something inside that can help. Hurry!

title: 神秘的猫头鹰
text: 再耽误一会，连我最珍贵的护心毛都要被它给撸掉了咕……！！
text_loc: If we waste another second, that thing's going to pluck off my most precious chest fluff, hoo!

name: 皮箱
text: |||<Center>皮箱内放着三个圆圆的球，此刻正因你的靠近而不停跃动。突然，有什么从里面冲了出来！</>
text_loc: |||<Center>Three round pods rest inside the case. As you draw near, they begin to tremble—then something bursts out!</>

title: 神秘的猫头鹰
text: 这是火系精灵「火花」，长大可以喷出火焰，现在已经可以熟练使用火花。是忠诚、勇敢的精灵。
text_loc: This is Sparka, a Fire-Type Jini. Loyal and brave in equal measure, it wields sparks with ease. When fully grown, it can breathe flames.

title: 神秘的猫头鹰
text: 阁下对于未来旅途的热情，是否被它点燃了呢？
text_loc: Has it ignited your enthusiasm for the journey ahead, Young Roco?

text: 有被点燃
text_loc: It has.

text: 只能选择一只精灵作为初始伙伴——确认选择它吗？
text_loc: You can only choose one Jini as your starting companion. Is that your final decision?

text: 选择火花！
text_loc: Choose Sparka.

title: 神秘的猫头鹰
text: 勇敢的火花和你倒是绝配，这不是恭维的话！但——请先摆平眼前这个家伙！！
text_loc: Brave little Sparka is a perfect match for you, and I mean that! But please, deal with this one first!

name: 生气的精灵
text: &#！*……%——！！（这只精灵看起来很生气的样子……）
text_loc: &#!*... %—!! (This Jini looks pretty peeved...)

text: 让我再想想
text_loc: Let me think.

title: 神秘的猫头鹰
text: 这是草系精灵「喵喵」，不停地摇晃尾巴，容易受到惊吓，平时很乖巧。是善良、可靠的精灵。
text_loc: This is Meewee, a Grass-Type Jini. Gentle and dependable, it wags its tail constantly and startles easily, but is sweet-natured through and through.

title: 神秘的猫头鹰
text: 阁下那份处变不惊的自信，是否被它唤醒了呢？
text_loc: Has it stirred that calm, steady confidence within you, Young Roco?

text: 有被唤醒
text_loc: It has.

text: 只能选择一只精灵作为初始伙伴——确认选择它吗？
text_loc: You can only choose one Jini as your starting companion. Is that your final decision?

text: 选择喵喵！
text_loc: Choose Meewee.

title: 神秘的猫头鹰
text: 机智的喵喵和你倒是绝配，这不是恭维的话！但——请先摆平眼前这个家伙！！
text_loc: Meewee, with its quick wit, is a perfect match for you, and I mean that! But please, deal with this one first!

title: 神秘的猫头鹰
text: 这是水系精灵「水蓝蓝」，喜欢漂浮在水中，没事吐个泡泡，头顶有个可爱的蝴蝶结。是温柔，体贴的精灵。
text_loc: This is Cerulla, a Water-Type Jini. Gentle and caring, it loves to float around and blow bubbles, all with an adorable bow on its head.

title: 神秘的猫头鹰
text: 阁下对于美好生活的希冀，是否被它滋养了呢？
text_loc: Has it nurtured that hope for a beautiful life within you, Young Roco?

text: 有被滋养
text_loc: It has.

text: 只能选择一只精灵作为初始伙伴——确认选择它吗？
text_loc: You can only choose one Jini as your starting companion. Is that your final decision?

text: 选择水蓝蓝！
text_loc: Choose Cerulla.

title: 神秘的猫头鹰
text: 柔韧的水蓝蓝和你倒是绝配，这不是恭维的话！但——请先摆平眼前这个家伙！！
text_loc: The ever-so resilient Cerulla is a perfect match for you, and I mean that! But please, deal with this one first!

title: 神秘的猫头鹰
text: 呼——得救了！我代表得以幸存的护心毛，向你发出由衷的赞叹咕~
text_loc: Whew, I'm saved! Thanks to you, my chest fluff will live to see another day. My most heartfelt thanks to you, hoo!

title: 神秘的猫头鹰
text: 没有阁下的帮助的话，在下可绝对无法摆脱那只胖鸭的纠缠……！
text_loc: Without your help, I never would have shaken off that Duckiji, not in a million years!

text: 你好，猫头鹰
text_loc: Hello there, owl.

text: 安全了就好呀
text_loc: Glad you're safe.

title: 神秘的猫头鹰
text: 初次见面，便让阁下看到如此丢脸的一幕……实在是不好意思……
text_loc: I apologize for you having to witness such an undignified display upon our very first meeting.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 那么，请允许在下正式自我介绍一下！我是噜噜，魔法学院的金牌向导！噜噜家族的一员！
text_loc: Now then, please allow me to formally introduce myself. I am Coolu, the Five-Star Guide of the Magic Academy, and a proud member of the Hoolu family.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 呃，看这身充满活力的打扮，想必……阁下便是在下需要负责接引的那名同学了吧？
text_loc: My, you seem like a real bundle of energy. You must be the new student I've been assigned to guide?

text: 正是本人……
text_loc: That would be me.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 呼呼咕！虽说阁下也算对在下有救命之恩，但必要的程序还是需要走一下滴——
text_loc: Hoo! You really saved my feathers back there today, and I won't deny it. But we've got to stick to procedure, I'm afraid.

text: （呈上）入学通知书
text_loc: (Present) Letter of Admission

text: 从背包中找出了一张装饰精致的书页，似乎就是噜噜口中提到的「入学通知书」。
text_loc: You rummage through your bag and fish out an elegantly decorated piece of paper—this must be the Letter of Admission Coolu mentioned.

text:
亲爱的{name}：
很高兴通知你，你已被录取为洛克王国魔法学院的新生。|||请准时前往指定地点报到。
——格里芬
text_loc:
Dear {name},
We are pleased to inform you that you have been accepted as a student at the Magic Academy of Roco Kingdom. |||Please report to the designated location at the assigned time.
— Griffin

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 太棒了！有格里芬校长的亲笔签名，那便绝对不会出错了咕~
text_loc: Wonderful! That's Headmaster Griffin's personal signature alright. No question about its authenticity, hoo.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 按照惯例，每位踏上魔法学习之路的小洛克，都需要选择属于自己的「精灵伙伴」。
text_loc: Tradition dictates that every young Roco who sets out on the path of magic must choose their own Jini companion.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 这本应有庄重的仪式，但误打误撞间，你好像已经完成了对它们的挑选了咕……
text_loc: That process typically involves a rather formal ceremony, but it seems you've already made your choice, by accident no less, hoo...

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 作为阁下亲自挑选的第一个伙伴，刚才和那小家伙并肩作战的感觉如何呢？
text_loc: So, how did it feel fighting alongside your first little companion?

text: 感觉有点陌生
text_loc: Haven't got the hang of it.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 阁下谦虚了咕~其实作为初次的战斗，我看阁下的水准已经足够惊艳了！
text_loc: You're too modest, hoo. For a first battle, your performance was nothing short of impressive!

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 身为陪伴你们洛克族最久的精灵之一，那孩子可是十分适合成为搭档的选择。
text_loc: This Jini is one of the most stalwart companions of the Rocos, making it an excellent choice indeed.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 同在下一样，它们也是受到了大自然魔力的眷顾，「充满奥秘」的生物。
text_loc: Like myself, they are creatures blessed by the magic of nature. Mysterious beings, as we're fond of saying.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 即便历代洛克魔法师们不断探索，精灵世界至今依旧充满谜团，咕——！
text_loc: Generations of Roco mages have devoted themselves to its study, and yet the world of Jini remains full of mysteries, hoo!

text: 有点期待
text_loc: I can't wait.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 而作为学院的传统——想成为更强大的魔法师，阁下也需要获得更多伙伴的帮助才行。
text_loc: According to Academy tradition, if you wish to grow into a more powerful mage, you'll need the help of many more companions.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 我正好有一些能与精灵订立契约的「咕噜球」，初次见面，就当是噜噜家族的见面礼好了！
text_loc: As it happens, I have some Buddy Pods, which are just the thing for forming pacts with Jini. Consider them a gift from the Hoolu family, to celebrate our becoming acquainted!

text: 谢谢你，噜噜
text_loc: Thank you, Coolu.

text: 你是最棒的猫头鹰！
text_loc: You're the best owl around.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 另外，关于与其它精灵订立契约的方式——可以尝试向它们投掷你自己的精灵，或是主动靠近它们。
text_loc: One more thing. When it comes to forming pacts with other Jini, you can either try sending your own Jini toward them, or approach them yourself.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 大胆地朝它们掷出咕噜球，让更多的精灵成为伙伴吧！
text_loc: Throw your Buddy Pods like you mean it, and make as many Jini your companions as you can!

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 新生教学到此告一段落——在下也可以放心去处理另一件「大事」了咕。
text_loc: That concludes your orientation. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have a busy schedule I have to keep to, hoo.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 此地前往学院的工具年久失修。呼呼……还需好好检修一番才行。
text_loc: The vessel that takes us to the Academy has seen better days. Hoo... it'll need a proper inspection before we set off.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 就让我们稍后再会吧咕！相信以阁下的能力，眼下这点小事还远远难不住你~
text_loc: Until we meet again, hoo! I have every confidence this small task is well within your abilities.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: |||<Center>噜噜在你的眼前，突然消失了踪迹……</>
text_loc: |||<Center>Coolu vanishes right before your eyes...</>

text: 感觉有点熟悉
text_loc: Felt like second nature.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 哦哦？看来阁下很有成为战斗达人的天赋啊，这样的新生可不多见咕~
text_loc: My oh my! It seems you have quite the aptitude for battle. New students like you don't come along often, hoo.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 好在身为最为可靠的精灵之一，那孩子成长的潜力，绝对会超乎你的想象！
text_loc: And as one of the most dependable Jini around, that little one's potential for growth is sure to surprise you.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 这么快就完成了吗！真是太有精灵魔法师天赋了咕！
text_loc: Finished already? You really do have a knack for this, hoo!

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 出发前的准备还需要一点时间，不如趁此机会预习一下炼金术的基础吧。
text_loc: We still have a little time before we're ready to depart. Why not dedicate it to a crash course on the basics of alchemy?

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 还记得先前赠与阁下的咕噜球吗？只要拥有足够的炼金材料，便可借助「炼金魔法」随意制造出来。
text_loc: Remember those Buddy Pods I gave you? With enough of the right materials, you can craft as many as you need using Alchemy Magic.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 朝着野外的矿石投掷精灵，就能方便地获取炼金所需的材料。
text_loc: Set your Jini loose at the mineral deposits out in the wild to gather the materials you'll need.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 之后再前往充盈魔力的炼金釜，借助它的力量完成咕噜球的制作吧咕！
text_loc: Then head to the Alchemy Cauldron and use its power to craft yourself some Buddy Pods!

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 待阁下完成之后，启程的准备应该也已妥当，我们就能出发入学了咕！
text_loc: By the time you're finished with that, we should be ready get on our way, hoo!

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: 少了那些精灵，可完全没法启动这个大家伙……
text_loc: Without those Jini, there's just no way to get this thing running...

text: 怎么了？
text_loc: Something wrong?

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: 没……没什么……咕？！阁下居然已经来了！
text_loc: N-No, nothing's wrong... hoo? You're here already!

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: 呃……有关我们启程魔法学院的装置，在下好像、也算「基本」检查完毕了吧……
text_loc: I've finished inspecting the vessel that will take us to the Magic Academy... essentially. More or less.

text: 装置？你指的是……
text_loc: Which vessel?

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: 不错咕，如你所见——前方「停泊」的这艘庞然大物，便是魔法飞艇「洛克号」！
text_loc: Indeed. It's that magnificent and magic airship moored just ahead, the Roco!

text: 我们就坐这个入学？
text_loc: Are you sure?

text: 这也太破了吧……
text_loc: It's falling apart...

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: 请阁下不必担心，虽说此刻它看上去状态不佳，但在黯淡的外表下，其实有着神奇的魔法真相。
text_loc: You mustn't worry. It may be a bit worse for wear, but beneath that weathered exterior lies something truly magical.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: 每一届的小洛克新生，都是乘坐着由我们噜噜家族亲自驾驶的「洛克号」，安全抵达学院的！
text_loc: Every class of new Roco students has arrived at the Academy safely aboard the Roco, piloted by my very own Hoolu family!

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: 只不过……眼前遇到了些麻烦，用来激活魔法装置的精灵被在下给弄丢了……咕……
text_loc: However, we've run into a small problem. The Jini needed to power the magical device have been misplaced. By me. Hoo...
What?

text: 那现在要怎么办？
text_loc: So what do we do now?

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: 抱歉咕……！这的确属于本向导的失误，一定是先前被那只胖鸭追逐时遗落的！
text_loc: My apologies, hoo! I'm your guide here, and I should do better. They must have been lost while I was being pursued by that Duckiji!

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: 不要着急咕，阁下请看——环绕附近的三根魔法石柱便是启动「洛克号」的关键装置。
text_loc: No need to panic, hoo. If I can direct your attention over to these three magical pillars... these are the key to getting the Roco airborne.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: 而阁下只需跟随在下的指引，捕捉先前弄丢的「幽系」「翼系」「普通系」三系精灵就行。
text_loc: All you need to do is follow my instructions and recapture three Jini: one Shadow-Type, one Wing-Type, and one Normal-Type.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: 至于如何借助这些精灵的力量启动石柱，等到收集齐精灵之后，再让在下细细道来。
text_loc: As for how to use their power to activate the pillars, I'll explain everything once you've gathered all three.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: 看阁下步履轻盈的样子，成果如何？捕捉不同系别的精灵也没想象中困难吧？
text_loc: You look light on your feet. How did it go? Catching Jini of different types wasn't as hard as you expected, I hope?

text: 轻松完成
text_loc: It was actually easy.

text: 有点难度
text_loc: It was trickier than I thought.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: 正如我先前所说——精灵是「充满奥秘」的生物，无论哪一系别的精灵都具备各自独特的「魔法」。
text_loc: As I mentioned before, Jini are greatly mysterious beings. Every type carries its own distinct magic.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: 而启动眼前那艘洛克号的方法，或者说，激活魔法石柱的关键，便是「精灵魔法」咕！
text_loc: In fact, the secret to getting the Roco up and running, and the key to activating those pillars, is Jini Magic, hoo!

text: 「魔法」！
text_loc: Magic?

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: 如何使用「精灵魔法」驱动它们，便是我们接下来的课题。
text_loc: Our next lesson is how to harness Jini Magic to power these pillars.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: 「精灵魔法」与精灵们本身一样，有着不同的元素系别，也只会与相同系别的魔法石柱产生共鸣——
text_loc: Just like the Jini themselves, Jini Magic comes in different elemental types, and they will only resonate with a pillar of the matching type.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: 此时就需要阁下刚才订下契约的「幽系」「翼系」「普通系」精灵出场了。观察魔法石柱的外观，便可判断能够与之共鸣的精灵系别。
text_loc: This is where the Shadow-Type, Wing-Type, and Normal-Type Jini you just captured come into play. Take a close look at each pillar. Its appearance will tell you which type can resonate with it.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: 然后——只需朝着石柱投掷出相应的精灵就行，是不是简单得有点意外？
text_loc: Then it's as simple as throwing the matching Jini at the pillar.

text: 就这么简单？
text_loc: That's all there is to it?

text: 有点想试试
text_loc: I want to try.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: 呼呼咕！其实精灵魔法的妙用还远不止如此，在下刚才所说也只是最、最粗浅的基础而已。
text_loc: Hoo! The uses of Jini Magic go far beyond what I've described. What I've shared is only scratching the surface.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: 日后有空，仍有无数关于精灵魔法的奥秘，需要阁下去亲自探寻，举一反三呢！
text_loc: There are countless Jini Magic-related secrets waiting for you to discover and make your own. All in good time.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: 但眼下——阁下只需聚焦眼前这些小小的石柱，以求尽量赶上学院的入学典礼即可。
text_loc: For now, just focus on these pillars so we can make it to the Academy's opening ceremony in time.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: 对了，差点忘了提醒阁下，在投掷精灵前，请先确保所需要的精灵已经加入队伍。好了，快去试着发动这艘「破旧」的飞艇吧~
text_loc: Oh, I nearly forgot. Before you throw a Jini at a pillar, first make sure you have the correct Jini in your party. Now go, let's get this battered old airship moving!

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: 不错不错，飞艇内部的魔力已被激活，通往船舱的门扉也已顺利出现了！
text_loc: Excellent! The airship's magic has been activated, and the door to the cabin has appeared right on cue!

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: ——那么，阁下，做好准备，我们要正式前往魔法学院了咕！
text_loc: Now then, get ready, Young Roco. We're officially on our way to the Magic Academy, hoo!

name: 马尔文
text: 老师老师！您帮忙看看，这位同学好像有点晕船了……
text_loc: Excuse me, Professor! Could you come take a look at this student? She seems to be feeling under the weather...

name: 马尔文
text: 老师老师！您帮忙看看，这位同学好像有点晕船了……
text_loc: Excuse me, Professor! Could you come take a look at this student? She seems to be feeling under the weather...

name: 菲比
text: 有点……想吐……（*（￥%……（干呕的声音）
text_loc: I feel... like I'm going to be sick... (*(￥%... *retches*

text: 哦？不太应该啊，飞艇用炼金术专门加固过，难道是噜噜船长把动力强化得过头了？？
text_loc: Hmm, that's strange. The airship was reinforced with alchemy. Did Captain Hoolu push the engines a little too hard?

text: 哎，事不宜迟……！赶紧去船尾找治愈兔吧，它的魔法应该能让你们好受些~
text_loc: No time to waste! Head to the stern and find the Bunniaid. Its magic should help you feel better.

name: 马尔文
text: 好的好的，谢谢老师！菲比，坚持住啊……
text_loc: Got it, thank you, Professor! Hang in there, Phoebe...

text: |||<Center>马尔文搀扶着菲比向船后方走去……</>
text_loc: |||<Center>Marvin guides Phoebe toward the back of the ship...</>

text: 一如往常，这届的小朋友也是这般可爱呐，又是值得期待的新学年……
text_loc: This year's students are as endearing as ever. Another new school year to look forward to...

text: 打声招呼
text_loc: Say hello.

text: 哦？！是这位小同学。原以为你会错过这班航线，所幸最后还是及时赶到了~
text_loc: Oh? It's you. I thought you might miss this flight, but I'm glad you made it just in time.

text: 老师好！
text_loc: Hello, Professor!

text: 侥幸侥幸
text_loc: Just barely.

name: 路易斯
text: 哈哈，光顾着处理晕船的事，倒忘了好好介绍一下我自己——我叫路易斯。
text_loc: Ha, I got so caught up with the infirmed students that I forgot to introduce myself. I'm Louis.

name: 路易斯
text: 平时我是魔法学院的技能课老师，但今天……来客串一下你们本趟旅程的安全专员。
text_loc: I normally teach Skill Development at the Academy, but today I'm here in a slightly different capacity—your safety officer for this trip.

name: 路易斯
text: 说起来……是遇到什么麻烦了吗？刚才见你登船时有些狼狈，你的向导呢？
text_loc: Speaking of which... did something happen? You seemed somewhat out of sorts when you boarded. Where's your guide?

name: 路易斯
text: |||<Center>「路易斯话音刚落，噜噜扑腾着翅膀就飞了过来……」</>
text_loc: |||<Center>"The moment Louis finishes speaking, Coolu comes fluttering over..."</>

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: ——路！易！斯！本猫头鹰没看错吧，你这家伙……怎么会出现在这里？？
text_loc: LOUIS! Is that really you? What on earth are you doing here?

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 是学院派你来的咕？？令鸟费解！一向爱坐办公室的小子，今天居然主动带队了！
text_loc: Did the Academy send you, hoo? That's baffling! You're the type who never leaves his desk, and now you're out here leading a group in person!

name: 路易斯
text: 哈哈，这可说来话长了……老朋友，谁让学院将本次旅程定为最高安全规格呢……
text_loc: Haha, it's a long story, old friend. What can I say? The Academy felt this trip required the highest level of security available.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 「最高安全规格」？？那不是在重大精灵灾害发生时才启用的……天呐咕！
text_loc: Really? That's only ever invoked during major Jini disasters... good heavens, hoo!

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 难怪得由你亲自护送，但恕我直言咕！在下可从未收到这么危险的消息啊。
text_loc: No wonder they sent you personally. But may I ask, hoo, why no one briefed me on such a serious matter?

text: 竖起耳朵
text_loc: Listen close.

text: 发生了什么？
text_loc: What happened?

name: 路易斯
text: （使了使眼色）咳咳……，打住吧老朋友，我看此事……还是稍后再聊比较好。
text_loc: *exchanges a meaningful look* Ahem... I think we'd best leave it there, old pal. We can pick this conversation back up later.

name: 路易斯
text: 总之无论发生任何情况，校方都做好了万全的对策，相信不久便会安全抵达学院。
text_loc: Whatever happens, the Academy has contingency plans in place. I'm confident we'll arrive safely in no time.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 最好如此咕……路易斯，有你这番话，我和小洛克阁下也能放心不少！
text_loc: I'll hold you to that, Louis, hoo. That does put both me and Young Roco at ease!

name: 路易斯
text: 好啦，我们也别制造紧张气氛了，想必{name}，早就迫不及待地想融入学院生活了吧？
text_loc: Well, let's not stir up any more tension. I imagine {name} is already eager to dive into life at the Academy, isn't that right?

text: 没错没错
text_loc: Absolutely.

text: 那是当然！
text_loc: Of course!

name: 路易斯
text: 哈哈，那就去和船上的同期新生们相互认识，交流一下与精灵相逢的心得吧……
text_loc: Well, then go meet some of your fellow first-years on board. You can swap stories about how you each met your Jini.

name: 路易斯
text: 魔法学院向来提倡同学们，在使用精灵的沟通中成长——而这种「特殊」的交流方式，也许会让你兴奋起来！
text_loc: The Magic Academy has always encouraged personal growth by having students communicating with their Jini. You may also happen to find it exciting!

name: 路易斯
text: 但要记得……点到即止就好！哈哈，那就不耽误你宝贵的时间啦，快去、快去吧~
text_loc: Just remember, keep it in check! Well, I won't take up any more of your time. Off you go.

text: 前方的同学正望着自己的精灵，思考着什么。
text_loc: A student nearby is gazing at her Jini, deep in thought.

name: 史黛西
text: 我的板板壳啊，什么时候，你也能成长为那种「惊人」的精灵呢……？
text_loc: Oh, my little Catapawn... when will you grow into something truly extraordinary?

text: 惊人的精灵？
text_loc: Extraordinary, you say?

name: 史黛西
text: 没错，你也对培育不可思议的精灵感兴趣吗？看样子遇到同道者了。
text_loc: Exactly. You're interested in raising something remarkable too? Looks like I've found a kindred spirit.

name: 史黛西
text: 但我想培育的精灵，是一种只在传说中出现的精灵哦——它们被称为「精灵王」。
text_loc: But the Jini I want to raise is one that only exists in legend. They're called the Jini Kings.

text: 精灵王？
text_loc: Jini Kings?

text: 熟悉的名字
text_loc: Sounds familiar.

name: 史黛西
text: 没错！顾名思义，精灵王自然就是精灵世界的绝对王者，据有关人士透露……
text_loc: The Jini Kings are the absolute rulers of the Jini world. And according to those in the know...

name: 史黛西
text: 它们掌握着每种系别的巅峰魔法，所以轻而易举就能改变气候，甚至……搬动山脉。
text_loc: They command the most powerful magic of every type imaginable. They can shift weather patterns or even move entire mountain ranges.

name: 史黛西
text: 对了！悄悄告诉你，听说在轻风山附近的山脉里，就栖息着一只精灵王呢……
text_loc: Oh, and you didn't hear this from me, but word has it that a Jini King lives somewhere in the mountains near Mount Whisperwind.

name: 史黛西
text: 如果能成功与它结成契约，嘿嘿嘿，我是不是也能一举成为瞩目的大魔法师了！
text_loc: Heh heh, if I could form a pact with it, I'd shoot straight to the top and become a legendary Archmage!

name: 卢西奥
text: 喂喂……同学请留步，听说过传说中的「大魔法师」吗？
text_loc: Hey, hey... have you got a second? Have you heard of the legendary Archmages?

name: 卢西奥
text: 他们是卡洛西亚最强的精灵魔法师，亦对专一系别的精灵有着独到的研究。
text_loc: They're the greatest Jini mages on Kalosia, each of them experts in a particular Jini type.

name: 卢西奥
text: 因此得到了不可思议精灵的青睐，几乎人手一只超酷的传说精灵，真是羡慕！
text_loc: Because of that, the most extraordinary Jini are drawn to them. Pretty much every one of them has an incredibly powerful Legendary Jini. Lucky them!

text: 哇，好厉害！
text_loc: Wow, that's amazing!

text: 有这么夸张？
text_loc: Is that all actually real?

name: 卢西奥
text: 水系地区的泡泡老师，草系研究员罗兰老师……
text_loc: There's Professor Bubby from the Water-Type region, Researcher Ronan from the Grass-Type side...

text: 好像听说过……
text_loc: I think I've heard of them...

text: 不太认得
text_loc: Not ringing any bells.

name: 卢西奥
text: 不过……要说最厉害的大魔法师，还是传说中那名叫，他的名字，叫……亚瑟！
text_loc: But the greatest Archmage of all, if the legends are to be believed, goes by the name... Arthiel!

name: 卢西奥
text: 总之，大魔法师们远近闻名，但又神秘莫测。
text_loc: Anyway, the Archmages are famous far and wide, yet remain shrouded in mystery.

name: 卢西奥
text: 而我的梦想——就是追随并成为一名真正的大魔法师，让我们一起努力吧，同学！
text_loc: My dream is to follow in their footsteps and become a true Archmage myself. Maybe I'll see you at the top, friend!

name: 魔法门
text: <Center>飞艇突然发出轻微的震动，随后传送门再次发出光芒，看来又有新同学到了……</>
text_loc: <Center>The airship lets out a faint shudder, and the portal lights up again. Looks like another new student has arrived.</>

text: 岂有此理！这儿的负责人是谁，竟敢不等本公主登船就擅自启航了？
text_loc: How dare they! Who's in charge here? Setting sail without waiting for the Princess is absolutely unacceptable!

text: 可丽希亚，别惹麻烦啦，呼——路途遥远，咱们赶上就好。
text_loc: Krithya, please don't make a scene. Phew. We've had a long journey. The important thing is we made it.

name: 可丽希亚
title: 王国公主
text: 不行！菲尔特，没打败刚才那家伙本公主已经火大了，还有，不要暴露我的身份！
text_loc: I won't hear any of it, Furtis! I'm already irritated that I didn't win that last fight. And stop letting people know who I am!

name: 可丽希亚
title: 王国公主
text: 嗯？看什么看？哼……正好，那就命令你向我说明一下情况！
text_loc: Hm? What are you staring at? Tell me what's going on here, that's an order!

text: 你们迟到了啊
text_loc: You're late, you know.

name: 可丽希亚
title: 王国公主
text: 迟到？？
text_loc: Late?

name: 可丽希亚
title: 王国公主
text: 我们可是立志成为新的大魔法师才来草原冒险的。挑战的专家，对决的使者！
text_loc: We came to the plains in pursuit of our dream of becoming the next Archmages. We are seekers of challenges, champions of duels!

name: 菲尔特
text: 但是不知道怎么就变成度假之旅，不小心玩过头错过开学了……
text_loc: Somewhere along the line, though, it turned into a vacation. We got a little too carried away and missed the start of school...

name: 可丽希亚
title: 王国公主
text: 冒险，这是冒险！
text_loc: It was an adventure. A proper adventure!

name: 可丽希亚
title: 王国公主
text: 再说，你算哪棵奇丽草，竟敢对本公主评头论足？
text_loc: Besides, who are you to comment on my affairs? Watch your mouth.

text: 那又怎样？
text_loc: And if I don't?

name: 可丽希亚
title: 王国公主
text: 本公主的话举足轻重，禁止顶嘴……！哼……
text_loc: My word carries weight around here. You're not permitted to speak back to me! Hmmph...

name: 可丽希亚
title: 王国公主
text: 看来你对自己的实力很自信，那不妨，就用「精灵对决」来证明一下！
text_loc: You seem awfully confident. In that case, why not prove it in a Jini Duel?

name: 可丽希亚
title: 王国公主
text: 那种真正的魔法师们陷入争端时，才会使用精灵发起的公正对决。
text_loc: A fair contest that true mages resort to only when there's a serious dispute, fought through their Jini.

name: 可丽希亚
title: 王国公主
text: ——哼哼……如果我赢了，你就当我的小跟班……如果……我输了，就向你道歉喽。在精灵诸王的见证下，败者必须信守诺言噢！怎么样，敢来试试嘛！
text_loc: If I win, you must become my sidekick. And if I lose... I'll apologize. With the Jini Kings as witnesses, the loser must keep their word. So, dare you challenge me?

name: 菲尔特
text: 可丽希亚……你答应过圣安德鲁陛下的，没到魔法学院，不准打架……
text_loc: Krithya... you promised His Majesty King Aindreas. No fighting until we reach the Magic Academy...

name: 可丽希亚
title: 王国公主
text: 哼哼，这可不是打架，我只是好心给新同学科普精灵对决的知识！
text_loc: This isn't fighting. I'm simply giving a new student a helpful lesson on Jini Duels, out of the goodness of my heart.

name: 可丽希亚
title: 王国公主
text: 放心吧！本公主的目标可是大魔法师！对付这种小孩，自然会手下留情的!
text_loc: Don't fret. My goal is to become an Archmage. Someone like this won't prove to be a challenge, surely.

name: 菲尔特
text: 完蛋了……同学，为你的安全和健康祈祷……
text_loc: Oh no, I'll just... pray for your safety and wellbeing.

text: 对不起……
text_loc: Sorry...

name: 可丽希亚
title: 王国公主
text: 别急着道歉，嘿嘿，想必你也听说过「精灵对决」吧？
text_loc: Don't apologize just yet. I presume you're familiar with what a Jini Duel is?

name: 可丽希亚
title: 王国公主
text: 那种真正的魔法师们陷入争端时，才会使用精灵发起的公正对决。
text_loc: A fair contest that true mages resort to only when there's a serious dispute, fought through their Jini.

text: 你们也是新生？
text_loc: Are you first-years too?

name: 可丽希亚、菲尔特
text: 新生？？
text_loc: First-years?

name: 可丽希亚
title: 王国公主
text: 哼，别太得意，陪你对战是本公主平易近人，而且本公主只用了三成实力而已。
text_loc: Hmph, don't get too full of yourself. I only chose to duel you to humor you, and I was only using a third of my power anyway.

name: 可丽希亚
title: 王国公主
text: 但……约定就是约定，未来的大魔法师绝不食言——
text_loc: But... a deal's a deal. A future Archmage never breaks her word.

name: 可丽希亚
title: 王国公主
text_loc: I... I... I'm sorry.

name: 船长噜噜
text: 同学们！抓紧桅杆！！
text_loc: Everyone! Grab onto something!

name: 船长噜噜
text: 那里是……？
text_loc: Is that...?

text: 噜噜？？路易斯老师……？！
text_loc: Coolu? Professor Louis?

text: 身体好痛……这里是……哪里？
text_loc: Everything hurts... where am I?

text: 这是……什么精灵？像是……要我跟它走的样子……
text_loc: What is this Jini? It's almost like it wants me to follow.

text: 这只精灵在唤醒它的同伴吗？
text_loc: Is this Jini trying to wake the others?

text: 不知道为什么，我能看懂石碑上的文字。
text_loc: I don't know how, but I'm able to read what's written on the stone.

name: 巨大的石碑
text: 「铭记梦想者，终见光明」
text_loc: "Light will find those who keep their dreams alive."

text: 拿出星盘
text_loc: Pull out the Stardial.

text: 终于——金色的叶子，又落回了{gender:他,她}的诞生之地……
text_loc: At last... the golden leaf has drifted back to the place of {gender:his,her} birth.

text: 没想到，我只是稍稍浅眠，竟这么快……便能与你相见了~
text_loc: I slumbered only for a brief moment, and yet... here you are, much sooner than expected.
Who are you?

text: 我——曾是卡洛西亚大陆上，精灵王座的守护者，见证了洛克与精灵契约的终始。
text_loc: I was once the guardian of the Jini thrones on the continent of Kalosia. A witness to the beginning and the end of every pact between Rocos and Jini.

text: 但现在，呵呵，只是个不得不照看这破旧庭院的守园人而已，不如你就叫我……
text_loc: But now... hehe, I'm nothing more than a caretaker tending to this worn-out garden. You can simply call me...
*pauses in thought*

name: 白树
text_loc: "The Radiant Tree."

text: 白、树？
text_loc: The Radiant Tree?

name: 白树
text: 哈哈，虽然从你的口中念出，颇有一种奇妙的味道。
text_loc: Haha, there's something rather delightful about hearing it come from your lips.

name: 白树
text: 说起来多有打扰，莫名就用这种方式将你唤来此地，实在称不上妥当。
text_loc: I apologize for the inconvenience, by the way. Summoning you here in such an abrupt manner was hardly proper of me.

name: 白树
text: 但或许……你也已经猜到了，是「它」把你带到这里来的。
text_loc: But perhaps you've already guessed. It was that little one who brought you here.

name: 白树
text: 嗯——就是那个，爱变作星光的调皮的小家伙。
text_loc: That mischievous rascal who loves to take the form of starlight.

text: 好像是它救了我
text_loc: I think it saved me.

name: 白树
text: 一如既往啊，像是它的脾气——永远这么勇敢，这么地……不计后果。
text_loc: That would be very much in character. Always so brave... and so reckless.

name: 白树
text: 它成功救下了你，似乎也用尽了力气，不能继续住在那枚星盘中了……
text_loc: It managed to save you, but doing so seems to have left it physically spent. It can no longer stay inside that Stardial.

text: 这到底是什么？
text_loc: What even is this thing?

text: 原来叫「星盘」啊！
text_loc: So it's called a Stardial...

name: 白树
text: 把它交给我吧，就让金色的树影，为你揭开它真正的样子……
text_loc: Hand it to me, and the golden light of the tree shall reveal what it truly is.

text: 你知道发生了什么？
text_loc: Do you know what happened?

name: 白树
text: 我与这小家伙心意相通，自然也知晓它的所见所闻。
text_loc: That little one and I share a deep connection. I know everything it has seen and heard.

text: 你是……一棵树？
text_loc: So... you're a tree?

name: 白树
text: 哈哈，若你想要这么理解，倒也没错~
text_loc: If that makes it easier for you, then yes, I am.

text: 是在叫我？？
text_loc: Is someone calling out to me?

text: 呵呵，不必在意……
text_loc: Heh, pay it no mind.

text: 是刚刚那只神秘的精灵——！
text_loc: It's that mysterious Jini from before!

text: 眼前的蓝色精灵，步履欢快地走向了我，亲昵地蹭了蹭……
text_loc: The blue Jini in front of me jauntily trots over and nuzzles up against me.

name: 白树
text: 果然，虽说是初次见面，但你们已经像老朋友一样熟稔了。
text_loc: Just as I thought. You two are already like old friends.

name: 白树
text: 但……不知道你是否熟悉它的名字呢？
text_loc: But I wonder... do you happen to know its name?

text: 是什么？？
text_loc: No, what is it?

name: 白树
text: 它便是最后的光之精灵王——「迪莫」，它将会是你并肩作战的伙伴，一同成长的挚友。
text_loc: It is the last of the Light Jini Kings, Dimo. It will accompany you in battle and come to be your closest companion.

text: 好期待……
text_loc: I can't wait...

text: 太棒啦！
text_loc: Awesome!

name: 白树
text: 迪莫突然有些急躁地原地跳跃，示意你跟上，然后跑开了……
text_loc: |||<Center>Dimo suddenly grows restless, hopping in place to signal you to follow before dashing off.</>

name: 白树
text: 嗯……？这孩子！呵呵，看来我们的交谈得暂告一段落了。
text_loc: Hmm? Well, it appears our conversation will have to wait.

name: 白树
text: 比起我要向你诉说的，明显这小家伙，还有更加急迫的事情想要告诉你~
text_loc: Whatever I have to tell you, little Dimo clearly has something far more urgent to share with you.

name: 白树
text: ——去追上它吧，也许你能了解关于它的更多故事。
text_loc: Go after it. Perhaps you'll learn a little more of its story.

text: 是迪莫！！
text_loc: It's Dimo.

name: 白树
text: 不错！它便是最后的光之精灵王——「迪莫」，{name}，你竟然真的知道！
text_loc: Most impressive! Yes, it is the last of the Light Jini Kings, Dimo.

name: 白树
text: 它将会是你并肩作战的伙伴，一同成长的挚友。
text_loc: It will accompany you in battle and come to be your closest companion.

text: 迪莫……竟跑到了这里，静静凝望着前方的某物……
text_loc: Dimo wanders over and stands quietly, gazing at something ahead.

text: 剑身散发出微光，一些金色的文字浮现，在我眼前徐徐展开——
text_loc: A faint glow pulses along the blade, and golden words begin to rise from it, slowly unfurling before my eyes.

name: 光之碑文
title: 墓志铭
text: <span color="#ffd700">此处铭记着一位逝者的故事，他是最伟大的国王，亦是最好的孩子。</>
text_loc: <span color="#ffd700">Here lies the story of one who has passed. The greatest of kings, and the finest son.</>

name: 光之碑文
title: 墓志铭
text: <span color="#ffd700">「在黑暗与荆棘蔓延之际，你是最闪亮的星星」</>
text_loc: <span color="#ffd700">"In the hour when darkness and thorns spread without end, you were the brightest star."</>

name: 光之碑文
title: 墓志铭
text: <span color="#ffd700">「世界笼罩于一场噩梦，而你却独守使命，在血与光芒的挥洒下……终换和平。」</>
text_loc: <span color="#ffd700">"The world was engulfed by a Nightmare, yet you alone stayed true to your purpose. Through blood and blazing light, you won us peace."</>

name: 光之碑文
title: 墓志铭
text: <span color="#ffd700">「此刻——日鸣月落，星灵齐悲，在噩梦褪去的漫漫长夜里，愿你安眠……」</>
text_loc: <span color="#ffd700">"Now, as the sun dims and the moon fades, as every star and spirit mourns, may you rest peacefully through the long night after the Nightmare ends."</>

name: 光之碑文
title: 墓志铭
text: <span color="#ffd700">「你所信赖的光之精灵，永远依偎着你，当星光流转之际，它会找到新的愿望与勇气……」</>
text_loc: <span color="#ffd700">"The Jini of Light you trusted will remain by your side forever. When the stars align, it will find wishes and courage anew."</>

text: 「光之精灵」……？迪莫此刻看起来，好像有些悲伤……
text_loc: "Jini of Light"? Dimo looks almost sad right now...

text: 难道，迪莫就是光之精灵，而这里……是它曾经陪伴的……
text_loc: Could it be that Dimo is the Jini of Light, and this place was where it once stayed with...

text: 迪莫感受到了我的热情，振作了起来！但它的目光，依旧停留在这把剑上……
text_loc: Dimo feels my attempt to lift its spirits, but its gaze still lingers on the sword.

text: |||<Center>剑身的微光突然流动起来，一个坚定却温柔的声音响起：</>
text_loc: |||<Center>The faint glow along the blade begins to stir, and a voice rings out, firm yet tender:</>

name: 渺远的声音
text: |||||||||||||||<Center>星光已然流转了吗？那么该告别了……我的伙伴。</>
text_loc: |||||||||||||||<Center>Have the stars aligned at last? Then it is time to say goodbye, my companion.</>

name: 渺远的声音
text: |||||||||||||||<Center>以后的旅途，就好好陪在{gender:他,她}的身边吧……</>
text_loc: |||||||||||||||<Center>Stay by {gender:his,her} side, wherever the road ahead may lead you.</>

text: 迪莫欢快地叫了起来，好似那颗国王球就是为它而准备的。
text_loc: Dimo lets out a cheerful cry, as if that King's Buddy Pod had been made just for it.

text: 建立契约
text_loc: Form a pact.

text: 获得了迪莫！
text_loc: Dimo obtained!

name: 白树
text: 恭喜你！悦目的金色光芒再次闪耀，你得到了迪莫的认可~
text_loc: Congratulations! A beautiful golden light shines once more. Dimo has joined you.

name: 白树
text: 果然，当星光流转之际，它找到了新的愿望与勇气……
text_loc: Just as it was written, when the stars aligned, it found new wishes and new courage.

text: 刚才插着剑的丘冢……
text_loc: The mound with the sword...

text: 迪莫的主人……
text_loc: Dimo's previous companion...

name: 白树
text: 不错~想必你已经知晓，迪莫的旧主，其实就是那位被群星所铭记的「英雄王」。
text_loc: Indeed. As I imagine you already know, Dimo's former companion was none other than the one remembered by the stars, the Hero King.

name: 白树
text: 他曾是大陆上最杰出的精灵魔法师，却为了守护他所心爱的王国，牺牲了自己……
text_loc: He was the greatest Jini mage the continent had ever known, yet he gave his life to protect the kingdom he loved.

name: 白树
text: 在他生命的最后时刻，这誓死守护他的小家伙，将寄住着他灵魂的信物带来了这里。
text_loc: In his final moments, the devoted Dimo carried the keepsake holding his soul to this very place.

name: 白树
text: 自那之后……迪莫始终期盼新的希望。等待了好久好久，而等来的，却是像你这样可爱的小朋友。
text_loc: Dimo has held on ever since, waiting for its hope to be renewed. Now, finally, after waiting for so long, someone has come. And to think they're so adorable.

text: 我吗？
text_loc: Are you talking about me?

text: 嘿嘿，也没有那么可爱
text_loc: Hehe, you flatter me.

name: 白树
text: 哈哈。坦白说，我也并不意外……
text_loc: Well, this is hardly a surprise.

name: 白树
text: 在卡洛西亚大陆上，人们许下愿望，恪守约定，因之获得了力量——而精灵们，也同时被赋予进化的意义。
text_loc: Across the continent of Kalosia, people make wishes and keep promises. Through that, they gain strength, and the Jini, in turn, are given a reason to grow.

name: 白树
text: 虽说大部分时候，这份约定最终都会被忘记，但只有孩子们，才会坚信它的存在~
text_loc: Most of the time, those promises are eventually forgotten. But children... children are the ones who never stop believing.

text: 迪莫不停点着小脑袋，像是在为我「证明」一般……
text_loc: Dimo eagerly nods along, as if vouching for every word.

name: 白树
text: ——而于千千万万的叶片中，被迪莫选中的你，一定有着更为纯真的愿望。
text_loc: And among the countless leaves, the one Dimo chose is you. That tells me you carry a wish purer than most.

name: 白树
text: 无论……你与那位英雄是否有所联系，这份星盘，还是先交还给你。
text_loc: Whatever connection you may or may not share with that hero, this Stardial belongs with you.

name: 白树
text: 作为英雄王留下的宝藏，它的内部……仍然蕴藏着无数强大的力量。而你，亦能使用早已储存其中的——与纯真愿望所共鸣的魔法。
text_loc: As a treasure left behind by the Lightbringer, it holds immense power within it. You can already draw upon what has long been stored inside, magic that resonates with wishes true and pure.

text: 愿望……共鸣？
text_loc: A wish... resonates?

text: 要怎么使用呢？
text_loc: How does it work?

name: 白树
text: 共鸣魔法乃是洛克与精灵之间契约的具象体现，「愿力强化」便是其中最为基础的一种。
text_loc: Resonance Rituals are living proof of the pact between Rocos and Jini. Wishpower Boost is the most fundamental of those rituals.

name: 白树
text: 在战斗时，对精灵使用「愿力强化」便可使它短暂获得额外的力量，使出更为强力的精灵魔法。
text_loc: In battle, using Wishpower Boost on your Jini grants it a burst of extra strength, allowing it to unleash more powerful Jini Magic.

text: 好想试试看！
text_loc: I want to try it!

name: 白树
text: 别着急，想要掌握这星盘的力量，恐怕你还需要接受一次小小的考验~
text_loc: Not so fast. To master the power of this Stardial, you will first need to pass a small trial.

name: 白树
text: 早有所闻，你们精灵魔法师们热衷于使用对决来表达自己的信念，见证最庄重的承诺。
text_loc: I've long heard that you Jini mages love to express your convictions through duels and bear witness to the most solemn of vows.

name: 白树
text: 那么，准备好了吗？若想获得这股力量——就让我在对决中看到你的决心吧！
text_loc: So then, are you ready? If you want this power, show me your resolve in a duel!

name: 白树
text: 果然！你是一片炙热的叶子，虽还不甚耀眼，却充满了绽放的希望……
text_loc: Just as I thought. You are a blazing leaf, not yet at full brightness, but full of the promise to bloom.

name: 白树
text: 说起来，经历了刚才的战斗……你是否感到与星盘加深了联系呢？
text_loc: Do you feel a deeper connection with the Stardial after that battle?

text: 加深了许多！
text_loc: Much deeper!

name: 白树
text: 那就好，想必总有一天，你会通过这个星盘，解开所有与他相关的力量~
text_loc: Good. I have no doubt that one day, through this Stardial, you will unlock every last power connected to the Lightbringer.

text: 在「愿力强化」之外，卡洛西亚大陆上还有更多样的共鸣魔法等待你去探索，收集并掌握它们的使用方式，能大大增强你的战斗能力。
text_loc: Not just Wishpower Boost. There are many Resonance Rituals across Kalosia waiting to be discovered, and with them, you'll command a far greater power of the pact.

name: 白树
text: 也只有这样，我才能更放心地，让你和迪莫回到属于你自己的世界……
text_loc: Only then will I feel at ease and allow you and Dimo to return to your rightful world.

text: 为何会这么说？
text_loc: Why do you say that?

name: 白树
text: 或许你还不知道……一股古老的黑暗力量又回来了，就如从前一样。
text_loc: Perhaps you don't yet know... an ancient dark power has returned, just as it did before.

name: 白树
text: 而你与迪莫，应该也已领教过了这股黑暗力量的可怕……
text_loc: You and Dimo have already had a taste of how terrifying that darkness can be.

text: 紫黑色的能量
text_loc: That dark violet energy...

text: 那些黑衣人……
text_loc: Those hooded figures...

name: 白树
text: 不错，那股力量，它曾经被击败，却从未被彻底消灭……
text_loc: That's right. While that power was defeated once, it was never truly destroyed.

name: 白树
text: 伴随着无边的污染，它深入了世界的根须，也侵蚀了众多强大生灵的身躯。
text_loc: It has spread its corruption deep into the roots of the world, taking hold of many powerful beings along the way.

name: 白树
text: 唯有比拟那位英雄的力量，才能够化解它的影响，甚至……挽救这一切。
text_loc: Only a power that rivals the Lightbringer's can undo its influence, and perhaps even turn everything around.

text: 可他不是已经
text_loc: But didn't he already...

text: 那就还有希望
text_loc: Then there's still hope.

name: 白树
text: 所以，作为能够呼应星盘的孩子，我们需要你的帮助，才能与之抗衡！
text_loc: And so, as the one who answers the Stardial's call, we need your help to stand against it.

name: 白树
text: 但……只靠你与年幼的迪莫，恐怕还无法面对这股黑暗的反扑……
text_loc: But you and young Dimo are not yet ready to face this darkness head on.

name: 白树
text: 为此——你也需要寻觅更多的伙伴，那些……曾与星盘订立了契约的强大存在。
text_loc: To get there, you must seek out more companions. Powerful ones who once made a pact with the Stardial.

text: 它们在哪里？
text_loc: Where are they, then?

name: 白树
text: 就在……那位英雄曾走过的路上，在那些残存于遥远精灵歌谣的点滴里。
text_loc: Along the path that hero once walked. In the notes that linger in distant Jini songs.

name: 白树
text: 跟随那位从前之人的足迹，你便能在久远约定的丝缕中，找到它们~
text_loc: Follow the trail he left behind, and through the threads of old promises, you will find them.

name: 白树
text: 而这枚星盘，会始终与你同在，为你指明前路与方向……
text_loc: All the while, this Stardial will be with you to light the way ahead.

text: 我……能做到吗？
text_loc: Do I have what it takes?

text: 只能说试试……
text_loc: I'll give it a try...

name: 白树
text: 那么——金色的叶子，重回你所在的世界，得到所有精灵王的帮助吧。
text_loc: Now then, golden leaf, return to the world whence you came. Seek out all the Jini Kings and solicit their aid.

name: 白树
text: 就如你在渴望与它们订立契约一样，它们，也在等待着你的到来！
text_loc: Just as you long to form a pact with them, so have they been waiting for you.

name: 白树
text: 待到那时，你一定能找到属于自己的力量……
text_loc: When that day comes, you will find the strength that is truly yours.

name: 白树
text: 也自然，会再次听见我的呼唤……
text_loc: And you will come to hear my voice once more.

text: 我也不知道……
text_loc: I still feel uncertain...

name: 白树
text: 没关系~往后还有着无数次与这星盘共鸣的机会。不只是「愿力强化」……
text_loc: That's alright. There will be countless more chances to resonate with the Stardial, and not simply for Wishpower Boost.

name: 白树
text: 你会获得种类繁多的共鸣魔法，也会因此掌握更为强大的契约之力。终有一天……
text_loc: You will discover many kinds of Resonance Rituals, and through them, gain an ever greater command over the power inherent in the pact. One day...

name: 白树
text: 你会解开所有与他相关的力量，也只有这样，我才能放心地将迪莫交给你。
text_loc: You will unlock every power connected to the Lightbringer. Only then can I truly entrust Dimo to you.

name: 黑衣人
title: 追踪者
text: 大人说了，他们靠太近了，一个都不能放过！
text_loc: The master said they got too close. Don't let any of them get away!

name: 黑衣人
title: 驯龙者
text: 那一船还挺多人的，现在怎么只剩这几个了？
text_loc: How come there are so few of them? Weren't there a bunch of people onboard?

name: 黑衣人
title: 追踪者
text: 那只怪鸟好像指挥他们撤离了，我去追。这个蓝色的小东西看起来有点……让我不舒服，你当心点。
text_loc: That weird bird seemed to be taking them to safety. I'll go after them. Also, this little blue thing gives me a bad feeling. Watch yourself.

text: <Center>矮个的黑衣人乘着飞行精灵离开了。</>
text_loc: <Center>The hooded figure flies off on a Jini.</>

name: 黑衣人
title: 驯龙者
text: 哼，你放心的去好了。一个小孩而已！
text_loc: Hmph, go right ahead. It's just a kid!

name: 黑衣人
title: 驯龙者
text: 可恶！我……居然输给了一个孩子？！
text_loc: Unbelievable. I lost to a child?

name: 黑衣人
title: 驯龙者
text: 无妨！我们的任务已经完成，黑暗已然弥散，库伦大人的伟大计划必将成功！
text_loc: It doesn't matter. Our mission is complete. The darkness has spread. Lord Kullen's great plan will not fail!

text: |||<Center>黑衣人离开了。</>|||<Center>你将受伤的噜噜抱到了附近的石台上。</>
text_loc: |||<Center>The hooded figure retreats.</> |||<Center>You carry the injured Coolu to a nearby stone ledge.</>

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 咕噜……咕……唔……，好痛。
text_loc: Hoo... hoo... ugh... everything hurts.

text: 做洛工呼吸
text_loc: Give mouth-to-mouth.

text: 揉揉护心毛
text_loc: Ruffle his chest fluff.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 咕？恍惚间竟看到了小洛克阁下，难道我已经踏上灵魂之河了吗……
text_loc: Hoo...? W-Was that you? Young Roco, have I already stepped onto the River of Souls...?

text: 真的是我
text_loc: It's me.

text: 你可没有！
text_loc: You most certainly have not!

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 咕？！没……错，真的是阁下，谢天谢地！你居然没事咕！！
text_loc: Hoo? You're right... it really is you. Good feathers, you're okay, hoo!

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 不过你刚才跑哪里去了？？飞艇坠落之后，我们可一直都在找你。
text_loc: Where did you disappear to? After the airship went down, we were looking everywhere for you.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 最后就差你一个了咕，路易斯急地团团转，只好带着其余同学先行撤离……
text_loc: You were the last one unaccounted for, hoo. Louis was beside himself, but he had no other choice than to take the other students and go ahead.

text: 不好意思
text_loc: Sorry about that.

text: 其实我……
text_loc: Well, I...

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 好啦咕！人没事就好，说起来，刚才那些气势汹汹的黑衣人呢？？
text_loc: It's fine, hoo! You're safe, and that's what matters. Now then, who were those hooded figures? They looked pretty menacing...

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 从没见过那样阴森的魔法……先前撤退的时候，大伙儿也没少吃他们的苦头！
text_loc: I've never seen such dark magic. They gave us a heck of a hard time on their way out.

text: 好像已经离开了
text_loc: It looks like they've gone.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 呼——那可太好了咕，想必他们是被在下英勇抵抗的精神给吓退了！
text_loc: Phew, what a relief. I'd like to think they were scared off by my heroic show of resistance!

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 虽然惊魂未定，但我们能够成功击退追捕，就是天大的好事咕。
text_loc: It's been a harrowing ordeal, but driving them off is a victory worth celebrating, hoo.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 既然如此，我们也赶快撤离这里，前往附近的驻地与路易斯汇合吧……
text_loc: In any case, let's not linger here. We should make our way to the nearest outpost and regroup with Louis.

text: 出发！
text_loc: Let's go!

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 不对……等一等……这里的山，怎么好像在……？？
text_loc: Hold on... why does this mountain look like it's...?

text: 我已经解决了……
text_loc: I already took care of it.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 你……？？打赢了他们？？
text_loc: What? You beat them all?

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 呼呼咕，虽说阁下天赋异禀，但现在绝不是吹牛的好时候~
text_loc: Hoo, Young Roco, your talents never cease to amaze, but now is really not the time to be showing off.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 既然侥幸摆脱了他们，我们也快撤离这里，去附近的驻地与路易斯汇合吧！
text_loc: We've fortunately managed to get out of this in one piece, but there's not a moment to waste. To the nearest outpost, and back to Louis!

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 我看见了什么？！风卷里，竟然藏着这么狰狞的精灵……太恐怖了咕。
text_loc: What did I just see? There's a terrifying-looking Jini lurking in that whirlwind... this is bad, hoo.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 不能再停留了，阁下，我们必须撤离！！立刻、马上！
text_loc: We can't stay here. Young Roco, we have to go. Right now!

text: 要怎么撤？
text_loc: How do we get out?

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 还记得先前订立契约的<span color="#cc0033">「冬羽雀」</>吗，在悬崖边使用它，然后闭上眼睛……跳下去！
text_loc: Remember the <span color="#cc0033">Winterfinch</> you formed a pact with? Go to the edge of the cliff, send it out, close your eyes... and jump!

name: 噜噜
text: 我再说一遍飞行的方法吧——先将冬羽雀编入你的队伍。
text_loc: Let me go over how to fly one more time. First, add Winterfinch to your party.

name: 噜噜
text: 选中冬羽雀，点击飞行！
text_loc: Select Winterfinch, then tap Fly.

name: 噜噜
text: 注意！飞行需要消耗你的体力。请在体力耗尽之前降落，否则可能会因体力耗尽而从高处坠落受伤。
text_loc: Keep in mind that flying uses up your Stamina! Make sure to land before it runs out, or you risk taking a high altitude fall.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 别担心，在下也会努力扑腾翅膀保护你的，再说这都什么时候了……
text_loc: Don't worry, I'll do my best to flap alongside and keep you safe. Although I will say now's not the time for hesitation...

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 咕啊！下一波石头又要来啦，阁下——快飞吧！！
text_loc: Hoo! Here comes another wave of rocks. Fly, Young Roco, now!

text: 这是……谁的家吗？嗯？迪莫？
text_loc: Is this... someone's home? ...Hmm? Dimo?

name: 佩西
title: 住家阿姨
text: 呀！你醒了！被太阳晒过一天的被子，睡得还舒服吗？来自魔法学院的小朋友。
text_loc: Ah, you're finally awake! That blanket's been out soaking in the sun all day, and you had quite the snooze under it, my little friend from the Academy.

name: 佩西
title: 住家阿姨
text: 我叫佩西，是这里的住家阿姨，按商店街流行的说法，也是「管家」？说回来，小朋友，你现在感觉还好吗？
text_loc: Name's Penny. I'm the lady of the house here, or a "housekeeper," as they say down in Merchant Town. How are you feeling?

text: 好得超乎想象
text_loc: Better than I expected.

name: 佩西
title: 住家阿姨
text: 小孩子的恢复力真是惊人。真好，你看起来也神采奕奕！
text_loc: The resilience of youth never ceases to amaze me. Wonderful, you look bright-eyed and bushy-tailed!

text: 我记得……飞艇坠落，神秘的空间里，有一位「白树」——在那之后，我遇见了黑衣人，旁观了一场了不得的对战……
text_loc: I remember the airship going down, a mysterious space, and someone called "The Radiant Tree." After that, hooded figures appeared, and there was a pitched battle unlike anything I'd ever seen...

name: 佩西
title: 住家阿姨
text: 听说……你晕倒在了风眠山脉？外头正闹风灾呢，真是可怕！幸好你的朋友靠谱，及时把你救了回来。
text_loc: I heard you were found unconscious somewhere in the Windrest Mountains. Terrible winds ravage that place. You're lucky your friend was quick enough and brought you back safe.

text: 朋友？
text_loc: My friend?

name: 佩西
title: 住家阿姨
text: 就是那只叽叽喳喳的小猫头鹰噜噜先生呀！圆滚滚的小小一团，嘴上倒是利索得很。
text_loc: That chatty little owl, Mr. Coolu. Round as a ball and can really talk your ear off.

name: 佩西
title: 住家阿姨
text: 这孩子，满嘴都是「{name}要是变植物洛咋办啊咕」，「担心死了咕」的，在你床边绕了很久很久……
text_loc: You should have heard him carrying on. Hovering around your beside for the longest time, fretting, "What if {name} never wakes up, hoo" and "I'm so worried, hoo."

text: 让它担心，挺不好意思的……
text_loc: I feel bad for worrying him.

text: 也太夸张了吧！
text_loc: That's a bit dramatic.

name: 佩西
title: 住家阿姨
text: 别提了，一会儿给你盖被子，一会儿又凑近你喃喃细语……它辛勤照顾你，连我都帮不上什么忙呢。
text_loc: You have no idea. One moment he was tucking in your blanket, the next he was right up close murmuring away. He worked so hard looking after you that I honestly didn't have to do much of anything.

name: 佩西
title: 住家阿姨
text: 就连路易斯老师亲自来唤它去工作，还要先用翅膀反复摸你的额头确认，满不情愿地磨蹭了好久才走——
text_loc: And when Professor Louis came to call him back to work, he still insisted on pressing his wing to your forehead one more time, before shuffling off ever so reluctantly.

name: 佩西
title: 住家阿姨
text: 对了，说到「走」，噜噜先生临走时留了一封信，嘱咐务必要由你亲自打开……
text_loc: Oh, speaking of which, Mr. Coolu left a letter before he went. Insisted that I not open it, as it was for your eyes only.

name: 佩西
title: 住家阿姨
text: 那时候呀，它胖胖的身躯扭来扭去，小爪子歪歪扭扭地写，颇费一番功夫的样子，还挺可爱的，呼呼。
text_loc: You should have seen it, that little round body wiggling back and forth as those tiny talons worked overtime scratching out every word. Quite the sight, I must say.

text: 头还晕乎乎的
text_loc: I'm still feeling a bit foggy.

name: 佩西
title: 住家阿姨
text: 不要勉强自己哦，适当晒晒太阳，活动活动吧，会让自己舒服一点。
text_loc: Don't push yourself. A little sunshine and a short walk will do you good.

name: 噜噜的留信
title: 金牌向导
text: 亲爱的{name}！
text_loc: Dear {name}!

name: 噜噜的留信
title: 金牌向导
text: 抱歉，飞离山脉行动不顺，没能保护你咕……幸好，找到了你！
text_loc: I'm sorry. Our escape from the mountains didn't go as planned, and I wasn't able to protect you, hoo... But I'm so glad I found you!

name: 噜噜的留信
title: 金牌向导
text: 现在你暂且在风眠山魔法师驻地的主人家中休憩，我和路易斯已经探望过你，但你一直昏睡，我很担心！
text_loc: You're resting at a homestay near the Windrest Mountain mage outpost. Louis and I have both come to check on you, but you've been asleep the whole time. I've been so worried!

name: 噜噜的留信
title: 金牌向导
text: 等你恢复了，请来驻地找我和路易斯！慢悠悠地咕！注意身体咕！
text_loc: Once you're feeling better, please come find Louis and me at the outpost! But take your time and don't rush, hoo! Take care!

text: 这封信的结尾，用墨水印了一只凌乱的小爪子。
text_loc: At the bottom of the letter, a small, messy talon print has been stamped in ink.

name: 佩西
title: 住家阿姨
text: 哈哈哈，别调皮了小家伙，快陪你的小主人一起上学吧。
text_loc: Haha, don't be silly. You go ahead and keep your friend company on the way to school.

text: 佩西阿姨
text_loc: Miss Penny?

text: 我看过信了
text_loc: I've read the letter.

name: 佩西
title: 住家阿姨
text: 嗯嗯，接下来就得去报到了嘛，对了，别忘了带上你这只特别的精灵！
text_loc: Good, good, then you're ready to head to the outpost. Oh, and don't forget to bring that special Jini of yours.

name: 佩西
title: 住家阿姨
text: 从未在商店街附近见过这种精灵，蓝蓝的真好看，一定是非常稀有的品种……
text_loc: I've never seen a Jini like that anywhere near Merchant Town. Such a lovely shade of blue. It must be incredibly rare.

name: 迪莫
text: 迪莫~~迪莫~~（赖在地上不想走）
text_loc: Dimo~~ Dimo~~ *sprawled on the ground, refusing to move*

text: 带走它——
text_loc: Bring Dimo along.

text: |||<center>将迪莫装回了咕噜球里……</>
text_loc: |||<center>Dimo is returned to its Buddy Pod.</>

name: 路易斯
text: 恭喜你，顺利完成了前置学习！给你，这就是——「魔法师手册」。
text_loc: Congratulations, you've completed your orientation! Here, this is the Mage's Handbook, and it's is for you.

name: 噜噜
text: 今天就正式成为魔法学院的学生了咕，要加油咕！
text_loc: Today's the day you officially become a student of the Magic Academy. Give it your all, hoo!

name: 兴奋的学生
text: 谢谢路易斯老师，谢谢噜噜，我会加油的！！呃，这本作业好厚……
text_loc: Thank you, Professor Louis. Thank you, Coolu. I'll do my best! Wow, that's one hefty tome...

name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>这名新生一边翻着叫做《魔法师手册》的册子，一边抓耳挠腮地离去了。</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>The new student flips through the Mage's Handbook, scratching their head as they head off.</>|||

name: 噜噜
text: 路易斯，咱们的露天课堂，真希望能有效果咕。
text_loc: I really do hope this Outdoor Classroom makes a difference, Louis.

text: 久等了——我来报到！
text_loc: I'm here to check in!

name: 噜噜
text: 咕咕咕？！是阁下！呜呜，你再不醒，我都要去王国城堡请医生了！
text_loc: By the feathers, it's you! I was this close to sending for a doctor from the Citadel.

name: 路易斯
text: 啊……是你！最后才离开山脉的那位同学？！
text_loc: Ah, it's you! The one who was last to leave the mountains.

name: 路易斯
text: 幸好你没事，在你昏迷的日子里，噜噜每天必去看你好几次，都要踏破房子的门槛了。
text_loc: I'm so glad you're alright. While you were unconscious, Coolu practically wore a groove in the doorstep from checking in on you so much.

text: 噜噜先生还真够义气
text_loc: You really came through, Coolu.

text: 让大家担心了……
text_loc: Sorry for worrying you all...

name: 噜噜
text: 对了！和小同学说说那个事情吧！风卷！露天课堂！咕咕！
text_loc: Oh, tell {gender:him,her} about the windstorm and the Outdoor Classroom, hoo!

name: 路易斯
text: 噜噜是指，风灾徒生，飞艇坠毁……虽然学生大多无事，但事件的影响面，还是远远超出了学院的预期。
text_loc: Right. Coolu is referring to how, although most students emerged unharmed from the airship accident, the damage to the airship itself far exceeded what the Academy had anticipated.

name: 路易斯
text: 飞艇需要时间维修，不仅如此，由于暴怒的风卷未曾停息，无法预测的魔力波动，也严重影响了航道……
text_loc: The airship needs time for repairs. On top of that, the raging winds show no sign of letting up, and the unpredictable surges in magical energy have made the flight routes completely unsafe.

name: 路易斯
text: ——因此……恐怕不能将你们如期送往学院了。
text_loc: In other words... it looks like we won't be able to get you all to the Academy on schedule.

text: 风灾居然这么严重！
text_loc: Are these winds that serious?

text: 啊？我们没法上学了？
text_loc: Wait, so we can't go to school?

name: 路易斯
text: 别急，别急，在该地区魔法学院分部的帮助下，我们得以在此处暂且安顿。
text_loc: Don't worry. With the help of the local Magic Academy branch, we've been able to settle here for the time being.

name: 路易斯
text: 本地的大魔法师「伊里斯」慷慨相助，经过商议……我们决定，为滞留的新生们提供临时的——「露天课堂」！
text_loc: The local Archmage, Irys, generously offered his assistance. After some discussion, we've decided to set up a temporary Outdoor Classroom for the students who are stranded here.

name: 噜噜
text: 没错咕！为了不拖下大家学习的进度，专门设置的露天课堂！
text_loc: That's right, hoo! A special Outdoor Classroom, so no one falls behind in their studies.

name: 路易斯
text: 噜噜说得太严肃了，其实嘛，就是化困难为机会，让学生们自由地接触野生精灵！在真实的冒险中，自然地积累魔法师的实践经验。
text_loc: Coolu makes it sound very official, but really, it's about turning a setback into an opportunity. Students will get to roam freely, encounter wild Jini, and build real hands-on experience as mages out in the field.

text: 自由行动？感觉很看自觉性
text_loc: That calls for self-discipline.

text: 自由行动？感觉会玩得很爽
text_loc: This is gonna be so much fun!

name: 噜噜
text: 自由，却也有要求哦，咕咕！
text_loc: You'll have freedom, yes, but we'll also have expectations of you!

name: 路易斯
text: 如噜噜老师所言。为了督促大家学习，学院也准备了配套措施——给每位学生发放一本<span color="#D56C1F">《魔法师手册》</>！
text_loc: As Coolu says, to keep everyone on track, the Academy has given every student a copy of the <span color="#D56C1F">Mage's Handbook</>.

text: 我也有吗？
text_loc: Does that include me?

name: 路易斯
text: 哈哈哈，当然你也有一份。不过在那之前，你要像其他学生们一样，先完成前置学习，才能从我这里拿到手册。
text_loc: Haha, of course it does. But first, you'll need to complete your orientation, just like all the other students, before I hand it over.

name: 噜噜
text: 路易斯说的前置学习是指，小同学需要先去找露天课堂的老师们学习一些基础知识，咕咕！
text_loc: For your orientation, you'll need to visit the Outdoor Classroom instructors and learn some foundational skills first, hoo.

name: 路易斯
text: 说起来，恩佐应该就在不远处教学生们，你可以先去他那边学习。
text_loc: In fact, Enzir should be teaching nearby. You can start with him.

name: 噜噜
text: 咕！恩佐是你们的学长，是我们学院的优秀学生。阁下好好学习，未来也能成为恩佐那样厉害的魔法师哦，咕咕！
text_loc: Hoo! Enzir is an upperclassman, and one of the Academy's finest students. Study hard, and one day you'll be just as accomplished as Enzir, hoo!

name: 路易斯
text: 去吧，小同学，希望这次的前置学习能让你有所收获。
text_loc: Off you go. I hope this orientation gives you a solid start.

text: 直接投掷捕捉的命中率还不错……但和精灵对决时尝试捕捉的行为，还是有些冒进，下次可以等对面的精灵更虚弱些。
text_loc: Direct throws have a decent hit rate, but trying to catch a Jini mid-duel is a bit aggressive. Next time, wait until they're more worn down.

name: 努力的学生
text: 谢谢恩佐老师！我，我会再努力的！我这就去再尝试一下！
text_loc: Thanks, Enzir! I'll keep trying! Let me go give it another shot!

text: 这位学生斗志昂扬地冲向了沙滩边的野生精灵们。
text_loc: The student charges toward the wild Jini on the beach with infectious enthusiasm.

name: 恩佐
text: 经历过这么大的变故，这些新生们还挺有干劲的……不过，究竟是什么，让精灵迸发出那么强大的力量击沉洛克号……
text_loc: Even after everything that's happened, these new students still have plenty of fight in them... Still, what could have driven those Jini to release that much power and bring down the Roco...

name: 恩佐
text: 那些黑衣人，是什么来历？他们对那些精灵究竟做了什么……是因为那些精灵身上侵蚀涌动的紫黑色能量吗……
text_loc: Who were those hooded figures? What did they do to those Jini? Was it that dark violet energy corrupting them?

name: 恩佐
text: 这一切又和风灾有着怎样的联系？看来，还需要进一步调查……
text_loc: And what does any of this have to do with the hellacious winds? I need to find answers to these questions.

text: 恩佐老师，我来报到！
text_loc: Professor Enzir?

name: 恩佐
text: 嗯……你是？哦，你就是路易斯所说的那位——最后离开山脉的同学{name}吧？
text_loc: Hmm? Oh, you must be the one Louis mentioned, the last student to leave the mountains. {name}, was it?

name: 恩佐
text: 呵，不用叫我老师，我只是比你大一点，也是魔法学院的学生，本是为了收集样本数据而来，现在受路易斯老师委托暂任你们的助教，你可以叫我——恩佐。
text_loc: No need to call me professor. I'm only a few years older than you, and also a student at the Magic Academy. I came here to collect sample data, but Louis has asked me to step in as your teaching assistant for the time being. You can call me Enzir.

name: 恩佐
text: 听说你昏迷了很久。虽然治疗并非我的专长，但魔药学和基础医理有不少相通的地方。
text_loc: I heard you were unconscious for quite a while. Treatment isn't exactly my specialty, but potion studies and basic medical theory have a fair amount of overlap.

name: 恩佐
text: 若是你愿意，我可以为你简单检查一番，以免留下什么不易察觉的隐患。
text_loc: If you'd like, I can do a quick check, just to make sure nothing's been overlooked.

name: 恩佐
text: 嗯……你的魔力压正常，波动频率也在正常范围内……看起来没什么大问题，不用担心。
text_loc: Hm... your mana pressure is normal, and your frequency readings are within range. Nothing seems out of the ordinary. You should be fine.

name: 恩佐
text: 我看到你从路易斯老师那边过来，想必已经知道了「露天课堂」的事情。
text_loc: Since Louis sent you, I imagine you already know about the Outdoor Classroom?

text: 路易斯老师告诉我了
text_loc: Yes, Professor Louis told me.

text: 路易斯让我来找你
text_loc: Louis sent me to find you.

name: 恩佐
text: 我想路易斯让你来找我，也是考虑到了这点，希望你们新生能提前掌握野外探索的能力。
text_loc: I'd expect that's precisely why Louis sent you my way. Getting new students up to speed on field exploration before anything else.

name: 恩佐
text: 嗯……本是要在学院正式学习后才会发放的东西，「露天课堂」倒是给了你们一个提前接触的机会。
text_loc: Hm... normally this wouldn't come until after formal Academy classes, but the Outdoor Classroom gives you a chance to get acquainted with it early.

text: 什么东西？
text_loc: With what?

name: 恩佐
text: ——「高级咕噜球」！它是魔法学院研制的新型咕噜球。
text_loc: The Advanced Buddy Pod. It's a new type of Buddy Pod developed by the Magic Academy to be more effective than the standard model.

name: 恩佐
text: 目前仍处于配方调试的重要阶段，我们炼金分院仍在进行效力与稳定性的最终调校。
text_loc: It's currently in the critical phase of formula refinement. The School of Alchemy is still running final adjustments on its potency and stability.

name: 恩佐
text: 为了获取更全面的样本数据，目前魔法学院计划广泛发放这种咕噜球给学生们，以及一些热衷于野外冒险的魔法师们。
text_loc: To gather more comprehensive sample data, the Academy plans to distribute these to students and Roco mages who spend a lot of time in the field.

text: 你对风灾很有研究？
text_loc: Windstorm weighing on you?

text: 你很关心学生安全？
text_loc: You worry about students?

name: 恩佐
text: 哈哈，刚才我的自言自语被你听到了？确实，除了辅导新生以外，学院也命我在此研究这突然出现的风灾。
text_loc: Haha, you caught my muttering just now? Yes, aside from guiding new students, I've also been asked by the Academy to investigate this sudden disaster.

name: 恩佐
text: 但没想到，这次灾害规模如此之大，连你们这些新生也被……
text_loc: I didn't expect it be so large-scale, certainly not to the point where new students like yourself would be caught up in it.

name: 恩佐
text: 呼，看你这副着迷的样子，风灾，可不是那么轻松有趣的事情。
text_loc: From the look on your face, I can tell you're intrigued. This windstorm is no small matter, and certainly not something to take lightly.

name: 恩佐
text: 总之，风灾的议题暂且搁置，先履行路易斯给的助教委托，让我教教你如何使用「高级咕噜球」吧！
text_loc: Anyway, let's set that aside for now. Louis gave me a job to do, so let me teach you how to use the Advanced Buddy Pod.

name: 恩佐
text: 简单来说，「高级咕噜球」使用效果会略优于普通咕噜球。除了能在精灵对战中投掷，与精灵结成契约，也能在不进入战斗时使用。
text_loc: Simply put, the Advanced Buddy Pod is more effective than a Basic Buddy Pod. It can be used during a Jini duel to attempt a pact, but it can also be used in the wild without entering combat.

name: 恩佐
text: 遇到精灵，在未开始战斗时，趁其不备直接投掷出一颗，便有概率能和精灵完成契约的缔结。
text_loc: When you spot a Jini and haven't engaged yet, you can toss one and have a chance of forming a pact right then and there.

name: 恩佐
text: 不过，一部分洛克仍倾向于选择对决中使用。他们认为，在对决中让精灵进入弱化状态，能增加成功率。
text_loc: That said, some Rocos still prefer to battle first even with the Advanced Buddy Pod. They believe weakening a Jini in a duel improves their chances of success.

name: 恩佐
text: 两种方式，各有优劣。以后你也可以在其中选择更适合自己的。
text_loc: Both approaches have their merits. You'll find which one suits you better over time.

name: 恩佐
text: 但作为魔法学院的新生，好好学习使用它，是你当下的重点。
text_loc: For now, as a new Magic Academy student, getting comfortable with it is what matters most.

name: 恩佐
text: 这些高级咕噜球给你，去周围进行练习吧。
text_loc: Here are some Advanced Buddy Pods. Go practice around this area.

text: 我见过那些污染的精灵……
text_loc: I've seen those Jini...

name: 恩佐
text: 嗯……你是？哦，你就是路易斯所说的那位——最后离开山脉的同学{name}吧？
text_loc: Hmm? Oh, you must be the one Louis mentioned, the last student to leave the mountains. {name}, was it?

name: 恩佐
text: 呼，不用叫我老师，我只是比你大一点，也是魔法学院的学生，在这里兼任助教，你可以叫我——恩佐。
text_loc: No need for formalities. Louis may have asked me to step in as your teaching assistant, but I'm only a few years older than you. You can call me Enzir.

name: 恩佐
text: 听说你昏迷了很久。虽然治疗并非我的专长，但魔药学和基础医理有不少相通的地方。
text_loc: I heard you were unconscious for quite a while. Treatment isn't exactly my specialty, but potion studies and basic medical theory have a fair amount of overlap.

name: 恩佐
text: 若是你愿意，我可以为你简单检查一番，以免留下什么不易察觉的隐患。
text_loc: If you'd like, I can do a quick check, just to make sure nothing's been overlooked.

name: 恩佐
text: 嗯……你的魔力压正常，波动频率也在正常范围内……看起来没什么大问题，不用担心。
text_loc: Hm... your mana pressure is normal, and your frequency readings are within range. Nothing seems out of the ordinary. You should be fine.

name: 恩佐
text: 不过你刚刚说，你见过这种精灵？确定是被这种紫黑色能量侵蚀的精灵？
text_loc: But you just said you've seen these Jini before? You're certain they were corrupted by that dark violet energy?

name: 恩佐
text: |||<center>把自己与黑衣人手下紫黑色精灵交手时的情况，告诉了恩佐。</>|||<center>恩佐很感兴趣，不断追问，让我补充信息，时不时陷入了沉思。</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>You describe your encounter with the hooded figures' corrupted Jini to Enzir.</> |||<center>He listens intently, asking question after question, prompting you to fill in every detail, pausing now and then to think.</>|||

name: 恩佐
text: 这种能量，居然是能被控制和利用的？我起初以为更像是一种具有某种传染特性的疾病……
text_loc: That energy can actually be controlled and weaponized? I assumed it was something closer to a contagious disease...

name: 恩佐
text: 看来污染存在程度的递进……或许污染存在可逆性？那么污染的代价是什么，解除污染的代价又是什么……太多太多疑惑还没有答案。
text_loc: So there are degrees of corruption... and perhaps it's reversible? If so, what does it take to corrupt something, and what does reversing it cost... so many questions still unanswered.

text: 什么？
text_loc: Sorry?

text: 完全听不懂了……
text_loc: You lost me there.

name: 恩佐
text: 没什么，这些只是我个人的研究内容，{name}同学不用在意。
text_loc: Never mind. These are just my own thoughts pertaining to research. Nothing you need to worry about, {name}.

name: 恩佐
text: 回来了。我看到了你刚才的表现。做得不错！
text_loc: Welcome back. I watched you practicing just now. Well done.

name: 恩佐
text: 小同学，你果然很有天分。
text_loc: You really do have a gift for this.

text: 没有啦……
text_loc: You flatter me.

text: 一般一般~
text_loc: Oh, I'm nothing special, heh.

text: 嗯？怎么感觉星盘在晃动，似乎充满了某种能量？
text_loc: Huh? Why does my Stardial feel like it's trembling... It's almost pulsing with energy.

text: 我看看，新生提交的记录……十三份、十四份，十五份……嗯？又有小孩拿鸭吉吉充当地鼠……不合格！
text_loc: Let me see, records submitted by new students... thirteen, fourteen, fifteen... hm? Another one using a Duckiji for a Burroo... rejected!

text: 还有这只精灵，那些黑衣人留下的……
text_loc: And then there's this Jini, the one left behind by the hooded figures.

text: 奇怪……这种紫黑色能量，好像与它自身的草系能量混合到了一起，形成了一种奇异的血脉……
text_loc: Strange... this dark violet energy seems to have blended with its own Grass-Type energy, producing a peculiar kind of Bloodline.

text: 是某种巧合下形成的变异血脉，还是这种紫黑色能量本身就是一种系别之力……
text_loc: Is this a mutation that formed by chance, or is this dark violet energy a type-based power in its own right...

text: 无论如何，这都是一个非常值得研究的精灵系课题，我需要更多的案例……看来要麻烦新同学了。
text_loc: Either way, this is an incredibly fascinating research topic in Jini studies. I need more cases to work with... looks like I'll have to trouble a new student.

text: 打扰了——
text_loc: Excuse me...

name: 易西
text: 唔，是没见过的新同学。你好，小魔法师，我的名字叫易西，本身是学院的一名学生，在此兼任助教一职。
text_loc: Oh, an unfamiliar face. Hello there, young mage. My name is Yessi. I'm a student at the Academy, currently filling in as a teaching assistant here.

name: 易西
text: 我的职责，主要是帮助你们学会如何在野外生存和冒险！
text_loc: My primary responsibility is to help you learn how to survive and explore out in the wild.

name: 易西
text: 想必你也多少从路易斯老师那里得知了风卷的事情……「露天课堂」，虽说是迫不得已，却也未尝不是个提升自己的好机会。
text_loc: I'm sure Louis has filled you in on the situation with the winds by now. The Outdoor Classroom may not have been the plan, but it's a real chance to grow.

name: 易西
text: 提升自己……对哦！小同学，来得正好！有没有兴趣和这只丢丢缔结契约呀？
text_loc: Grow stronger... right! And actually, your timing is perfect! How would you like to form a pact with this little Ribbitto here?

text: 诶？这么突然？！
text_loc: Wait, just like that?

name: 易西
text: 这只小家伙因为被黑衣人抓去受了不少苦，身上这些紫黑色能量，唉……
text_loc: This fella went through a lot at the hands of those hooded figures. Having all that dark violet energy on it must have been rough.

name: 易西
text: 学姐也想拜托你，收集更多紫黑色能量与变异血脉的课题研究素材——
text_loc: I also wanted to ask a favor. Could you help me gather more research samples on the dark violet energy and mutated Bloodlines?

text: 原来是抓我做苦力！
text_loc: So it's an assistant you want!

name: 易西
text: 所以，这只小家伙就托付给你了！
text_loc: That settles it! This Jini is officially in your hands now!

name: 易西
text: 小同学不用担心，本学姐刚刚已经检查过这只丢丢了，这种紫黑色的能量没有影响它的理智。
text_loc: Don't worry. I already checked it over. The dark violet energy hasn't affected its mind.

name: 易西
text: 一般而言，只要精灵的理智尚存，便有缔结契约的可能性。
text_loc: Generally speaking, as long as a Jini's mind is intact, forming a pact is still possible.

name: 易西
text: 为了感谢你的仗义相助，咕噜球就让本学姐为你提供吧！
text_loc: To thank you for your help, the Buddy Pods are on me.

text: 眼前这只丢丢，虽然浑身都是那紫黑色的可怕能量，但眼神并不似黑衣人手下精灵那样，没有残暴、癫狂和痛苦……
text_loc: This Ribbitto is covered in that dark violet energy, but its eyes are nothing like the ones under those hooded figures' control. No rage, no frenzy, no pain.

text: 丢丢被成功收进了咕噜球中。
text_loc: Ribbitto has been successfully caught in a Buddy Pod.

name: 易西
text: 观察这只小家伙的事情，学姐就拜托你啦！
text_loc: From here on, I'm counting on you to keep an eye on this little fella!

name: 易西
text: 这种奇异的血脉似乎会带来一些不可思议的能力，希望它在未来的旅途中能帮到你。
text_loc: This strange Bloodline seems to bring some remarkable abilities along with it. Hopefully it'll come in handy on your journey.

name: 易西
text: 本学姐已经能想象出日后你与它的精彩冒险了——
text_loc: I can already picture the adventures you two have in store.

name: 易西
text: 不过，在大展拳脚之前，本学姐得教你一点常识……当当当——看，我们眼前的这棵「魔力之源」！
text_loc: But before any of that, there's something basic I need to teach you... ta-da! Take a look at this Manabough!
Manabough?

text: 这个怪怪的木头......
text_loc: This weird branch?

name: 易西
text: 可不要小看它哦！像这样的小小枝桠，不仅滋养着我们脚下的整片大地，更是众多精灵的栖息之所。
text_loc: Don't underestimate it! These little branches nourish the land beneath our feet and serve as home to countless Jini.

name: 易西
text: 而且，魔力之源作为连通整座大陆的命脉，散布各地，像是一个个避风港，为咱们的冒险保驾护航。
text_loc: They're the lifeblood that connects the whole continent, and are scattered all across the world, like safe harbors that watch over our adventures.

name: 易西
text: 这便是魔力之源的功效，使地形、道路显隐。对魔法师来说，「魔力之源」便是灯塔，让我们免于危险。
text_loc: Such is the power of the Manabough. It shapes what terrain and paths are visible. For a mage, a Manabough is a vanguard that keeps danger at bay.

name: 易西
text: 此外，「魔力之源」还有几个非常重要的作用！
text_loc: There's also a couple more important things a Manabough can do.

name: 易西
text: 咳咳，认真听哦，这正是本学姐要教给你的第二个知识点！
text_loc: Pay attention now, for this is the second thing I need to teach you.

name: 易西
text: 在魔力之源处，我们可以恢复状态，还可以与噜噜先生一起回顾自己的精灵捕捉经历。
text_loc: At a Manabough, you can restore your health and look back on your Jini-catching journey together with Mr. Coolu.

name: 易西
text: 回顾时，噜噜先生会综合考察精灵的外观稀有度、天分好坏以及所获得的特殊奖牌等多重因素，为你刚刚订立契约的伙伴做出评价。
text_loc: During the review, Mr. Coolu will evaluate your new companions based on a combination of factors, including the Jini's visual rarity, talent quality, and any special medals earned.

name: 易西
text: 外观越别致、天分越好，噜噜先生给到的奖励也就越好！
text_loc: The more striking the appearance and the better the talent, the better the rewards Mr. Coolu will give!

name: 易西
text: 一旦综合评价达到一定水平，你的精灵就能被评为「稀有精灵」！
text_loc: Once your overall score reaches a certain level, your Jini will be recognized as a Rare Jini!

name: 易西
text: 怎么样，试试朝着面前这棵「魔力之源」投掷精灵来激活它，然后让噜噜先生对你捕捉到的精灵进行回顾吧！
text_loc: Go ahead and give it a try! Toss a Jini at the Manabough in front of you to activate it, then have Mr. Coolu review the Jini you've caught.

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌信使
text: {SubmitPetReport}
text_loc: {Jini Catch Report}

text: 回顾
text_loc: Review.

name: 噜噜
text: {CampPetReport}
text_loc: {Jini Submission}

text: 下次吧
text_loc: Maybe next time.

name: 易西
text: 你做得很棒！学姐目前能教你的，都教你啦！
text_loc: Great work! That covers everything I can teach you for now.

name: 易西
text: 也许以后在冒险的路上我们还能再见面。以你的天资，假以时日，一定能成为像传说中麦蛰伦、鸽伦布一样厉害的洛克！
text_loc: Maybe we'll cross paths again out on the road. With your talent, I have no doubt you'll grow into a legendary Roco, just like the great Mage-llan and Coo-lumbus of old!

name: 菲尔特
text: 可丽希亚！不要再打了！咱们说是要教新生们实战，但局面是不是有点……难以收拾？！
text_loc: Krithya! Stop fighting! I know we said we're here to teach new students through real combat, but this is getting a little out of hand!

name: 菲尔特
text: 咱们打遍新生无敌手了！这样下去，要是让学院知道了……
text_loc: We've gone undefeated against every new student here! If the Academy finds out...

name: 可丽希亚
text: 什么公主，叫我「可丽希亚老师」！再说，本老师只是教学风格较为严厉而已……
text_loc: I'm not a princess right now! I'm to be called "Professor Krithya!" Anyway, I simply have a more rigorous teaching style.

name: 菲尔特
text: 你见人就这样说，到时候大家真的以为你是老师了。咦！你是……
text_loc: If you keep saying that to everyone, people are actually going to think you're a real professor. Oh! You're...

name: 可丽希亚
text: 菲尔特，你在那里挤眉弄眼做什么？哦！难道是来了新的练手的？！咳咳——新的受教同学？
text_loc: Furtis, why are you making that face? Oh! Is that a new sparring partn... Ahem, I mean, a new student?

text: （看来跑不掉了）
text_loc: (There's no escaping this.)

text: （啊？可丽希亚怎么是老师？）
text_loc: (Wait, Krithya is a professor?)

name: 可丽希亚
text: 可丽希亚小课堂的新生！来老师这里！哦吼吼，真是冤家路窄！是你呀。
text_loc: You! The new student for Krithya's Academia! Come here! Oh ho ho, what a small world! It's you.

name: 菲尔特
text: 唉，就让可丽希亚过过当老师的瘾吧，只是可怜了眼前的同学。
text_loc: Ugh, just let Krithya have her moment. You're the one I feel sorry for.

name: 可丽希亚
text: 哼，别管本公主之前是什么身份，现在就是负责教导「精灵对决」的老师！你那不服气的眼神怎么回事？嗯？
text_loc: Hmph, pay no mind to who I was before. Right now I am your instructor for Jini Duels! What's with that look? Hmm?

name: 可丽希亚
text: 是觉得本公主没资格教你吗？！哼哼，不就是理论知识嘛。
text_loc: You think I'm not qualified to teach you? Hmph, anyone can teach theory.

name: 可丽希亚
text: 「精灵对决」，也叫「魔法师对决」，顾名思义，便是魔法师和魔法师之间，用精灵一决胜负！
text_loc: A Jini Duel, also called a Mage Duel, is exactly what it sounds like: mage versus mage, settled through their Jini!

text: 好的！记笔记！
text_loc: Got it. Taking notes!

name: 可丽希亚
text: 谁的魔力先归零，谁就输！学会了吗？
text_loc: Whoever runs out of mana first, loses. Got that?

text: 好的……记笔记！
text_loc: Got it! Putting it all up here.

name: 可丽希亚
text: 要论怎么变强，本公……本老师的建议是……呃，先掌握系别克制再说！至于系别克制是什么……多打你就会了！
text_loc: As for how to get stronger, my recommendation is to start by mastering how the varying types relate to each other, which is something you'll figure out through practice.

text: 好的……记笔记……
text_loc: Okay, got it...

name: 菲尔特
text: 可丽希亚老师的意思是——呃，在实战中学习和运用精灵对战的理论知识？
text_loc: Professor Krithya, do you mean that learning and applying battle theory it best done through actual combat?

name: 可丽希亚
text: 咳咳，没错，本老师就是这个意思。
text_loc: Ahem, yes. Precisely.

name: 菲尔特
text: 可丽希亚老师，要不要在对决前，多解释几句？这样会比较像……老师……
text_loc: Perhaps you could go into some more detail before the duel? It might make you seem more like a professor...

name: 可丽希亚
text: 哼，那我的话，你可要听好啦！
text_loc: Hmph, then listen up!

text: （欣喜）好的，可丽老师！
text_loc: (Excited) Got it, Professor!

text: （狐疑）好的，可丽……老师
text_loc: (Skeptical) Okay, Professor...

name: 可丽希亚
text: 气势不错，既然来到了可丽希亚小课堂，那么我就有义务好好引导你走上对决之路……！
text_loc: Good attitude. Since you've walked into Krithya's Academia, I have a responsibility to how you the way of dueling.

name: 可丽希亚
text: 精灵有十八种元素系别，系别之间又各自存在克制和抵抗的关系。
text_loc: Jini come in eighteen elemental types, and each type has its own strengths and weaknesses against the others.

name: 可丽希亚
text: 在对决中，要随时注意克制关系，尽量使用克制对方的技能。
text_loc: During a duel, always keep these relationships in mind and try to use skills that your opponent is weak against.

name: 可丽希亚
text: 如果场上的精灵没有携带克制对方的技能呢，就要及时换上克制对方的精灵。
text_loc: If the Jini you have out doesn't have a move that your opponent is weak against, switch to one that does.

name: 菲尔特
text: 另外，如果不得不面对克制自己的对手时，使用「防御」也能大幅降低受到的伤害，并抢占先机。
text_loc: And if you're up against a type that has the upper hand on you, using Defend can cut the damage you take significantly and help you seize the initiative.

name: 可丽希亚
text: 哎呀，说这么多，不如实战一下！
text_loc: Anyway, enough talk. Let's get into it!

text: 啊？还要打啊
text_loc: Another one?

name: 菲尔特
text: 唉，同学，看来你是逃不掉了……祝你好运！
text_loc: Well, looks like there's no getting out of this one for you...

name: 可丽希亚
text: 准备好了吗？放心，本老师会注意教学为主，嘿嘿，不会让你输得太难看！
text_loc: Ready? Get ready, because class is now in session!

text: 来就来！
text_loc: Bring it on!

name: 可丽希亚
text: 咦，居然这么快就掌握了？！看来飞艇之后，你也有了不少的进步，我暂且认可你了！
text_loc: You picked that up already? You've come a long way since the airship. I'll give you that much.

name: 可丽希亚
text: 看你已经使用过「高级咕噜球」了？哼哼，既然你是我的学生，那我就爽快地教你一个……搞到这东西的好办法！
text_loc: You've already used an Advanced Buddy Pod? Well, since you're my student, I'll be generous and share a great way to get more of them!

name: 可丽希亚
text: 一般来说，「高级咕噜球」是魔法学院发放给学生和魔法师们使用的制式咕噜球，这你应该已经知道了。
text_loc: Generally, the Advanced Buddy Pod is the standard-issue Buddy Pod distributed to students and mages by the Magic Academy. You probably already know that.

name: 可丽希亚
text: 但我们在外冒险时，时常会遇到一些号称正在进行「露天对战」的洛克魔法师。
text_loc: But out in the field, you'll often run into Roco mages who host what they call Outdoor Duels.

text: 「露天对战」？
text_loc: Outdoor Duels?

name: 菲尔特
text: 是啊……「露天对战」是什么？
text_loc: What does that mean?

name: 可丽希亚
text: 用通俗点的话说——外出的学生可以随意向路过的魔法师发起挑战！
text_loc: Put simply, any student out in the field can challenge a passing mage to a duel whenever they want.

name: 可丽希亚
text: 作为学生多少经验会有不足，就算会输也不用害怕！切磋，进步！才是露天对战的要义！
text_loc: Students are bound to have less experience, and losing is nothing to be afraid of. The whole point of Outdoor Duels is to learn and improve through sparring.

name: 可丽希亚
text: 如果已经开启了地图，途中遇见的「露天对战」对手都会在地图上标注出来。实在打不过的话，等提升实力之后再去切磋也不迟。
text_loc: Once you've opened the map, any Outdoor Duel opponents nearby will be marked on it. If someone's too tough for you at the moment, just come back once you've leveled up.

name: 菲尔特
text: 那这和学院发的「高级咕噜球」有什么关系呀？
text_loc: But what does any of that have to do with the Advanced Buddy Pods the Academy gives out?

name: 可丽希亚
text: 为了吸引更多洛克来与他们对决，每个「露天对战」的魔法师们其实都会准备不少「高级咕噜球」，作为奖励送给打败他们的洛克。
text_loc: To draw in more challengers, Outdoor Duel mages always stock up on Advanced Buddy Pods to give out as prizes to anyone who beats them.

name: 可丽希亚
text: 所以，只要够厉害，便可以从那些「露天对战」的魔法师手上赢得更多的「高级咕噜球」。
text_loc: So if you're good enough, you'll never run out of Buddy Pods, heh heh!

name: 菲尔特
text: 那……刚刚{name}赢了，可丽希亚你是不是也要拿出「高级咕噜球」作为奖励呢？
text_loc: In that case... {name} just won, so shouldn't you hand over some Advanced Buddy Pods as the prize?

name: 可丽希亚
text: ……咳咳，不就是「高级咕噜球」嘛！本老师手里多着呢！
text_loc: Ahem, Advanced Buddy Pods? I've got plenty!

name: 可丽希亚
text: 作为勉强被我看得上眼的奖励，这些「高级咕噜球」就送给你了！
text_loc: Consider it a reward from me, since I've deemed you worthy... albeit barely!

name: 菲尔特
text: 可丽希亚比上次要有耐心了很多！进步很大！简直是闪闪发光！
text_loc: You're much more patient than you were before, Krithya! A major improvement!

name: 可丽希亚
text: 哼哼，小意思啦~ ……咳咳，那么，应该没什么其他事情了，你可以回去了。……等等……你可不能跟路易斯老师提到我，说我是老师的事情！……这是……这是秘密身份！！
text_loc: Hmph, it was nothing... ahem, well then, I think we're all done here. You're free to go. Actually, wait. Under no circumstance can you tell Professor Louis about me. About me being a professor and all that. It's a... it's my secret identity!

name: 菲尔特
text: 啊，那个，可丽希亚的意思是，她在这里教同学们对决是正常的课程安排，就不用特地跟路易斯老师讲了……
text_loc: Um, what Krithya means is, there's nothing strange about her teaching here, so there's no particular need to bring it up with Professor Louis.

name: 菲尔特
text: 是刚刚可丽希亚讲的内容有哪里没理解吗？要不要再来一局？
text_loc: Was there anything from Krithya's lesson that wasn't clear? Want to go another round?

name: 可丽希亚
text: 怎么，怎么回事！难道是我教错……咳咳！不可能，一定是你在开小差！
text_loc: Wait, what?! Did I teach it wrong... ahem! Impossible. You must have been zoning out.

name: 可丽希亚
text: 本老师……唉！本公主直接地告诉你，作为我看中的对手，不可以输在这里，给我鼓起斗志再来一次！
text_loc: As your professor... I mean, as the Princess, let me give it to you straight. I've chosen you, and I will not allow you to lose here. Now pull yourself together and go again!

text: |||<center>在可丽希亚的鼓舞下，我重新振作起来。</>|||<center>再来一局吧！这一次，尽全力去学习那些战斗技巧吧！</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>With Krithya's encouragement, you find your footing again.</> |||<center>One more round. This time, give it everything you've got and really learn those battle skills!</>|||

text: 我看可以之后再来……
text_loc: Maybe I'll come back later.

name: 可丽希亚
text: 什么嘛，还没准备好吗？算了算了，本公主很有耐心，暂且等等你吧！
text_loc: What, not ready yet? Fine, I'll wait a little longer.

text: 咦？什么声音？好像是驻地入口那边传来的……
text_loc: Hmm? What's that sound? Seems like it's coming from the outpost entrance.

text: 先过去看看吧，晚点再去找路易斯老师。
text_loc: Let's go check it out. I'll find Professor Louis afterward.

text: 到底发生了什么事？……
text_loc: What in the world is going on?

text: 你获得了神奇的「星星魔法」。使用星星魔法向野生的精灵投掷，能够击晕它们。在被击晕状态下的精灵，被成功捕捉的概率也会更高
text_loc: You've learnt the mystical "Starry Magic," which can be used to stun Jini. Stunned Jini are easier to catch.

text: 在野外，你还会遇到一些强大的首领级精灵，在与它们的战斗中，也需要先用星星魔法破除其魔法防御。
text_loc: Out in the wild, you'll also encounter powerful Elite Jini. In those battles, you'll first need to break through their magical defenses with Starry Magic.

text: |||<center>一场战斗后，暴走的巨兽似乎终于平静了一点…… </>
text_loc: |||<center>After the battle, the rampaging beast seems to have finally calmed down a little.</>

text: 咳咳……刚才我的帅气登场，出了一些小小差错，无伤大雅，无伤大雅。
text_loc: Ahem... my grand entrance had a few minor hiccups. Nothing to worry about. Everything's fine.

text: 不过，小同学，虽然你很勇敢，但以后可不要随意招惹发狂的精灵了哦！
text_loc: But listen, while I admire your bravery, please don't go picking fights with rampaging Jini on your own.

text: 你是……？
text_loc: Who are you?

name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 啊？你，你，你，不是本地人吧？连伊里斯我——都不知道？！
text_loc: Hm? You... you're not from around here, are you? How could anyone not know of me, the magnificent Irys?

text: 大魔法师伊里斯？！
text_loc: The Archmage Irys?

name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 嗯哼，所谓「大魔法师」……不过是帅气的伊里斯我，在俗世的小小称号罢了，无需介怀。
text_loc: Oh, that... that is merely a title the common folk have given me, the dashing Irys. A yoke thrown upon my mighty neck. Think nothing of it.

name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 比起头衔，我更希望你能充分赞美我的实力——给，这是最新的一期，不客气。
text_loc: Titles are but a trifle. I'd much prefer you shower my true prowess with the praise it deserves. Here—the latest issue. You're most welcome.

text: 这是什么……
text_loc: What is this?

text: 花花绿绿的一本杂志！呜哇——伊里斯的大头被刊登在封面上！非常……具备冲击力的美学……
text_loc: Oh, what a bright, colorful magazine! Whoa, there's your face right there on the cover! That's quite the... striking aesthetic.

text: 话说回来，这是什么……？杂志……？《本地人知道》？？
text_loc: Wait, what even is this? Those in the Know?

name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 哈哈，这本杂志中的专访，也只是……对我「学富八车」的——小小侧写罢了。
text_loc: Haha! The interview contained within those pages is but a single droplet from the fondue of knowledge that flows through this magnificent mind of mine!

text: 是学富五车吧……
text_loc: Do you mean "fount?"

name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 话说回来，刚才你使的那几招，有模有样的嘛……
text_loc: That said, those moves you pulled just now weren't bad. Not bad at all.

name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 看起来，我可以指点你一下！不知道你……是否感兴趣？
text_loc: I think I could show you a thing or two! Would you be interested?

text: 指点我？
text_loc: Sure, show me.

name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 嘘，人多眼杂，这里不是说话的地方。
text_loc: Shh, too many eyes around here. This is not the place to talk.

name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: ——来驻地最高点！
text_loc: Meet me at the highest point of the outpost.

text: 伊里斯？是谁？
text_loc: Irys? Who's that?

name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 哈哈哈，你在我的房子里躺了这么久，居然连我这位……大魔法师都不知道？！
text_loc: Ha! You spent all that time resting in my abode and you don't even know who I am? The great Archmage?

name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 比起头衔，我更希望你能充分赞美我的实力——给，这是最新的一期，不客气。
text_loc: Titles are but a trifle. I'd much prefer you shower my true prowess with the praise it deserves. Here—the latest issue. You're most welcome.
