task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
name: 伊里斯
text: 「聆风镇蜜蜂蜇人」，「月牙镇水怪出没」……唉，全都是风灾引起的精灵发狂事件。
text_loc: "Windrun Bees Stinging Locals," "Monatun Lake Monster Spotted"... the Jini are going wild because of this windstorm.

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
name: 伊里斯
text: 我必须做得更多，让一切……回到正轨……
text_loc: I must do more. I have to get things back on track.

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
text: 伊里斯，我来了！
text_loc: Irys, I'm here!

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
name: 伊里斯
text: 哟吼~！吓我一跳，小同学，是你呀，咦，路易斯也来了？
text_loc: Oh ho! You startled me there. Oh, and Louis is with you?

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
name: 路易斯
text: 伊里斯，风灾的影响，还在扩大。
text_loc: Irys, the winds are spreading.

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
name: 伊里斯
text: 是，精灵发狂的现象愈发泛滥，刚才挑衅你的那只大块头，就是例子……
text_loc: Yes, the Jini frenzy is spreading like wildfire. That big brute who came at you earlier is proof of that.

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
text: 感觉突然变得狂暴了
text_loc: It just snapped.

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
name: 伊里斯
text: 我认识那孩子……咳咳，那只精灵，它的本性不是这样的，你不要怪它。
text_loc: I know that fello... ahem, that Jini. That is not its true nature. Please don't hold it against the poor creature.

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
text: 没事，我知道精灵本性善良
text_loc: Yeah, they're naturally kind.

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
text: 没事，我教训了它一顿也扯平了
text_loc: All the same, I set it straight.

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
name: 路易斯
text: 伊里斯，你叫这位小同学来，是为了什么？只是闲聊，可不符合你的性格啊。
text_loc: Irys, why did you call this student here? Just for a chat? That doesn't sound like you.

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
name: 伊里斯
text: 我和小同学约好了，我要负责指导{gender:他,她}，可……越来越多的「精灵狂暴事件」需要处理……
text_loc: I made a promise to guide {gender:him,her}, but these incidents concerning frenzied Jini keep piling up like an avalanche of headaches I cannot outrun.

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
name: 路易斯
text: 什么？！你……？指导这孩子？！大魔法师伊里斯，竟愿意——指导新生？
text_loc: Wait... you wish to instruct this child? The great Archmage Irys, willing to take new student under his wing?

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
name: 路易斯
text: 既然是伊里斯大魔法师的话，那我也能放下一百个心了……珍惜这段际遇吧，小同学！
text_loc: Well, if it's Archmage Irys, I couldn't ask for anyone better. Treasure this opportunity, my friend!

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
name: 伊里斯
text: 这名小同学虽然是个小小愣头青，但是……很勇敢，符合我的品味！
text_loc: This student may be a bit of a loose cannon, but {gender:he,she}'s brave, and bravery, my friend, is the one ingredient I never turn down.

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
name: 路易斯
text: 对了，差点忘了要给你手册了。
text_loc: Oh, I nearly forgot. I still need to give you that handbook.

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
name: 路易斯
text: 小同学，想必你已经见过「露天课堂」的老师和助教同学们了吧？感觉如何？
text_loc: I imagine you've met the Outdoor Classroom instructors and teaching assistants by now? How did it go?

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
从这里走向世界与未来
name: 路易斯
text: 嗯，不错，看来小同学在「露天课堂」还是收获不少啊。
text_loc: Good, sounds like the Outdoor Classroom has been worthwhile.

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
name: 路易斯
text: 飞艇坠毁之后，幸好有他们在，分担了不少教学工作，我才能抽出手来处理风灾……
text_loc: Thank goodness for everyone chipping in after the airship disaster. They took a lot off my plate so I could focus on the winds.

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
name: 路易斯
text: 不多说了，给你这本《魔法师手册》，请收好！
text_loc: Anyway, here's your Mage's Handbook. Keep it safe.

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
name: 路易斯
text: 这是一本随身携带的魔法书，罗列了待完成的课题，也是学生的必修。
text_loc: It's a portable spellbook that lists all the coursework to be completed. It's required reading for every student.

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
name: 路易斯
text: 但有伊里斯全权负责你的话，手册的内容估计也不重要了……哈哈，这家伙的性格，我还是略知一二的！
text_loc: Though now with Irys in the picture, what's in the handbook might end up being the least of your concerns... ha, I know this man well enough to say that!

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
name: 路易斯
text: 我也不多留了，我还需要再完善一下驻地的安全措施……风灾后，可真是忙得停不下来啊。
text_loc: I shouldn't stay long. I still need to tighten up the outpost's security measures. It's been nonstop since the winds started.

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
text: |||<center>路易斯老师叹着气离开了。</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>Professor Louis sighs and takes his leave.</>|||

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
name: 伊里斯
text: 《魔法师手册》，是学院发给新生的新式作业？怎么，里面还有迪兰老师的超级长篇历史课吗？
text_loc: Mage's Handbook... Is this the Academy's fresh take on homework for new students? Please tell me it doesn't have any of Professor Dilian's marathon history lectures in it.

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
text: 因为「露天课堂」
text_loc: That's why Outdoor Classroom...

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
text: 暂时还回不了学校上课
text_loc: We can't get back to school yet.

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
name: 伊里斯
text: 对噢，是我忘了。这露天课堂的想法倒是不错。
text_loc: Right, I completely forgot. The Outdoor Classroom idea is actually inspired.

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
name: 伊里斯
text: 哼哼，本来就该在实践中学习嘛，不经过冒险探索，不开动脑筋研究怎么解决实际问题，怎么当一个大魔法师？
text_loc: Hmph! Learning through doing—as it should be! You cannot become an Archmage by sitting in a chair reading a book. You must leap into the unknown, wrestle with real problems, and emerge victorious!

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
name: 伊里斯
text: 呃……不过……即使是大魔法师，问题多了，也有些头疼啊——
text_loc: Hm... though I must admit, even for a great Archmage, when problems multiply like rabbits, headache inevitably follow.

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
name: 伊里斯
text: 好了，小同学，我也不耽误你的学习了，去完成你的手册作业吧！
text_loc: Anyway, I won't hold you up. Go take care of your handbook assignments.

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
text: 啊？怎么话里有话……
text_loc: Hm... sounds fishy.

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
text: 感觉浑身毛毛的……
text_loc: Got a bad feeling...

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
name: 伊里斯
text: 没事，之前说好指导你，这件事，我似乎有了点新的想法，嘿！
text_loc: Oh, it's nothing. I promised to guide you, and I believe the form promise will assume has just become a great deal more interesting. Ha!

task_name: 从这里走向世界与未来
从这里走向世界与未来
text: |||<center>还没等我反应过来，伊里斯便离开了……</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>Before I could even respond, Irys was already gone.</>|||

name: 路易斯
title: 学院导师
text: 回收了满满当当的作业！看来，哪怕是风灾威胁之下，露天课堂也有了成效。就是，这质量嘛……
text_loc: A full haul of completed assignments. Even with the winds looming, the Outdoor Classroom is paying off. The quality of the assignments, on the other hand...

name: 路易斯
title: 学院导师
text: 算了，这群孩子愿意和我一起，帮商店街居民们恢复生活。无论作业如何，他们的实际行动都值得表扬。
text_loc: Well, what's important is that these kids are willing to pitch in and help the Merchant Town residents get back on their feet. Whatever's in the assignments, their actions speak for themselves.

text: 老师，我作业做完了
text_loc: I'm all finished, Professor.

name: 路易斯
title: 学院导师
text: 哦？来，给我看看。
text_loc: Let me take a look.

name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>路易斯老师仔细地审阅了我的作业。</>|||<center>虽然认认真真做了，但当面被阅卷，还是有点小忐忑。</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>Professor Louis carefully looks over my assignment.</> |||<center>I did my best, but having someone grade it right in front of me is a little nerve-wracking.</>|||

name: 路易斯
title: 学院导师
text: 这……这是什么……
text_loc: This... this is...

text: 我哪里做错了吗？
text_loc: Is it wrong?

text: 我完成度不高嘛？
text_loc: Is it sloppy?

name: 路易斯
title: 学院导师
text_loc: Well...

name: 路易斯
title: 学院导师
text: 我对作业的完成度，要求可是非常严格的……
text_loc: I have extremely high standards when it comes to assignments.

name: 路易斯
title: 学院导师
text: 但也很难不给你满分……第一章的作业……非常完美！！！
text_loc: However, it's very hard not to give you full marks. The assignment for Chapter One... is absolutely perfect!

text: 喂喂，老师——路易斯老师——
text_loc: Hey, Professor Louis...

name: 路易斯
title: 学院导师
text: 哈哈，我等下要去商店街，再看看风灾的情况，所以短时间内可能不在驻地。既然你做得又快又好——
text_loc: I'm heading to Merchant Town shortly to check on the wind situation, so I may not be at the outpost for a while. Since you finished so quickly and did so well...

name: 路易斯
title: 学院导师
text: 嘿嘿，事不宜迟，现在就给你布置第二章的作业吧！
text_loc: There's no time like the present. Let me go ahead and assign you Chapter Two right now!

text: 啊？！不要啊！
text_loc: What? No, please!

text: 不是吧，我该哭还是笑……
text_loc: Should I be happy, or sad?

text: 作业作业，我最喜欢写作业了
text_loc: I love assignments!

text: 只能说，感受到了路易斯老师的超级热情，和作业的……无穷无尽。
text_loc: All I can say is, I felt the full force of Professor Louis's enthusiasm, along with the full force of homework...

name: 路易斯
text: 啊，是你，来交作业了吗？正好有事情找你……但没关系，先让我看看你的作业。
text_loc: Oh, it's you. Here to turn in your assignment? Good timing, I actually needed to speak with you. But before that, let me see the assignment first.

name: 路易斯
text: 嗯——课题，一项、两项、三项……记录非常详细！干得不错！
text_loc: Hmm. Topics covered: one, two, three... very detailed. Well done!

name: 路易斯
text: 小同学，你表现得非常优秀，看来我也能放心了……
text_loc: You've performed exceptionally well. I can rest a little easier now.

name: 路易斯
text: 伊里斯在塔顶等你，应该是之前说要辅导你的那件事。
text_loc: Now, here's the thing. Irys is waiting for you at the top of the tower. I believe it's time for him to make good on his promise.

name: 路易斯
text: 对了，作为魔法学院的学生，时不时也会接到一些更具有挑战性更有趣的「课外作业」，记得关注。
text_loc: Oh, and as a Magic Academy student, you'll occasionally receive more challenging and interesting "extra credit assignments." Keep an eye out for those.

name: 伊里斯
text: 小同学，你来了呀！
text_loc: There you are!

name: 伊里斯
text: 听路易斯说，你在「露天课堂」表现非常不错？
text_loc: Louis tells me you did remarkably well in the Outdoor Classroom?

name: 伊里斯
text: 看来，你确实很有潜力……
text_loc: It seems you really are a diamond in the rough.

text: 诶诶？
text_loc: Huh?

name: 伊里斯
text: 如你所知，各地出现了许多莫名的「精灵狂暴事件」。
text_loc: As you know, unexplained incidents involving frenzied Jini have been erupting all over the place.

name: 伊里斯
text: 虽然我一直在调查，但一直不敢直接介入处理……
text_loc: I've been investigating, but stepping in directly... is a step I've been reluctant to take.

name: 伊里斯
text: 我身份特殊，独自行动恐怕不妥，毕竟……
text_loc: My position is complicated. Acting alone could stir up more trouble than it solves, because...

text: 你有什么顾虑吗？
text_loc: Because?

name: 伊里斯
text: 一个大魔法师，突然出现在村子里，肯定会……
text_loc: When an Archmage suddenly materializes in a village, it's bound to...

text: 会引发骚乱吧
text_loc: Cause a panic?

text: 会让居民恐慌吧
text_loc: Frighten the locals?

name: 伊里斯
text: 呼……你很聪明，当大魔法师出现在附近的村镇，居民们也许会认为事情的严重程度超乎了想象，难免会出现不必要的恐慌……
text_loc: Hm... you're sharp. When an Archmage appears near a town or village, people might assume things are far worse than they are, and unnecessary panic tends to follow.

name: 伊里斯
text: 所以我想到，或许可以让一个看上去平平无奇的洛克，在明面上代替我行动，而我，则在暗中支援……嗯！简直是完美的配合！
text_loc: So here is my brilliant stroke of genius: a perfectly ordinary-looking Roco acts as my "face", while I, the magnificent Irys operates from the shadows. A flawless partnership, if I do say so myself!

text: 听上去会很好玩
text_loc: Sounds fun.

text: 什么叫平平无奇
text_loc: "Ordinary-looking?"

name: 伊里斯
text: 嘿嘿！总之，自上次遇见你，我就感觉你有着某种令我安心的品质。
text_loc: Heh! Ever since our paths first crossed, I've had a feeling about you. You have a certain quality, like a perfectly tuned string, that puts me at ease.

name: 伊里斯
text: 而且，上次制服那只大块头时，你使用的魔法……让我印象深刻。
text_loc: And that magic you used to bring down that big brute—it left quite the impression on me.

name: 伊里斯
text: 说实话，我也很久没有见过那样的魔法了。
text_loc: Truthfully, I haven't seen magic like that in many a moon.

name: 伊里斯
text: 虽然很微弱，但那魔法迸发的光芒……让我很感动。
text_loc: Faint as it was, the light that poured from it moved even my ordinarily unshakeable heart.

name: 伊里斯
text: ——嗯……我有一种奇怪的感觉，也许会和你很合得来！呵呵，罢了！那就让我们一起去解决，山下的「精灵狂暴事件」吧！
text_loc: I have the strangest feeling we are going to get along like a board on fire. Ha! Very well, let's head down and deal with this Jini situation together!

text: 那我学校的作业……
text_loc: But my assignments...

name: 伊里斯
text: 哈哈，那么简单的小朋友作业，没意思！接下来，你就跟着伊里斯我一起，做风眠省定制版的本地人作业吧！
text_loc: Ha, please! From here on, you'll be running alongside the great Irys on a grand field assignment: Windrest Province edition! And custom-crafted at that! Much more exciting than those dreadfully dull little assignments!

text: 什么本地人作业……这个伊里斯老师，果然是个怪洛克吧！但总感觉，也是个很有意思的洛克。
text_loc: A "grand field assignment"... this Irys is quite the unusual Roco. But inexplicably interesting as well.

text: 和这家伙一起，未来的冒险，会很刺激吧？
text_loc: Going on adventures with this guy... is going to be something.

name: 逃跑的精灵
text: 伊……呜哇呜哇，伊里斯！！呜呜呜……——大人，呜哇呜哇，总算，来！！
text_loc: Iri-Irys!! Waaah... you, waaah, you're finally here!

text: 什么，我能听得懂这只精灵说的话？不对，星盘有点微热，微微颤动，似乎，是这盘子的能力？！
text_loc: Wait, I can understand this Jini? Hold on, the Stardial is warm and trembling slightly. Could that be what's doing it?

text: 小精灵，你说你认识伊里斯？
text_loc: Are you saying you know Irys?

name: 伊里斯
text: 哈哈，自然！伊里斯大人我的人缘……不对，等等，你懂精灵语？！
text_loc: Ha, naturally! The reputation of the great Irys amongst the Jini is... wait, you speak Jinish?

name: 伊里斯
text: 这语言，对高年级学生来说，也是「从入门到放弃」，专家更是——少之又少！
text_loc: Even advanced students consider this language easy to start, but easier to quit. Genuine experts in it are rarer than a four-leaf clover in a snowstorm!

name: 伊里斯
text: 啧啧啧，看不出来，你这孩子，深藏不露啊……
text_loc: Well, well, well. Didn't see that coming. You've been hiding your light under a bushel, haven't you?

text: 我也不知怎么回事……
text_loc: I have no idea...

text: 就……就是懂嘛！
text_loc: I just... can, okay?

name: 伊里斯
text: 嗯？看你这副懵懵懂懂的模样，难道说，你不是靠学习学会，而是有什么特别的——「作弊道具」？！
text_loc: Hm? That look on your face... you mean to tell me you've got some kind of special "cheat item" doing it for you, don't you?

name: 伊里斯
text: 唔，这倒是印证了我的猜测……
text_loc: Hm. That would actually confirm a theory of mine.

text: 你在说什么谜语
text_loc: What do you mean?

name: 伊里斯
text: 啊哈哈，我随口说说的，或许，你是不可多得的——呃，语言奇才？
text_loc: Oh nothing! Just thinking out loud. Or perhaps you truly are a once-in-a-generation linguistic prodigy?

name: 伊里斯
text: 哎哎，比起那个，你看，这孩子还挂着鼻涕和眼泪呢……小家伙，你慌慌张张地逃来窜去，是遇到了什么吗？
text_loc: But never mind that—look at this poor Jini! Snot, tears, and what appears to be a whole barrel of despair. Tell me, little one, why are you scurrying about like a headless chicken? What happened?

name: 逃跑的精灵
text: 呜哇呜哇……（惊弓之鸟一样，飞快瞟了我几眼）
text_loc: Gaaah! *darts a few wide-eyed glances at me, startled*

text: 怎么还怕我呢……
text_loc: It's scared of me?

name: 伊里斯
text: 你不用害怕，这位小同学是我带来的助手，自己人！你放心说就好啦。
text_loc: You don't have to be afraid. This is my assistant—one of us! Go ahead, tell us everything.

name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>这只精灵又是抽泣，又是大哭地，呜呜啊啊说了半天。</>|||<center>虽然言语零碎，但似乎是说……有什么洛克在追它？</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>The little Jini sobs and wails, rambling on for a while.</> |||<center>The words come out fragmented, but it seems to be saying that... someone is chasing it?</>|||

name: 伊里斯
text: 嗯，你是说，因为出现了发狂的精灵，所以皇家办事处的士兵们正在尝试解决这件事？
text_loc: So you're saying, with the rampaging Jini causing chaos, the soldiers from the Royal Office have been trying to handle things?

name: 伊里斯
text: 你虽然是一只正常的精灵，却也被它们追了半天？怎么会这样……小同学，你怎么看？
text_loc: And even though you're a perfectly normal Jini, they've been chasing you around too? That doesn't make any sense... what do you make of it?

text: 事态紧急，所以处理比较混乱吧
text_loc: Maybe they got confused.

text: 怎么能这么对精灵？生气！
text_loc: This is outrageous!

name: 伊里斯
text: 嗯，他们通常都不会乱抓精灵，处事也一直很有条理和分寸，这次怎么会……
text_loc: They don't usually go grabbing Jini without cause. They've always been careful and measured. So what's so different this time...?

name: 逃跑的精灵
text: 会！呜哇呜哇，小花……关起来……高台，呜哇，守卫……呜哇！！！（气愤地）
text_loc: Yes! The Rise... guards... waaaah! They locked up Flowy! *fumes*

name: 伊里斯
text: 你是说，有一只小花被抓起来了？在那边的高台上？附近还有很多守卫？
text_loc: You're saying a Jini named Flowy has been locked up? Up at that Rise over there? With guards all around?

name: 伊里斯
text: 我知道了……小家伙，你别生气，也别哭，这里面，肯定有什么误会……
text_loc: I understand. Don't be upset now. Dry your tears. There is most certainly a misunderstanding buried somewhere in all of this.

name: 伊里斯
text: 你还信不过伊里斯我嘛！学富八车！有勇有谋！——总之，包在我身上，我去解救小花！
text_loc: You can trust me, Irys, the fondue of knowledge! Leave it all to me! I'll get Flowy out!

text: 相信伊里斯
text_loc: I trust you!

text: 就知道学富八车……
text_loc: Again with the fondue stuff...

name: 伊里斯
text: 小家伙，辛苦你了。你刚才……有点害怕这位小同学吧？放心，这次只是事态特殊，一般的时候，洛克们都是很和善的！
text_loc: You've had a rough go of it, little one. This young Roco gave you quite the scare just now, huh. No need to worry. Things are a bit topsy-turvy right now, but Rocos are good people, I promise.

name: 逃跑的精灵
text: 呜哇呜哇……（不好意思地点了点头）
text_loc: Okay... *nods, a little embarrassed*

name: 伊里斯
text: 嘿嘿，真是乖！
text_loc: Heh, that's a good Jini.

name: 伊里斯
text: {name}，事不宜迟，让我们出发去高台探查一下吧。得收集更多信息，才能知晓事件全貌！
text_loc: {name}, no time to waste. Let's head to the Rise and see what's going on. We need more information before we can figure out what's going on here.

name: 伊里斯
text: 这个牢笼！没错，我能感觉到……里面有精灵！
text_loc: This cage... Yes, I can feel it. There's a Jini inside.

name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>伊里斯一脸紧张，左嗅嗅，右敲敲。</>|||<center>终于，他紧蹙的眉间舒展了开来，脸上挂上了一丝不易察觉的笑容。</>
text_loc: |||<center>Irys leans in close, sniffing here and tapping there, his brow knotted tight.</> |||<center>Then, slowly, the furrow smooths and a faint smile finds its way onto his face.</>

name: 伊里斯
text: {name}！怎么办，有点不妙！！我感觉它非常瘦弱，似乎……奄奄一息！！
text_loc: {name}! This is bad. I can feel it—so weak, so frail... it's barely holding on!

text: 还能救吗？
text_loc: Can it still be saved?

text: 不会已经……
text_loc: Is it already...

name: 伊里斯
text: 可恶！可怜的小家伙，被关在监牢里这么久……
text_loc: Unbelievable. The poor creature, locked away in there all this time...

name: 伊里斯
text: 不快点放它出来的话，恐怕就……哎，很难说了！
text_loc: If we don't get it out soon... well. I'd rather not finish that sentence.

text: 不好，我们快想办法救救！
text_loc: We have to do something, fast!

name: 伊里斯
text: 别急，让我看看……唔，这个牢笼，被上了一组「有点麻烦」的魔法禁制啊……
text_loc: Hold on, let me take a look... hmm. This cage has been sealed with a rather troublesome set of magical locks.

name: 伊里斯
text: 魔力没法传输很远……也就是说，解开它的机关，就在附近！
text_loc: Magic can't be transmitted very far... which means the release mechanism has to be somewhere nearby!

text: 还挺懂嘛！
text_loc: You really do know your stuff.

name: 伊里斯
text: 喂喂，毕竟我可是大魔法师，可不是浪得虚名！
text_loc: Please. I am an Archmage. It's hardly a title I stumbled into.

name: 伊里斯
text: 机关数目众多……考虑到这只柔弱小花的身体情况……
text_loc: With this many locks to deal with... given the condition of our fragile little Flowy...

name: 伊里斯
text: 事不宜迟，我们迅速行动吧！
text_loc: No time to waste. Let's move!

text: 又是战斗的时候了！
text_loc: Time to fight!

name: 伊里斯
text: 停停停，什么战斗的时候！现在的重点是解开机关，放精灵出来！
text_loc: Whoa, whoa—fight? The priority right now is breaking those locks and getting the Jini out.

name: 伊里斯
text: 当然，要是有卫兵阻碍……也多周旋一下，从他们那里探知更多信息！
text_loc: That said, if any guards get in the way... go easy on them. We might be able to squeeze some useful information out of them.

text: 为啥不直接战斗？
text_loc: Why not just fight?

text: 你想知道什么信息？
text_loc: What info are you after?

name: 伊里斯
text: 在精灵们看来，卫兵不追究精灵狂暴的原因，只大剌剌地处理事态，因而让它们恐惧不安。
text_loc: According to that Jini, the guards aren't trying to understand why they're going berserk—they're simply rounding them all up. That's what's got them so scared.

name: 伊里斯
text: 对我来说，卫兵的行为……也不符合常理。他们何苦铺开大网，只要是精灵，全部抓捕？
text_loc: And from where I'm standing, the guards' behavior doesn't add up either. Why cast such a wide net? Rounding up every Jini in sight, no questions asked?

name: 伊里斯
text: 我想，我们得探听清楚，才能解开双方的矛盾，不是吗？
text_loc: If we actually want to untangle this whole mess, we need to find out what's really going on.

text: 你还真是有模有样的调停者呢！
text_loc: Someone's playing peacemaker.

name: 伊里斯
text: 毕竟，这也是我一直活动，致力去解决的课题嘛！
text_loc: Well, it is a puzzle I've long dedicated myself to solving.

name: 伊里斯
text: 呼……闲话少叙，这只柔弱小花，还嗷嗷待救呢！走！分头行动！
text_loc: Phew... enough talk. Flowy is still waiting to be rescued! Let's split up.

text: 高大强壮的身影，看似在努力站岗，但凑近一看，居然听到了阵阵鼾声……
text_loc: The tall, sturdy figure looks like he's doing his very best to stand guard. Look closer, though, and you can hear the soft respiration of snoring...

text: 悄悄绕过他……
text_loc: Sneak past him.

text: 大声叫醒他！
text_loc: Wake him up!

name: 汉普顿
title: 黄金骑士
text: 啊……对不起老大……！我没有偷懒！卫兵守则，第八条，严禁出勤时分心……嗯？！
text_loc: Wh — sorry, sir...! I wasn't slacking! Guard's Code, Article Eight: no distractions while on duty... hm?

name: 汉普顿
title: 黄金骑士
text: 什么嘛？原来是个小孩？风灾这么严重，小朋友你快回家里好好呆着……
text_loc: Oh? Just a kid? With winds this bad, you should be at home.

text: 向石柱的方向示意
text_loc: Point toward the pillar.

name: 汉普顿
title: 黄金骑士
text: 什么？要解开这个机关？
text_loc: What? You want to undo that lock?

text: 嘿嘿，可以吗？
text_loc: Could you?

text: 麻烦你了！
text_loc: Pretty please!

name: 汉普顿
title: 黄金骑士
text: 可这石柱可是老大亲自点名看守的，随便放你过去，我岂不是太没面子了……
text_loc: But the captain personally put me on this post. Letting you through would make me look pretty bad...

text: 露出可爱的眼神
text_loc: Give him your best puppy eyes.

name: 汉普顿
title: 黄金骑士
text: 呃……撒娇也没用啊，我……我不吃这套的！
text_loc: That... that's not going to work on me! I... I don't fall for that kind of thing!

text: 假装变得很委屈，继续向他求情……
text_loc: Time to really dial the pitifulness up to eleven...

name: 汉普顿
title: 黄金骑士
text: 唉，其实我也觉得……这精灵即便是发狂，关起来也有点太可怜了……
text_loc: If I'm being honest, even I think it's a bit much, locking up a Jini like that, even if it did go berserk...

name: 汉普顿
title: 黄金骑士
text: 但！站岗是卫兵的职责！擅离职守可不是我会做的事情！除非！除非我在精灵对决中堂堂正正地落败！
text_loc: But! Standing sentinel is a guard's duty! I must not abandon my post! Unless... unless I lose fair and square in a Jini Duel.

name: 汉普顿
title: 黄金骑士
text: 你知道该怎么做了吧，小朋友！
text_loc: You know what to do, kid!

text: 放马过来！
text_loc: Bring it on!

text: 离开
text_loc: Leave.

text: 尝试挑战他
text_loc: Challenge him.

name: 汉普顿
title: 黄金骑士
text: 也好，我在这儿站了半天，刚好可以活动活动！
text_loc: I've been standing here for ages. Might as well stretch my legs.

name: 汉普顿
title: 黄金骑士
text: 哇，不打不知道，怎么感觉……你比我们队长还厉害？
text_loc: Wow. Didn't expect that—you might actually be stronger than our squad captain!

name: 汉普顿
title: 黄金骑士
text: 我知道了，你一定是魔法学院的小孩吧？
text_loc: Let me guess. You're one of those Magic Academy kids, aren't you?

text: 答对了！
text_loc: Bingo.

text: 才发现啊
text_loc: Took you long enough.

name: 汉普顿
title: 黄金骑士
text: 那我心里平衡了不少，你们魔法学院，出了名的盛产各种「小怪物」。
text_loc: Ha, that settles it. The Academy's got a real reputation for producing freakishly-strong kiddos like you.

name: 汉普顿
title: 黄金骑士
text: 我也可以长舒口气！这下就是名正言顺的败退了。
text_loc: Alright, I can breathe easy now. A clean, honorable defeat—I can still hold my head high.

text: 感谢你愿意帮忙
text_loc: Thanks for being a good sport.

name: 汉普顿
title: 黄金骑士
text: 我可没帮忙噢！都是你的实力！
text_loc: I didn't do you any favors! That was all you.

name: 汉普顿
title: 黄金骑士
text: 那么，再见啦，小朋友！
text_loc: Well then, see you around, kid.

text: 欸？伊里斯似乎在和卫兵说什么……听听看吧！
text_loc: Hm? Irys seems to be talking to one of the guards... I should listen in.

name: 庄重的卫兵
text: 伊里斯大人，您屈尊来到此处，我又惶恐又激动……
text_loc: Master Irys, I am both humbled and overwhelmed to be graced with your presence.

name: 伊里斯
text: 呃……有这么夸张吗。
text_loc: Uh... is it really that big a deal?

name: 庄重的卫兵
text: 当然，伊里斯大人，您可是堂堂大魔法师，驻地主人，我当然相信您的判断……！
text_loc: Of course, Master Irys! You are an Archmage—the master of this outpost. I trust your judgment completely.

name: 庄重的卫兵
text: 毕竟，你的美名从商店街到皇家办事处，无人不知无人不晓！！！
text_loc: Your name is known from Merchant Town all the way to the Royal Office—there isn't a soul who hasn't heard of you!

name: 庄重的卫兵
text: 可您是没见到，那只精灵张牙舞爪的狂暴样子。要是它出来发狂，伤了您可怎么办……
text_loc: And yet, you haven't seen the state of that Jini when it went berserk. If it were to escape and harm you...

name: 伊里斯
text: 呃……你也太客气了。
text_loc: Uh... you really are too kind.

name: 庄重的卫兵
text: 所以，我还是建议谨慎处理……唉，说起来，这风灾不仅影响精灵，最近的天气也糟糕得很！……
text_loc: I strongly recommend we proceed with caution... and speaking of which, these winds haven't only been affecting the Jini—the weather has been absolutely dreadful lately!

name: 庄重的卫兵
text: 阴晴不定，万一刮风下雨，我都得找地方避避。您也小心，别被淋到了……
text_loc: Sunny one moment, storming the next. I'd hate for you to get caught in the rain, Master Irys. Do be careful.

text: 呃……这就是之前伊里斯所担心的「大魔法师突然出现引起不必要的注意」吧……虽然和预想中的骚乱不同……
text_loc: Ah... so this is what Irys meant by an Archmage showing up and drawing all the wrong kinds of attention. Not quite the riot he imagined, but still...

text: 这时候就得我英雄出场了！
text_loc: This is my moment to swoop in!

text: 仔细想想，或许有什么办法，引开他？呃……他刚说，极端天气他会去避避来着？
text_loc: Hmm... there might be a way to draw him off. Didn't he just say he'd find shelter if the weather turned bad?

name: 庄重的卫兵
text: 哎呀！怎么刚说，就下大雨了！我这乌鸦嘴！伊里斯大人！快跟我来！我带您避雨！
text_loc: Oh, there goes my big mouth! Soon as I mention rain, it starts pouring! Come with me, Master Irys, I'll take you somewhere dry.

name: 伊里斯
text: 哎——哎——你别拉拉扯扯……不用——嗯？（伊里斯似乎注意到了我的意图……）
text_loc: Hey, stop pulling me, there's no need—hmm? (Irys seems to have caught on to what I'm up to.)

name: 伊里斯
text: 哎呀！那就拜托卫兵您带我避雨了！你看看，我这帅气的头型也湿了，这衣服也淋得不成样子……
text_loc: Well then, I leave myself entirely in your capable hands! Look at this! My magnificent hair, completely ruined! These clothes are absolutely drenched beyond all recognition.

name: 庄重的卫兵
text: 诶诶？！咱这地方咋会起沙尘啊！难道是又有什么紧急情况了？伊里斯大人，随我避难！！
text_loc: Huh? How is there a sandstorm here? Is something happening? Master Irys, come with me and take cover!

name: 伊里斯
text: 哎——哎——你别拉拉扯扯，不用——嗯？（伊里斯似乎注意到了我的意图……）
text_loc: Hey, stop pulling me, there's no need—hmm? (Irys seems to have caught on to what I'm up to.)

name: 伊里斯
text: 哎呀！那就拜托卫兵您带我避难了！我看这沙尘起的蹊跷，准是有发狂的地鼠袭来，跑！保命要紧……
text_loc: Well then, I graciously accept your escort! A sandstorm, out of nowhere—clearly the work of some rampaging Jini on the warpath. Run! Self-preservation first!

name: 庄重的卫兵
text: 诶诶？！怎么突然起了大雾！难道是又有什么紧急情况了？伊里斯大人，你在哪——！！随我避难吧！
text_loc: What? A sudden fog? Is this another emergency? Master Irys, where are you? Take cover with me!

name: 伊里斯
text: 哎——哎——你别拉拉扯扯，不用——嗯？（伊里斯似乎注意到了我的意图……）
text_loc: Hey, stop pulling me, there's no need—hmm? (Irys seems to have caught on to what I'm up to.)

name: 伊里斯
text: 哎呀！那就拜托卫兵您带我避难了！我看这大雾起的蹊跷，准是有发狂水怪上岸袭来，跑！保命要紧……
text_loc: Well then, I humbly place my fate in your hands! This fog is deeply suspicious—clearly a sea monster has come ashore and is on the prowl. Run! Survival above all else!

text: |||<center>一场战斗后，这精灵似乎终于平静了一点…… </>|||
text_loc: |||<center>After the battle, the Jini seems to have finally calmed down a little.</>|||

name: 花花
title: <Blue>奇丽花</>
text: 咿呀咿呀——！！（看见伊里斯，似乎很激动）
text_loc: Eeya eeya! *spots Irys, visibly overjoyed*

name: 伊里斯
text: 诶……仔细看看，居……居然是你！完全认不出来了啊！
text_loc: One moment, let me get a closer look. Is... is that really you? I barely recognized you!

name: 伊里斯
text: 总感觉你还是十年前那样小小的一团，没想到一转眼，都这么大了！
text_loc: In my head you were still that tiny little bundle from ten years ago. Look at you now, all grown up!

name: 花花
title: <Blue>奇丽花</>
text: 咿呀咿呀，咿呀呀——！！（骄傲地挺起胸脯）
text_loc: Eeya eeya, eeyaaa! *puffs up proudly*

text: 什么柔弱小花，什么快要不行了？！火急火燎去救，居然比我还要生龙活虎？！
text_loc: "Fragile little Flowy," "barely holding on"? We rushed over like its life hung in the balance, and it's more full of life than either of us.

name: 伊里斯
text: 小奇丽花，我今天可是又救了你一次！是不是得好好感谢我呀？
text_loc: My little Florora! I do believe I've now rescued you twice. Surely that deserves some appreciation?

text: 挨打的可是我……
text_loc: I took all the hits...

text: 出力的可是我……
text_loc: I did all the actual work...

name: 伊里斯
text: 哈哈，这不就要正式介绍你嘛！花花，这次营救你的主要功臣——就是我身边这位小同学。
text_loc: Haha, well, now I get to make a proper introduction! Flowy, the real hero of this rescue operation, is this young {gender:man,woman} beside me.

text: 什么营救，我看你就是想捉弄我吧
text_loc: Rescue? You set me up.

name: 伊里斯
text: 嘿嘿，怎么会呢？你可是我的宝贝助手。至于花花的身体情况……纯属判断失误，失误！哈哈！
text_loc: Heh, of course not! You are my most prized assistant. As for Flowy's condition earlier... simply a minor miscalculation, that's all.

name: 伊里斯
text: 话说回来，小奇丽花，这几天都发生了什么？可以和我说说吗？
text_loc: Anyway, my little Florora, what exactly has been going on these past few days? Tell me everything.

name: 花花
title: <Blue>奇丽花</>
text: 呜呜……咿咿呀呀，咿咿呀呀！咿咿呀呀……（开始絮絮叨叨）
text_loc: Aww... eeya eeya, eeya eeya! Eeya eeya... *launches into a long, animated ramble*

name: 花花
title: <Blue>奇丽花</>
text: 呜呜……！（说着说着，突然手舞足蹈，眼中有泪光闪动）
text_loc: Aww...! *breaks into wild gestures mid-story, tears welling in its eyes*

name: 伊里斯
text: 什么？你是说，狂风过后，你被吹下山，在那之后……感觉身体不受控制，开始攻击别人？！
text_loc: What? After the storm blew you down the mountain, you lost control of yourself and started attacking others?

name: 伊里斯
text: 嗯……身体很疼……意识也很模糊……似乎——被控制了身体？！
text_loc: Hm... the pain... slipping in and out of consciousness... it sounds almost like someone took over your body.

name: 花花
title: <Blue>奇丽花</>
text: 呜呜，呜呜，呜呜……（泪珠一颗颗滚落下来，声音也带上了哭腔）
text_loc: Aww, awww... *sobs tearfully*

name: 伊里斯
text: 原来，你发狂后就碰到了皇家卫兵，不等你争辩，直接被抓了起来、关在这里……
text_loc: So after you went berserk, you ran straight into the Royal Guards, and before you could say a word, they grabbed you and locked you up in here.

text: 花花，好可怜……
text_loc: Poor Flowy...

text: 卫兵好心办了坏事
text_loc: So the guards meant well, but...

name: 花花
title: <Blue>奇丽花</>
text: 呜呜，呜呜，呜呜……（可怜巴巴地挂着眼泪，似乎有点……愧疚？）
text_loc: Ooo, ooo, ooo... *hangs her head, tears still falling, looking guilty*

name: 伊里斯
text: 你……是担心给山下洛克带来了麻烦？唉，花花，不要自责，毕竟你的失控，不是出于本意……
text_loc: You're worried you caused trouble for the Rocos down in the village? Don't be so hard on yourself, Flowy. What happened wasn't your fault.

name: 伊里斯
text: 你还是早点回山上去吧，风灾停息之前，记得先躲在避难所里，好吗？比如树洞呀，石窟呀……
text_loc: Head back up the mountain as soon as you can. Find some safe shelter until these winds blow over, alright? A hollow tree, a cave, anywhere.

name: 花花
title: <Blue>奇丽花</>
text: 咿呀呀！（感激地看了伊里斯一眼，点了点头）
text_loc: Eeya ya! *looks at Irys with grateful eyes and nods*

name: 花花
title: <Blue>奇丽花</>
text: 咿咿呀呀，呀呀！（感激的目光转向我，有些腼腆地将什么东西放在了我手里）
text_loc: Eeya eeya, ya ya! *turns that same grateful gaze toward me, then shyly presses something into my hands*

name: 伊里斯
text: 嘿嘿，它想送你个小礼物，我们的花花，是个懂事的好孩子呢……呃？！
text_loc: Heh, it wants to give you a little gift. Flow is, such a thoughtful, sweet thing... hold on.

name: 伊里斯
text: 不好，有脚步声……应该是皇家卫兵注意到了这边的动静！
text_loc: Heads up, footsteps. Sounds like the Royal Guards caught wind of the commotion over here.

text: 我们要怎么办？
text_loc: What do we do?

name: 伊里斯
text: 哎，虽说放走花花是好事一件，但卫兵毕竟与我们的任务不同……为避免引起不必要的误会……
text_loc: Letting Flowy go was the right call, but the guards have a different job to do than we do. So, to avoid any unnecessary misunderstandings...

name: 伊里斯
text: 咳咳，那话怎么说来着，计策计策……
text_loc: Ahem, how does that saying go? The wisest move is...

name: 伊里斯
text: ——走为上策！开溜！
text_loc: Move! Run while you still can!

name: 花花
title: <Blue>奇丽花</>
text: 咿呀呀，咿呀呀！（摇头晃脑地傻笑）
text_loc: Eeya ya, eeya ya! *shakes her head, giggling away*

text: 这次好像听懂了，它在说：「感谢——感谢——」
text_loc: I think I caught that one. She's saying, "Thank you."

text: 星盘似乎也摇晃了一下，继而变得微热……奇怪，那只蓝色精灵，是有了什么触动？
text_loc: The Stardial gives a faint tremble, then grows warm... strange. Something seems to have stirred in that little blue Jini.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-前往伊里斯小屋
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 佩西，门外有些吵闹的样子，又发生了什么事吗？
text_loc: Penny, what's going on over there? Sounds like quite the commotion.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-前往伊里斯小屋
name: 佩西
text: 您是不是忘了，今天是惯例的精灵教学日，洛克们为了学习关于精灵的知识，会相聚到魔法师之家。
text_loc: Have you forgotten? Today's the usual Jini Education Day—Rocos from all over gather at the Magehaven to learn about Jini.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-前往伊里斯小屋
name: 佩西
text: 我说呀，镇子的危机已经解除了，有时您也该放松下紧绷的神经，伊里斯大人。
text_loc: If you ask me, now that the town's out of danger, you really ought to let yourself unwind a little, Master Irys.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-前往伊里斯小屋
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 哈哈，四处奔波都把这事给忘得一干二净了！
text_loc: Haha. What with all this darting around, it completely slipped my mind!

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-前往伊里斯小屋
text: 伊里斯！
text_loc: Irys!

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-前往伊里斯小屋
text: 佩西阿姨！
text_loc: Miss Penny!

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-前往伊里斯小屋
name: 佩西
text: 哦，是之前借住这里的小同学啊。看你的样子，已经与伊里斯大人已经很熟络了吧。
text_loc: Oh, the young {gender:man,woman} who was staying here. You and Master Irys seem to have gotten quite comfortable with each other.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-前往伊里斯小屋
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 那可不，{name}可是我的得力助手！风灾的事情能暂告一段落，多亏了{gender:他,她}的鼎力相助呢。
text_loc: Ha, of course! {name} is my most capable assistant. Are the winds finally settling down? We have {gender:him,her} to thank for a good chunk of that.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-前往伊里斯小屋
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 不过，你怎么特地跑到魔法师之家来了？
text_loc: But what brings you all the way to the Magehaven?

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-前往伊里斯小屋
text: 来交作业
text_loc: Need to turn in my homework.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-前往伊里斯小屋
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 作业……魔法师手册对吧，你已经全部完成了？
text_loc: Homework? You mean the Mage's Handbook? You've finished all of it?

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-前往伊里斯小屋
text: 不在话下
text_loc: Absolutely.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-前往伊里斯小屋
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 虽说很想马上给你布置新的作业，但我还需要一点点的准备时间。你也看到外面的情况了，洛克们已经有些等不及了。
text_loc: I'd love nothing more than to pile on the next assignment right now, but I need a little more time to prepare. You've seen the crowd outside—the Rocos out there are already getting restless.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-前往伊里斯小屋
name: 佩西
text: 那就快快去吧，伊里斯大人。
text_loc: Then you'd best get going, Master Irys.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-前往伊里斯小屋
魔法师手册第3章小结-前往伊里斯小屋
name: 空对话

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-前往伊里斯小屋
text: 回来看看
text_loc: Just stopping by.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-前往伊里斯小屋
name: 佩西
text: 哈哈，小同学确实很久没回来这里看看了。
text_loc: It's been a while since we've seen you around here.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-前往伊里斯小屋
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 难不成你已经完成了我布置的作业？
text_loc: Don't tell me you've already finished the assignment I gave you.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-前往伊里斯小屋
text: 轻松搞定
text_loc: Done and dusted.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-来到魔法师之家的小广场
name: 外向的工人
text: 哇，是伊里斯大人！！总算是把您给请出来了！
text_loc: Whoa, Master Irys is here! We've finally managed to get you out!

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-来到魔法师之家的小广场
name: 兴奋的小朋友
text: 爷爷，爷爷！这就是大魔法师伊里斯吗，我还是第一次看见这么帅气的洛克呢。
text_loc: Grandpa, grandpa! Is that the great Archmage Irys? I've never seen such a dashing Roco before!

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-来到魔法师之家的小广场
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 哈……哈哈，说得我都有点不好意思了。
text_loc: Woah... haha, now I'm actually feeling a little sheepish.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-来到魔法师之家的小广场
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 咳咳——好了各位，欢迎各位参加本次的精灵教学日。看各位都是生面孔，不知道对精灵的哪些方面感兴趣呢？
text_loc: Ahem—welcome, everyone, to today's Jini Education! I see plenty of new faces. So tell me, what aspect of Jini are you most curious about?

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-来到魔法师之家的小广场
name: 外向的工人
text: 我！我！我想要学一些厉害的精灵魔法！能唬住人的那种！
text_loc: Over here! I want to learn some seriously impressive Jini Magic! The kind that'll blow peoples' socks off!

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-来到魔法师之家的小广场
name: 踏实的年轻人
text: 有没有一些实用的魔法呢，能让日常生活更加便捷，之类的……
text_loc: Something practical would be nice—magic that makes everyday life a little easier, you know?

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-来到魔法师之家的小广场
name: 兴奋的小朋友
text: 我就想要可爱的精灵！精灵魔法嘛……那是什么？
text_loc: I just want a cute Jini. What's all this about Jini Magic now?

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-来到魔法师之家的小广场
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 嗯……听起来是大家的需要有所不同。这样吧——
text_loc: Hmm... sounds like everyone's after something a little different. Alright then.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-来到魔法师之家的小广场
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 我们暂且分为两组，我和小同学先负责其中一组的教学。佩西，你帮忙接待一下另外一组。
text_loc: Let's split into two groups. My young assistant and I will handle one, and Penny, if you could take care of the other.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-来到魔法师之家的小广场
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 看到远处的火盆了吗？想要学习实用技巧的，可以先跟我们过来。
text_loc: See that brazier in the distance? Anyone looking to pick up some practical skills, come with us.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-来到魔法师之家的小广场
name: 佩西
text: 其他人先到我这里稍作等待，伊里斯大人随后就来。
text_loc: Everyone else, gather around me. Master Irys will be with you shortly.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵魔法教学
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 人似乎都到齐了，嗯……让我想想，今天的精灵魔法主题是「火焰」！
text_loc: Looks like everyone's here. Let me think... today's Jini Magic theme is "Flame."

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵魔法教学
name: 踏实的年轻人
text: 火焰？
text_loc: Flame?

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵魔法教学
name: 敬业的邮差
text: 我知道了，是使用精灵制造出火的魔法，没错吧？
text_loc: That's the magic that uses Jini to produce fire, right?

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵魔法教学
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 欸，怎么把我的话给抢了。不过，这位邮差先生说得很对……
text_loc: You took the words right out of my mouth. Yes, our friend here is absolutely correct.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵魔法教学
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 火系精灵所使用的魔法，可以凭空创造出火焰。对于洛克来说，可以灵活运用于照明、取暖，或是其他的各类用途。
text_loc: Fire-Type Jini can conjure flames from nothing. For Rocos, that can mean lighting, heat sources, and all sorts of everyday uses.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵魔法教学
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 而使用方法也十分简单，朝着可以点燃的物件掷出火系精灵即可。
text_loc: And the method is remarkably simple—just throw your Fire-Type Jini at something flammable.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵魔法教学
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 那么接下来，就由擅长使用火系精灵的魔法学院优秀学生——{name}为我们实际演示一下如何操作吧。
text_loc: Allow me to introduce {name}, a standout student of the Magic Academy and a true master of Fire-Type Jini who will be helping with a live demonstration.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵魔法教学
text: 怎么是我？
text_loc: Me?

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵魔法教学
text: 果然不出所料……
text_loc: I knew this would happen.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵魔法教学
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 嘿嘿，火系精灵确实不是我的特长。再说了，在露天课堂中与当地人打成一片，也是学院的初衷嘛。
text_loc: Heh heh, Fire-Types are honestly not my forte. Besides, getting Academy students and locals to learn together side by side is what the Outdoor Classroom is all about.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵魔法教学
name: 敬业的邮差
text: 伊里斯大人，这个小朋友能行吗？看样子，{gender:他,她}只是位新生同学啊。
text_loc: Master Irys, is this youngster really up to it? {gender:He,She} looks like a first-year student to me.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵魔法教学
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 这你可就看走眼了，这位可是解决月牙镇黑影事件的超、级、新、生！
text_loc: Ha, that's where you'd be wrong. This here is the one who cracked the shadow incident in Monatun. A real rising star, this one!

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵魔法教学
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 总之，这里先交给你了，那边还有些洛克等着我呢。就算是伊里斯大人我也是分身乏术，谁叫洛克们都如此热情呢。
text_loc: I'll leave things here in your capable hands—I've got a few more Rocos waiting on me over there. Even I, the great Irys, can only be in one place at a time, and the people's enthusiasm is simply too much to resist.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵魔法教学
魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵魔法教学
name: 踏实的年轻人
text: 那就请小同学演示一遍如何使用火系精灵魔法吧，我们也好有个参考。
text_loc: Well then, why don't you show us how to use Fire-Type Jini Magic? We could use a good reference.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-火盆教学后续
name: 高兴的年轻人
text: 哇，火盆真的被点燃了！
text_loc: Wow, the brazier actually lit up!

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-火盆教学后续
name: 敬业的邮差
text: 看起来很简单嘛，让我也来试试。
text_loc: That looked easy enough. Let me give it a shot.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-火盆教学后续
name: 敬业的邮差
text: 到你出场了，治愈兔！
text_loc: Now's your moment to shine, Bunniaid!

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-火盆教学后续
魔法师手册第3章小结-火盆教学后续
魔法师手册第3章小结-火盆教学后续
魔法师手册第3章小结-火盆教学后续
魔法师手册第3章小结-火盆教学后续
name: 敬业的邮差
text: 成功了！看来我也很有使用精灵的天赋嘛。
text_loc: I did it! Looks like I've got quite the knack for working with Jini.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-火盆教学后续
name: 踏实的年轻人
text: 只要学着小同学的动作掷出火系精灵，它们就会帮忙点燃火焰，真是太棒了！
text_loc: All you have to do is throw a Fire-Type Jini just like the assistant did, and they'll light the fire for you. That's incredible!

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-火盆教学后续
name: 敬业的邮差
text: 哈哈，这样即使是送往雪山的信件也不在话下，只用带上我的好搭档治愈兔，点燃沿路的火盆就能随时取暖。
text_loc: Ha! With this, even deliveries up to the snowcapped mountains will be a breeze. Just need to bring my trusty Bunniaid and light the braziers along the way to stay toasty.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-火盆教学后续
name: 高兴的年轻人
text: 那家里的炉灶也不用一直保持燃烧了，需要用的时候让精灵帮忙就行。
text_loc: And we don't have to keep the kitchen stove burning all the time anymore—just call on a Jini whenever we need it.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-火盆教学后续
name: 踏实的年轻人
text: 确实是再「实用」不过的精灵魔法，没想到我也有学会使用精灵魔法的一天。
text_loc: Truly the most practical Jini Magic there is. Never thought I'd see the day I could actually use Jini Magic myself.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-火盆教学后续
name: 踏实的年轻人
text: 谢谢你小同学，伊里斯大人果然没骗我们。我一定会勤加练习，使出和你一样的完美投掷姿势 ！
text_loc: Thank you so much. Master Irys wasn't exaggerating one bit. I'm going to keep throwing until my form looks just as perfect as yours.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-火盆教学后续
text: 看来这里告一段落了，去找伊里斯吧……
text_loc: Looks like things are winding down here. Time to go find Irys...

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵交互教学
name: 兴奋的小朋友
text: 好耶好耶，是小独角兽！我最喜欢的精灵！
text_loc: Yay, it's an Irikeras! My absolute favorite Jini!

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵交互教学
name: 忧郁的小朋友
text: 可是……我们还不够厉害，没法跟它达成契约，不是吗？
text_loc: But we're not strong enough to form a pact with it yet, are we?

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵交互教学
name: 兴奋的小朋友
text: 哇——我就要嘛，我就要嘛！
text_loc: I don't care, I want one!

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵交互教学
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 别急，小朋友。等你们长大了，自然有能力跟小独角兽结下契约，也许还能获得更厉害的白金独角兽呢。
text_loc: Easy now, kiddos. Give it time. When you're older, you'll have what it takes to form a pact with an Irikeras. And who knows, you might even earn the friendship of an Irikeron someday.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵交互教学
name: 兴奋的小朋友
text: 我现在就想要小独角兽嘛……呜呜……
text_loc: Aw man... but I want a Unicorn right now!

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵交互教学
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 嗯……也不是没有办法。精灵在开心的时候，会自然地亲近洛克，野外的精灵们也不例外。
text_loc: Well, there actually is a way. When a Jini is happy, it will naturally warm up to Rocos, and that goes for wild Jini too.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵交互教学
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 如果能逗小独角兽开心，它们就会很乐意让你跨在背上，载你一路。
text_loc: Make an Irikeras happy, and it'll gladly let you climb on its back and take you for a ride.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵交互教学
name: 兴奋的小朋友
text: 好耶！可是要怎么才能让它开心呢……嗯，喂它好吃的？
text_loc: Ooh! But how do you make one happy... feed it something tasty, maybe?

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵交互教学
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 小独角兽性格天真活泼，只需要做些动作让它们感受到善意，唔……或是演奏某种它们喜爱的「特殊乐曲」。
text_loc: Irikeras are curious and playful by nature. A few friendly gestures are usually enough, or if you happen to know a certain special melody they love, that works wonders as well.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵交互教学
text: 有种不好的预感……
text_loc: I have a bad feeling about where this is going...

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵交互教学
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 真是「说岚鸟、岚鸟就到」，这位魔法学院的同学可是跟独角兽族群有很深的渊源，由{gender:他,她}来给各位做演示再适合不过了。
text_loc: Well, speak of the angel, this Academy student here happens to have a deep connection with the Unicorn family. There's no one better to show you how it's done.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵交互教学
text: 没有这回事……
text_loc: I don't, actually.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵交互教学
text: 又来啊
text_loc: Here we go again.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵交互教学
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 我说有就有嘛。在聆风镇面对那么多一窝蜂你都没有胆怯，这点小事根本不在话下！
text_loc: Oh, trust me, you do. You stood your ground against that whole swarm back in Windrun without flinching—this'll be a piece of bread for you.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵交互教学
name: 外向的工人
text: 小朋友，既然伊里斯大人这么说了，就快点露两手给我们看看嘛。
text_loc: Go on, then! Master Irys says so, so show us what you've got!

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-伊里斯的精灵交互教学
name: 兴奋的小朋友
text: 对啊对啊，{gender:大哥哥,大姐姐}，就算是不能现在就契约小独角兽，我也想试试骑着它跑上两圈！
text_loc: Yeah! Even if I can't form a pact with the Irikeras today, I at least want to try riding it for a bit!

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-让逗小独角兽开心
name: 小独角兽
text: 嘶——嘶——（它看起来非常开心！）
text_loc: Hrrr— hrrr— (it looks incredibly happy!)

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-让逗小独角兽开心
name: 兴奋的小朋友
text: 喔！小独角兽看起来好开心的样子，{gender:大哥哥,大姐姐}好厉害。
text_loc: Wow! The Irikeras looks so happy! You're amazing.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-让逗小独角兽开心
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 就是现在，当小独角兽向你表达善意的时候，便可以搭乘它进行一段奇妙的短途冒险啦！
text_loc: Now's the moment—when an Irikeras warms up to you in this way, you can hop on and set off on a little adventure together.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-让逗小独角兽开心
魔法师手册第3章小结-让逗小独角兽开心
魔法师手册第3章小结-让逗小独角兽开心
魔法师手册第3章小结-精灵交互教学后续
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 非常棒，让我们感谢{name}的完美示范！
text_loc: Fabulous, let's all give {name} a round of applause for that perfect demonstration!

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-精灵交互教学后续
name: 兴奋的小朋友
text: {gender:大哥哥,大姐姐}好厉害，那只小独角兽就好像跟{gender:他,她}相处过很久似的。
text_loc: {gender:He,She} is so cool. That Irikeras looked like it had known {gender:him,her} for years.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-精灵交互教学后续
name: 外向的工人
text: 照这么说，如果我能逗野生的小独角兽开心，也能骑到它的背上咯？
text_loc: So if I can get a wild Irikeras in a good mood, I can ride it too?

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-精灵交互教学后续
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 没错，正如我所说，独角兽是亲近洛克的精灵族群，其他种类精灵偶尔也会载洛克一程，但达成的方式不尽相同。
text_loc: Exactly. As I said, Unicorns are naturally drawn to Rocos. Other Jini species will sometimes offer you a ride too, though each will have its own way of cozying up to you.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-精灵交互教学后续
name: 外向的工人
text: 那是不是也可以让小独角兽帮忙驮些货物啊，哈哈哈！
text_loc: In that case, can I get an Irikeras to carry my cargo too? Haha!

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-精灵交互教学后续
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text_loc: Well...

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-精灵交互教学后续
name: 兴奋的小朋友
text: 那可不行！精灵可是我们的好朋友，没经过它们同意不能这样！更何况是那么可爱的小独角兽。
text_loc: Absolutely not! Jini are our friends—you can't ask them to do anything without their consent. Especially not one as adorable as the Irikeras.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-精灵交互教学后续
name: 围观的年轻人
text: 就是就是，看你年轻力壮的，体力活自己干不就行了？
text_loc: Exactly! You look perfectly able-bodied to me. Carry it yourself.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-精灵交互教学后续
name: 外向的工人
text: 我、我也就说说嘛，可不会真的让精灵去做这种事！
text_loc: I-I was only joking! I would never actually make a Jini do that kind of thing.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-精灵交互教学后续
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 好了好了，小朋友，等下次再遇到小独角兽可以试试学着{name}的样子，跟它成为好朋友哦~
text_loc: Alright, alright. Next time any of you come across a Irikeras, try doing what {name} did and make friends with it.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-精灵交互教学后续
name: 兴奋的小朋友
text: 嗯！我回家一定好好练习！
text_loc: Okay! I'm going home to practice right away!

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-精灵交互教学后续
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 今天时间还早，各位是否还有关于精灵的困惑，可以尽情提问……
text_loc: The day is still young, so if anyone has more questions about Jini, ask away.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-精灵交互教学后续
name: 围观的年轻人
text: 我我我！！
text_loc: Oh, me, me!

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-精灵交互教学后续
魔法师手册第3章小结-精灵交互教学后续
魔法师手册第3章小结-精灵交互教学后续
魔法师手册第3章小结-精灵交互教学后续
魔法师手册第3章小结-精灵交互教学后续
text: 很长时间之后……
text_loc: Much later...

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-精灵交互教学后续
魔法师手册第3章小结-精灵交互教学后续
name: 佩西
text: 伊里斯大人，今天的教学真是充实啊。
text_loc: Master Irys, today's lesson was really something.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-精灵交互教学后续
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 呼——一没注意已经夜深了，想不到洛克们如此渴望与精灵相关的知识……
text_loc: Phew, the night's already crept in. I had no idea Rocos were this hungry for everything Jini-related.

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-精灵交互教学后续
text: 手册的作业……
text_loc: About the homework...

task_name: 魔法师手册第3章小结-精灵交互教学后续
name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 哦对了，差点忘记了你的作业。我这就去作准备，稍后来小屋里找我吧。
text_loc: Right, almost slipped my mind. Let me go get things ready—come find me in the cottage in a bit.

name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 魔法师手册的作业已经准备完毕，这次的作业就得全靠你自己了。
text_loc: The Mage's Handbook assignment is all set. You'll have to tackle this one on your own.

text: 你不一起吗？
text_loc: You're not coming?

name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 嗯，虽说山下的骚动暂时解除了，那个悬在风眠山的巨大风卷却依旧挥之不去。我总有一种……不祥的预感。
text_loc: The commotion down in the village has quieted for now, but that massive whirlwind hanging over Windrest Mountain isn't going anywhere. I have a feeling something isn't right.

name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 只要那个造成异变的源头还在，洛克们恐怕就没法恢复平静的生活。身为魔法师之家的主人，我有责任继续追查风灾的真相。
text_loc: As long as whatever caused this disruption is still out there, the Rocos won't be able to get back to their peaceful lives. As the master of Magehaven, it's my responsibility to keep digging for the truth behind this disaster.

name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 而且，我总不能天天陪着你嘛~哈哈！
text_loc: Besides, I can't be your shadow every step of the way. Haha.

text: 你才是
text_loc: You're one to talk.

text: 一个人没问题吗？
text_loc: You'll be okay on your own?

name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 我？我可是大魔法师伊里斯！再大的风灾，最后也不会是我的对手的！哈哈哈！
text_loc: What do you mean? I am the great Archmage Irys! No wind disaster in this world or the next is any match for me.

name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 对了，这次的作业完成后记得交给路易斯，我已经跟他打过了招呼。
text_loc: Oh, and once you finish this assignment, hand it in to Louis—I've already had a word with him.

name: 伊里斯
title: 大魔法师
text: 至于理由，我也希望你不要深究了，一定要说的话——这是大人之间的「秘密」。
text_loc: As for why, I'd rather you not dig too deep into that. If you must have a reason, let's just call it a little professional secret between professors.

name: 路易斯
text: 哟，这不是我们「小有声名」的{name}吗？！老师在这里……可等你半天了！
text_loc: Well, well, well—if it isn't the up-and-comer {gender:himself,herself}. I've been waiting here for quite a while, you know.

name: 路易斯
text: 我都从村民那里都听说了，你这小家伙，闯卫兵，闹蜂群，钓巨怪，可是立下了「赫赫战功」啊……
text_loc: I've heard all about it from the villagers—sneaking past the guards, stirring up a swarm, reeling in some monstrous catch... You've built quite the illustrious track record for yourself, haven't you?

text: 我知错了老师……
text_loc: I'm sorry, I know I messed up...

text: 我做的是有价值的事！
text_loc: I regret nothing!

name: 路易斯
text: 哈哈，老师想说，你做得很好！加上派去帮助商店街的学生……我们代表魔法学院，展示了应有的担当！
text_loc: Haha. What I actually wanted to say is—well done. Between you and the students helping out at Merchant Town, we showed exactly the kind of spirit the Magic Academy stands for.

name: 路易斯
text: 老师担心的……只是你的安全而已……伊里斯贸然拉你前去，是他的问题，我已经说过他了。
text_loc: The only thing I was worried about was you. Irys pulling you into all that without warning—that's on him, and I've already told him so.

text: 伊里斯他也没错……
text_loc: Irys didn't do anything wrong.

text: 对对对，都是伊里斯！
text_loc: Yeah, it's all his fault!

name: 路易斯
text: 哈哈，你们关系还挺好。好了，好了，小小年纪别苦着脸，放松！来，笑一个~
text_loc: Ha, you really are two peas in a pod. Come on, no long faces at your age—loosen up!

name: 路易斯
text: 村民们感谢魔法学院，甚至在商店街准备了可瓦斯畅饮……呼呼，你也累了，适当去休息休息，调节情绪吧！
text_loc: The villagers were so grateful they set up a free Rocovass station at Merchant Town for the Academy. You've earned a break, go get some rest and recharge.

name: 黑屏
text: 迪莫突然跳了出来，毛发炸立，尾巴颤抖，眼睛死死锁定巨影消失的方向。
text_loc: Dimo leaps out of nowhere, fur on end, tail trembling, eyes locked on the spot where the massive shadow vanished.

name: 迪莫
text: 呜呜——呜呜！！迪莫迪莫！
text_loc: Dimo! Dimo!

text: 迪莫是怎么了？似乎非常在意携风而来的紫黑色巨影……？
text_loc: What's gotten into Dimo? It seems really shaken up by that dark violet shadow that came in on the wind...

name: 路易斯
title: 学院导师
text: 喂！还好吗？！刚刚天昏地暗，紫黑魔兽掀起的狂风差点……幸好恩佐反应及时……！没伤到吧？小同学！
text_loc: Hey! You okay? That thing just blotted out the sky. The gale it kicked up nearly... thank goodness Enzir reacted so fast. You're not hurt, are you?

text: 我没事
text_loc: I'm fine.

text: 我头有点晕
text_loc: My head's spinning a little.

name: 路易斯
title: 学院导师
text: 哎，都怪我，防灾预案不足，差点让你们陷入危险！
text_loc: This is on me. My safety protocols weren't good enough, and I nearly let you all get hurt.

name: 恩佐
text: 这只蓝色精灵……似乎对紫黑魔兽也很感兴趣。难道……是紫黑色的力量吸引了它？！
text_loc: This blue Jini seems drawn to the Dark Monster. Could the violet energy be pulling it in somehow?

name: 路易斯
title: 学院导师
text: 这只蓝色精灵……看起来倒很像……王国的代表精灵……唔，得是我看错了吧……总之，先聊正事吧！
text_loc: This blue Jini... it almost looks like the Kingdom's representative Jini. Hmm, I must be seeing things. Anyway, let's focus on what matters.

name: 恩佐
text: 路易斯老师，我注意到您一直称呼那只紫黑色的怪物为「魔兽」，有什么特别的缘故吗？
text_loc: Professor Louis, I noticed you keep referring to that creature as a "monster". Is there any particular reason for that?

name: 路易斯
title: 学院导师
text: 我的措辞不够严谨，「紫黑魔兽」并非官方定性，而是民间称呼，和流行于这附近的传说有关……
text_loc: Loose phrasing on my part. "Dark Monster" isn't an official designation, but simply a local term. One tied to a legend that's been circulating around this area.

name: 恩佐
text: 传说？哦！对此我也略知一二——风眠山脉被从天而降的「紫黑魔兽」和它的三只仆从占领……
text_loc: A legend? Oh, I've actually come across that one—something about the Windrest Mountains being seized by a fallen Dark Monster and its three servants.

text: 原来早有描述？
text_loc: So there's a record of it?

text: 不是第一次作恶？
text_loc: It's done this before?

name: 路易斯
title: 学院导师
text: 嗯，传说这四只魔兽形貌恐怖，因此，这座山也被一些害怕的洛克们称为「魔窟」。
text_loc: Right. The legend describes four creatures of terrifying appearance. Some frightened Rocos even started calling these mountains the "Devil's Den."

name: 恩佐
text: 甚至……有一脉信仰邪恶的洛克成为了它的「信徒」，会专门带着精灵去山上参拜魔兽，用自己的魔力供养那家伙……
text_loc: And apparently... a lineage of Rocos who followed a dark faith became its disciples, making pilgrimages up the mountain with their Jini and feeding the creature their own magic.

text: 紫黑魔兽还有信徒？！
text_loc: It actually has disciples?

text: 牺牲自己供养邪魔吗……
text_loc: Feeding the evil...

name: 恩佐
text: 虽说不可思议，但对信徒来说，紫黑魔兽便是神明一般的存在……难道，它是什么真的王者吗？哼……
text_loc: Strange as it sounds, to those followers, the Dark Monster was something like a god. Makes you wonder... could it actually be some kind of true sovereign force? Some food for thought.

name: 路易斯
title: 学院导师
text: 原本都是捕风捉影的传说，不必挂在心上。我在意的是……故事里「紫黑色」的形容，倒和我们的所见吻合。这是否……能成为线索？
text_loc: It was all just folklore, however, so I never gave it much weight. What I find interesting is that the description of "dark violet" matches what we've seen with our own eyes. Could that be something to go on?

name: 恩佐
text: 嗯，追查精灵失踪时，商店街也发现了和魔兽类似的紫黑色残留。那气息甚是浓郁，确实是某种神秘的力量。
text_loc: Possibly. When I was tracking the missing Jini, we also found traces of that same dark violet residue around Merchant Town. The presence was strong. Definitely some kind of mysterious power at work.

name: 恩佐
text: 所以，山上那位，极大可能是被紫黑色力量污染了。但……目前证据链不充分，没法贸然下论断。
text_loc: Which means whatever's up on that mountain has almost certainly been corrupted by the violet energy. That said, we haven't established a clear linkage yet. I can't draw any firm conclusions.

name: 路易斯
title: 学院导师
text: 唉，我最担心的是……「紫黑魔兽」如果是真的某位「精灵王者」的话，它可能已经时日无多了……
text_loc: What worries me most is if the Dark Monster is actually some kind of Jini sovereign, it may not have much time left.

name: 路易斯
title: 学院导师
text: 对了，小同学，你去调查了受风灾影响的狂暴精灵，有没有发现什么线索？
text_loc: By the way, you went out to investigate the Jini affected by the winds, yes? Did you find anything useful?

text: 想起花花的昏迷
text_loc: Flowy's collapse.

text: 想起小刺头的癫狂
text_loc: Spike's frenzy.

text: 想起女王大人的躁动
text_loc: The Queen's rampage.

text: 仔细想想，无论是小刺头，花花，还是女王大人，它们都有个共同点……
text_loc: Come to think of it, Spike, Flowy, the Queen—they all had something in common.

name: 黑屏进入
text: |||<center>我同大家分享了自己的冒险记录，谈起了被紫黑色力量缠绕而发狂的精灵们。</>|||<center>他们变大变强，但也变得狂躁，直至失去理智。</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>I share my adventure notes with the group and describe the Jini that were consumed by the dark violet energy.</> |||<center>They grow larger and stronger, but lose themselves entirely in the process and become violent.</>|||

name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>那紫黑色力量……和刚刚所见「紫黑魔兽」身上所携一模一样。</>|||<center>这些缠上紫黑色力量而狂暴的精灵，原本无不例外，都栖息于风眠山之中。</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>That dark violet energy is identical to what we just saw on the Dark Monster.</> |||<center>Every single one of those Jini, without exception, once made their home somewhere in the Windrest Mountains.</>|||

name: 路易斯
title: 学院导师
text: 是的，如刚才所见，紫黑魔兽也来去于风眠山……
text_loc: Right. As we just witnessed, the Dark Monster itself comes and goes from those mountains.

name: 恩佐
text: 路易斯老师，刚才巨兽肆虐之际，我远远望见山顶风卷也跟着急剧变大……更加狂烈汹涌，充斥着闪电，是不是……
text_loc: Professor Louis, when the creature was rampaging just now, I could see the whirlwind at the summit surging, growing wilder, crackling with lightning. Could it be that...

name: 路易斯
title: 学院导师
text: 嗯，得致函学院，封锁山脉了！那么，恩佐！
text_loc: Yes. I need to send word to the Academy that the mountain range has to be sealed off. Enzir, since you're the Academy's appointed windstorm investigator...

text: 路易斯的眼神突然凝重了起来。
text_loc: Louis's expression turns serious.

name: 路易斯
title: 学院导师
text: 既然一切都指向风眠山，看来只有实地勘察，才能一探究竟。但这个任务，只能交给作为学院最强战力的你……
text_loc: With everything pointing to the Windrest Mountains, there's only one way to get to the bottom of this; someone has to go in. And that task can only go to the person the Academy specifically sent to handle it.

text: 恩佐？要代表学院进山？？紫黑色力量的实质依旧不清，太危险了吧！
text_loc: Enzir's going into the mountain alone? We know next to nothing about that violet energy, and the mountain is completely unknown territory. It's far too dangerous. Unless Enzir's abilities are...

name: 恩佐
text: ……谢谢路易斯老师的信任。我明白了，待我准备一下，便会进山调查。
text_loc: Understood. Thank you for trusting me, Professor Louis. I'll make my preparations and head into the mountain.

text: 恩佐给了我一个奇怪的眼色，他似乎……想要和我说什么？
text_loc: Enzir gives me a strange, knowing look like he has something he wants to say.

name: 恩佐
text: 晚上再见一次吧，我还有话和你说。
text_loc: Let's meet again tonight. I have something I need to tell you.

name: 恩佐
text: 找个安静的地方聊。
text_loc: I'll find somewhere quiet.

name: 恩佐
text: 你来了……还是和你单独见面，感觉比较自在。
text_loc: There you are. I feel more at ease talking to you one on one.

text: 你有点心事重重的，是怎么了？
text_loc: What's troubling you?

text: 恐怕……你不止是要和我告别吧
text_loc: What's really on your mind?

name: 恩佐
text: 在商店街，路易斯说，希望我单独进山调查……他的决定我自然遵守。但……
text_loc: At Merchant Town, Louis said he wants me to go into the mountain alone. I'll heed his orders, but...

name: 恩佐
text: 我确实有不同的考虑。
text_loc: I see things differently.

name: 恩佐
text: 这其中的原因，是你。
text_loc: The reason comes down to you.
Me?

name: 恩佐
text: 我最初觉得你是一个运气非凡的小洛克。但在和你一起合作经历了许多事情后，我意识到，运气的背后，其实是你潜藏的实力。
text_loc: At first I thought you were simply a remarkably lucky young Roco. But after everything we've been through together, I realized that luck was never a factor. It was ability, buried deep inside.

name: 恩佐
text: 于是我想，如果带你进山，或许能更好地完成使命，找到风灾的真相……现在，这种感觉越来越强烈了。
text_loc: So I started thinking... if I brought you into the mountain with me, we might have a better shot at uncovering the truth behind these winds. The more time passes, the more convinced I've become.

text: 你要劝我进山？！
text_loc: You want me to go?

name: 恩佐
text: 怎么，你似乎有点惊讶？以你的性格……绝不会对进山不感兴趣吧？
text_loc: Surprised? Given who you are... I'd have thought the chance to go in would be the last thing you'd turn down.

text: 可是学院禁止……
text_loc: But the Academy forbids it.

text: 可路易斯老师那边……
text_loc: But Professor Louis said...

name: 恩佐
text: ……路易斯？学院？哈哈——不必拘泥于外在的规则……重要的是，你的意愿。
text_loc: Louis? The Academy? Ha. All these rules are mere scaffolding around what really matters, which is what you actually want.

name: 恩佐
text: 先前的同行，已经让我知道，你绝非一般的孩子……
text_loc: Everything we've done together has shown me that you're no ordinary kid.

text: 也许我很普通呢？
text_loc: Maybe I am ordinary.

text: 我哪里特别？
text_loc: What makes me so special?

name: 恩佐
text: 那只蓝色的精灵，不就是最好的证明吗？如果我没猜错的话，那恐怕就是……
text_loc: That blue Jini of yours is proof enough, isn't it? If I'm right about what it is...

name: 恩佐
text: 哼……我还看到，它似乎对风卷、对山脉的真相……充满兴趣。
text_loc: I've also noticed it seems deeply drawn to the whirlwind, to whatever is hiding in that mountain.

name: 恩佐
text: 在紫黑魔兽离去之时，它曾自顾自地跳出来，朝着山脉怒吼吧？！
text_loc: When the Dark Monster withdrew, it jumped out and roared at the mountain. You saw it yourself...

name: 恩佐
text: 呼，如果是我的精灵……我或许会带着它进山，看看它究竟要探寻什么秘密呢……
text_loc: If it were my Jini, I'd want to take it along and find out what it's looking for in that mountain.

name: 恩佐
text: 不必露出那么惊讶的表情……你充满秘密，在这点上，我们是相似的。
text_loc: No need to look so shocked. You're full of secrets, and in that sense, we're alike.

name: 恩佐
text: 我们想要追寻的，不过是那看起来神秘又危险的……蒙着紫黑色阴影的真相……不是吗？
text_loc: We're both after the same thing: the truth hiding behind that dark violet shadow. Aren't we?

text: 恩佐锐利的眼神，让我感到有些发毛，他似乎看穿了我一般，让我没有理由拒绝……
text_loc: The sharpness in Enzir's gaze makes my skin crawl a little. It's as if he can see straight through me, and I have no good excuse left to say no.

name: 恩佐
text: 时候也不早了，我们得尽快进山。只是，山脉已经被封锁，山口设置了守卫，明面上你我不能一起进入。
text_loc: It's getting late. We need to move. The mountain's been sealed, though—there are guards at the entrance, so we can't waltz in there together.

name: 恩佐
text: 因此，我们需要分开行动，我会在山口内与你汇合。
text_loc: We'll go in separately. I'll meet you just inside past the entrance.

name: 黑屏
text: 接近山脉，星盘突然无序地开始颤动，旋即，迪莫跳了出来。
text_loc: As we approach the mountain, the Stardial begins trembling erratically. Then Dimo leaps out.

name: 迪莫
text: 迪莫……迪莫——！！
text_loc: Dimo... Dimo!

text: 迪莫吼叫着，和之前一样，看起来非常不安。它似乎非常在意山脉内的情况。
text_loc: Dimo is howling, same as before, clearly unsettled. It seems intensely focused on whatever is happening inside that mountain.

text: 无论如何，如恩佐所说，探查是对的，或许……真相和迪莫这小家伙也有关系。
text_loc: Either way, Enzir's right that going in to investigate is the right call. And the truth might be connected to Dimo somehow too.

name: 恩佐
text: 所以……你躲过了守卫的眼睛？还是……你击败了他们？无论如何，这确实是我对你的小小考验……
text_loc: So, you slipped past the guards? Or did you put them down for the count? Either way, consider it a small test I set for you, and you passed.

name: 恩佐
text: 哈哈，对你来说也不是难事吧？接下来，或许会遇到更多麻烦呢……
text_loc: Haha, I imagine it wasn't much of a challenge for you. What comes next might be a little rougher, though.

name: 恩佐
text: 你看，如此巨大的风车也被毁坏了，这也是紫黑魔兽的「杰作」吧。
text_loc: Look. Even a structure this massive lies completely destroyed. Another one of the Dark Monster's "masterpieces."

text: 巨大的破坏力……
text_loc: Such destructive power...

text: 某种绝对的力量将风车扭成了夸张的废墟，痕迹粗砺而锐利，似乎是一击而致。
text_loc: Some force has twisted the windmill into a grotesque wreck. The marks are jagged and deep, the kind of damage that comes from a single strike.

name: 恩佐
text: 仔细感受的话……山内的空气，似乎和外面也有一些细微的区别，湿润而粘稠，微微刺鼻。
text_loc: Pay attention to the air in here. It's subtly different from outside. Damp, heavy, faintly sharp.

text: 紫黑魔兽，就栖息在此地……
text_loc: The Dark Monster lives here.

name: 恩佐
text: 我很好奇，如果紫黑魔兽是被污染了，为何如此执着于风眠山，不愿离去？袭击商店街，似乎是不合常理的行为……
text_loc: What I find curious is this: if the Dark Monster is corrupted, why does it cling so stubbornly to Windrest Mountain? The attack on Merchant Town felt out of character.

text: 它确实有可能是受害者
text_loc: It could be the victim here.

name: 恩佐
text: 风眠山……有什么……它无法舍弃的东西吗？或者，它保护的东西？
text_loc: What does Windrest Mountain hold for it? Is it something it can't leave behind? Or something it's protecting?

name: 恩佐
text: 加害者？那它不应该只破坏商店街……而是会大肆袭击各地不是吗？以它的力量……从目前的受灾情况看来，它似乎在克制……
text_loc: If it were purely an aggressor, it wouldn't stop at Merchant Town. It would be striking everywhere. Considering its power and based on the scope of damage we've seen, it seems to be holding back.

name: 恩佐
text: 难道，我们都误会它了，它来到商店街，不是想要袭击，而是想要求援？！风卷，也是一个求救信号？
text_loc: What if we've had it backwards all along? What if it didn't come to Merchant Town to attack, but to ask for help? And the whirlwind is actually a distress signal?

text: 恩佐的推测……虽然乍一听起来感觉很不可思议，但仔细想想，确实也有它的道理……
text_loc: Enzir's theory sounds outlandish at first, but the more I mull it over, the more it makes sense in a strange way.

name: 恩佐
text: 对了，你的蓝色精灵，状态还好吗？
text_loc: By the way, how's your blue Jini doing?

text: 它在山口附近又出来了一次
text_loc: It came out near the entrance.

name: 恩佐
text: 出来了？唔，此处与它似有渊源……甚至，有什么它遗留的东西吗？否则，反应不会如此激烈……
text_loc: It came out? Hmm. Something here is resonating with it... or maybe there's something it left behind. Otherwise the reaction wouldn't be this strong.

name: 恩佐
text: 哎，以目前的信息量，推论到这个程度已经是极限了。接下来，我们得实际开始探测，才能掌握更多的信息。
text_loc: We're nearing the limit of what I can theorize with what we have. From here, we explore. It's the only way to get more answers.

name: 恩佐
text: 我感觉这里的空气和水源都受到了污染，我打算从研究植物性状的变化开始，着手收集素材。
text_loc: The air and water here both feel contaminated. I'll start by studying how the local plant life has been affected.

name: 恩佐
text: {name}，我去采集土壤样本，你可以帮我采集一些受影响的植物样本，以便后续研究吗？
text_loc: {name}, I'm going to collect soil samples. Can you gather some affected plant specimens for me? It'll help with the analysis.

text: 它也有可能是加害者
text_loc: It could be the aggressor.

text: 恩佐？
text_loc: Enzir?

text: 怎么不见了？
text_loc: Where did he go?

text: |||<center>尝试呼唤恩佐……</>|||<center>但回应我的，只有回音，孱弱得仿佛被雾气吸收殆尽。</>
text_loc: |||<center>I call out for Enzir...</> |||<center>But all I hear back is my own faint echo swallowed up by the fog.</>

text: 突如其来的诡异而浓厚的雾气，断绝了我和恩佐的联系。
text_loc: A thick, sudden fog has cut me off from Enzir completely.

text: 我得去找到他……
text_loc: I have to find him.

text: 什么？迪莫蹦了出来，似乎是对这里有印象一般，开始给我引路……
text_loc: Suddenly, Dimo leaps out of nowhere and starts leading the way, as if it's familiar with this place.

text: 迪莫在给我指引道路……
text_loc: Dimo is guiding me.

text: 感觉前方有点阴森呢，不过有它陪着我，也没有那么害怕了。
text_loc: The sacred mountain just tried to drive me out. So why can Dimo still lead me forward?

name: 神秘的声音
text: |||<center>迷途的旅人，你不听劝诫——一错再错——擅入此地——</>
text_loc: |||<center>Wandering traveler, you heed no warning. Again and again you err. You trespass here.</>

name: 神秘的声音
text: |||<center>我们会作为见证者，降下灾厄！</>
text_loc: |||<center>We stand as witness. Calamity shall descend.</>

name: 神秘的声音
text: |||<Center>禁止——禁止——禁止进入！！神明的圣地！</>
text_loc: |||<Center>Halt! Halt! This is sacred ground.</>

name: 神秘的声音
text: |||<Center>现在回头，还来得及！速速离去！</>
text_loc: |||<Center>Turn back now while you still can. Leave at once.</>

text: 那么粗砺空灵的声音，发出它的……居然是这么一个小东西吗？
text_loc: That voice was so rough and otherworldly. And yet the one making it is something this tiny?

name: 小小记忆石
text: 噼啪噼啪——噼啪！（张牙舞爪，似乎在表达不满）
text_loc: Klak klak, klak! *puffs up, clearly furious*

name: 小小记忆石
text: 噼啪噼啪——风绵……升所——闯？噼啪噼啪！噼啪噼啪！
text_loc: Klak klak — Weedlest... Sankchoo... trespass? Klak klak! Klak klak!

text: 风眠圣所？
text_loc: Windrest Sanctuary?

text: 它一瞟一瞟的……顺着眼神看过去……那就是……呃，「风眠圣所」？它是担心我闯进远处这个门吗？
text_loc: It keeps glancing over to something... Is that the Windrest Sanctuary? Is it worried I'm about to barge through that door over there?

name: 小小记忆石
text: 噼啪噼啪！黑伊芙！噼啪！！（看到我注意到风眠圣所，似乎更急了，作出了攻击的架势）
text_loc: Klak klak! Blake robos! Klak! *spots me noticing the Windrest Sanctuary, panics even more and adopts a fighting stance*

text: 黑伊芙……啊？黑衣服！它说的是……黑巫师？！它——把我和那群家伙当成一伙了？
text_loc: "Blake robos?" Wait... Black robes! Is it talking about the Dark Wizards? It thinks I'm one of them?

name: 小小记忆石
text: 噼啪噼啪——噼啪噼啪——（突然露出坚毅的眼神）
text_loc: Klak klak— klak— *eyes go firm and resolute*

text: 哎，你别误会啊！
text_loc: Hey, you've got it all wrong!

name: 神秘的声音
text: |||<Center>守卫圣所！——守卫圣所！</>
text_loc: |||<Center>Guard the Sanctuary! Guard the Sanctuary!</>

name: 神秘的声音
text: |||<Center>清除洛克！——清除洛克！</>
text_loc: |||<Center>Drive out the Rocos! Drive out the Rocos!</>

name: 小小记忆石
text: 咔哒咔哒——咔哒咔哒！
text_loc: Klak-klak, klak-klak!

text: 嗯……小小一只记忆石，现在看起来老实了不少，但还是恶狠狠地瞪着我。
text_loc: The little Remnstone has calmed down considerably, though it's still glaring daggers at me.

text: 仔细看看，眼泪在眼眶里打转，好像被欺负了一般，完全没有了刚才的气势。
text_loc: Looking more closely, though, there are tears welling up in its eyes. It looks like it's been through something awful. All that ferocity from a moment ago is completely gone.

name: 伊里斯
text: 咦？你……你怎么在这里！
text_loc: Huh? What are you doing here?

text: 声音……是伊里斯？！
text_loc: That voice... is that Irys?

text: 伊里斯！
text_loc: Irys!

name: 伊里斯
text: 我说你，居然没头没脑地进山脉里来了，怎么一回事？
text_loc: What on earth possessed you to wander into the mountains? What's going on?

name: 黑屏
text: 将迪莫的反应，自己受邀进山，恩佐却在起雾之后不明去向的情况，一股脑儿告知了伊里斯。
text_loc: You fill Irys in on everything: Dimo's reaction, the invitation to come in, and how the fog cut you off from Enzir.

name: 伊里斯
text: 风眠迷雾……那你们走散了也正常。可恩佐那家伙，到底在想什么？
text_loc: The Windrest Fog... that would explain why you got separated. But what is Enzir thinking, pulling a stunt like this?

text: 我自己也想来……
text_loc: I wanted to come too.

text: 我也挺纳闷……
text_loc: You're telling me.

name: 伊里斯
text: 不过没关系，好在我和你碰上了……时间紧迫，我先问问小石头情况。
text_loc: Either way, I'm glad I ran into you. We don't have much time. Let me check in with Rockie first.

name: 伊里斯
text: 小石头？不哭，告诉伊里斯，发生了什么？今天怎么是你守卫圣所？你的师父，那只大记忆石呢？
text_loc: Enough crying, Rockie. Tell me what happened. Why are you the one standing guard at the Sanctuary today? Where's your master, the elder Remnstone?

name: 小小记忆石
text: 噼啪噼啪……噼啪……盛迪……噼啪（颤抖着说了什么，眼泪都快溢出来了）
text_loc: Klak-klak... klak... alter... klak. *trembles, barely holding back tears*

name: 伊里斯
text: 你是说，你的师父去净化被污染的圣羽祭台了？所以今天，才由你来看守关隘……
text_loc: Your master went to purify the corrupted Holyfeathers Temple? So you've been left to hold the gate alone today...

name: 小小记忆石
text: 噼啪噼啪……噼啪……盛迪……噼啪（眼泪越掉越多）
text_loc: Klak-klak... klak... klak. *sobs openly*

name: 伊里斯
text: 什么？！紫黑色……雾气，黑衣服洛克？圣地被侵入了！可恶，它们果然紧追不放……
text_loc: What? Dark violet fog... and Rocos in black robes? The sacred grounds have been breached. Of course they wouldn't stop here.

name: 伊里斯
text: 小同学，还记得吗？我们在三镇遇到的精灵，大概也是被这能量污染，才纷纷逃离出山。
text_loc: Do you remember the Jini we encountered across the three towns? They were most likely driven out of the mountains by this same energy that's corrupting them.

text: 是那些黑衣人干的！
text_loc: Those hooded figures did this!

text: 是那种力量污染的！
text_loc: The dark power did it!

name: 伊里斯
text: 嗯，没想到，黑衣人竟然已经深入了山脉各个区域。那群家伙使用的能量……很强大，看来圣地也快沦陷了……
text_loc: So the hooded figures have already pushed deep into the mountain range. Whatever power they're wielding is formidable. It looks like even the sacred grounds are close to falling.

name: 小小记忆石
text: 噼啪噼啪！噼啪噼啪……（看到伊里斯陷入思索的样子了，不知所措地大哭起来）
text_loc: Klak klak! Klak klak... *sees Irys lost in thought and breaks into helpless, uncontrollable sobbing*

name: 伊里斯
text: 对方的人数众多，使用的能量也很古怪……双拳难敌四手，难道……只能这样了吗？！可恶！
text_loc: They outnumber us, and their energy is unlike anything I've seen before. Outmanned and outgunned... is this really it?

text: 我得想想办法！
text_loc: I need to find a way...

text: 我也想给大家出力！
text_loc: I want to help too.

text: 自来熟到略带轻浮的伊里斯，居然有这么无奈的时候……如果……如果能有我可以做的……
text_loc: Seeing Irys like this, the most unflappable person I've ever met, completely at a loss... something in me stirs. If there's anything I can do...

name: 黑屏
text: 迪莫……迪莫……
text_loc: Dimo... Dimo...

name: 黑屏
text: 就在此时，我的包里突然有什么冲破而出——熟悉的蓝色身影……是迪莫？
text_loc: Something bursts out of my bag. That familiar blue shape—Dimo?

name: 伊里斯
text: 什么？又是这只蓝色精灵……！小石头，这只蓝色精灵，很眼熟吧！
text_loc: Wait, this blue Jini again! Rockie, you recognize it, don't you?

name: 小小记忆石
text: 噼啪噼啪！！噼啪！迪！么！…阿……瑟……
text_loc: Klak klak! Klak! Dee—mo! ...Ar... thiel...

name: 伊里斯
text: 唔，我明白了，小同学！你是为了找到和它有渊源的那两件东西，才闯进山里的吗……
text_loc: Ah. I think I understand now. You came into the mountain to find the two things connected to Dimo, didn't you?

name: 伊里斯
text: 对此我确实略知一二……和这蓝色精灵有关联的那两个东西，分别被保管在两位「精灵王眷属」手中！
text_loc: As it happens, I do know something about this. The two items connected to this blue Jini are each kept by one of the two Jini King Attendants.

name: 伊里斯
text_loc: Hm... items... items... Yes! The keys!

text: 眷属？钥匙？怎么没头没脑的……
text_loc: Attendants? Keys? What?

name: 伊里斯
text: 圣所是通往山脉深处的唯一通路，如今主人既不在，能开启通路的「钥匙」，正是那两枚物件了！
text_loc: The Sanctuary is the only path leading into the heart of the mountain. With its master gone, the only things that can open the way are those two items.

name: 伊里斯
text: 嗯……我有了一个新的想法……或许——这就是转机！
text_loc: Hm... I just had a thought. And I believe it might be exactly the opening we need.

name: 伊里斯
text: ——小同学，我们兵分两路！我去祭台那边援助小石头的师父，你去眷属处，取来那两枚钥匙！
text_loc: Here's what we do; we split up. I'll head to the altar to back up Rockie's master, and you go find the Attendants and retrieve both keys.

text: 哈？我？
text_loc: Wait, me?

name: 伊里斯
text: 不用害怕！我恰巧和那两名眷属都有一面之缘，可以现写两封推荐信给你。
text_loc: Don't worry. I happen to know both Attendants personally. I can write you a letter of introduction right here and now.

text: 有推荐信？暂且相信你……
text_loc: Okay, go ahead then.

text: 那我可以大摇大摆去了
text_loc: Then it's all fine.

name: 伊里斯
text: 咳咳，深呼吸……小同学，也别没头没脑地冲……
text_loc: Ahem. Deep breath, Irys... Please don't charge in recklessly.

name: 伊里斯
text: 纯粹的精灵世界，确实不比洛克足迹遍布的地方，眷属们不一定都有欢迎外来者的心胸和气魄。
text_loc: The Jini world differs radically from any other place Rocos normally roam. The Attendants are not exactly prone to rolling out the red carpet for outsiders.

name: 伊里斯
text: 咱们也必须做好面对危险的准备！
text_loc: We must be prepared in case things go sideways.

text: 那推荐信的作用呢……
text_loc: What about those letters though?

text: 被……赶出去的那种？
text_loc: Will I be thrown out?

name: 伊里斯
text: 呃……有我的三寸不烂之舌……嗯，这样的推荐信，一定……也许……能让你获得稍微……好一点……的对待？
text_loc: With the full weight of my silver tongue behind them, these letters will certainly... or, probably, get you treated at least... somewhat better?

name: 伊里斯
text: 呃……总之……行动目标……我会为你……记录到……手册里……
text_loc: Uh, anyway, your objectives... Right, I'll just add them to your handbook...

text: 怎么回事……声音越来越小，吐字越来越虚……？
text_loc: Hs voice is fading. The words are getting harder to make out.

name: 伊里斯
text: 我很欣慰，你居然……能够做到这个地步，果然我没看走眼。
text_loc: I'm glad you made it this far. I knew I hadn't misjudged you.

name: 伊里斯
text: 你和那小家伙的关系，也越来越好了吧？那两件东西，果然是它的……
text_loc: You and that Jini are getting closer, aren't you? Those two items—they really do belong to it.

text: 是的，迪莫……
text_loc: Yeah. Dimo...

name: 伊里斯
text: 你看，这就是圣所——
text_loc: Take a look. This is the Sanctuary.

name: 伊里斯
text: 接下来，待我们准备完成，就是时候……呼——进去一探究竟了。
text_loc: Once we're ready, it's time to... phew... go inside and see what we're dealing with.

text: 你还好吗？
text_loc: Are you okay?

text: 你怎么了？看起来有点怪
text_loc: You seem out of sorts.

name: 伊里斯
text: 我没事……只是……有点担心里面的情况。
text_loc: I'm fine... just a little worried about what's waiting for us inside.

name: 伊里斯
text: 但暂时我们还没法进去，需要等鸭子和莎莎做好完成「仪式」的准备。
text_loc: We can't go in yet anyway. We need to wait for Elson Drake and Furisha to finish preparing for the ritual.

name: 伊里斯
text: 在这段时间里，也让我们努力磨砺自己，做到万无一失才好！
text_loc: In the meantime, let's make the most of it and sharpen ourselves up. We can't afford to leave anything to chance.

name: 麦克达克
text: 嘎嘎？就那家伙……本鸭不信！莎莎你的占卜到底准不准啊，我看那孩子顶多就是勇敢了点，能拯救翼王？本鸭还是保留观点……
text_loc: Quack? That kid? I'm not buying it! Sasha, how reliable is your divination, really? I'll concede that they're bold, but saving the King of Flight? I still have my reservations.

name: 法瑞莎莎
text: 麦克达克……潮汐的声音，月相，草木的痕迹都告诉我……未来的光芒……就在{gender:他,她}的身上。
text_loc: Elson Drake, the voice of the tides, the phases of the moon, the marks on the trees, all of it tells me the same thing. The light of what's to come rests in {gender:him,her}.

name: 麦克达克
text: 洗喙水的哗啦哗啦声……天上明晃晃大饼的圆缺……臭臭水草的泥巴痕迹……？！
text_loc: You mean, the splashing of beak-washing water, the big shiny moon-pie going round, and the muddy marks from stinky water weeds?

name: 法瑞莎莎
text: 不愧是麦克达克先生的品味呢~
text_loc: You certainly have a way with words, Mr. Drake.

name: 伊里斯
text: 哈哈，我看你们都别急，毕竟目前，除了依靠{gender:他,她}，我们束手无策，不是吗？
text_loc: Now then, let's all calm down. The truth is, right now, there's no one else we can count on other than {gender:him,her}. Isn't that right?

name: 伊里斯
text: 虽然那孩子究竟如何，没人敢下断言，但可以确定的是……
text_loc: None of us can say for certain what that kid is capable of. But one thing is clear.

name: 伊里斯
text: 光之精灵是如此的确信，坚定地选择了{gender:他,她}。
text_loc: The Jini of Light chose {gender:him,her} with complete certainty. No hesitation whatsoever.

text: 光之精灵？是在说……迪莫？
text_loc: You mean Dimo?

name: 麦克达克
text: ……哎，小孩，来都来了，怎么还有怪习惯，躲在那里偷偷听！
text_loc: ...Hey, kid. You're already here, so there's no need to eavesdrop.

text: 嘿嘿，不是故意的啦......
text_loc: Hehe, sorry...

text: 谁叫你们声音那么大嘛
text_loc: It's just that you were so loud.

name: 伊里斯
text: 嗯，我都听眷属们说了，你帮助了它们，也顺利拿到了钥匙。我没看错，你确实是神奇的孩子。
text_loc: The Attendants have told me everything—you helped them both and retrieved the keys. I never doubted you. You really are something extraordinary.

text: 还有点不好意思......
text_loc: You're making me blush.

text: 天才洛克登场
text_loc: Yes, that's me!

name: 伊里斯
text: 我给你的手册课题，也百分百地完成了，很好。
text_loc: And you completed all the handbook assignments I gave you. Well done.

name: 伊里斯
text: 圣羽祭台……我也稳定住了局面，虽然……只是暂时。我猜，不出多久，那里的防御就会瓦解。
text_loc: The Holyfeathers Temple... I managed to stabilize things over there, though only temporarily. I'd give it a short while before the defenses there come apart.

text: 暂时？
text_loc: Temporarily?

name: 伊里斯
text: 时间不多，我们需要尽快进入风眠圣所。
text_loc: We don't have much time. We need to get into Windrest Sanctuary as soon as possible.

name: 伊里斯
text: 不仅要探查风灾的源头，还必须…
text_loc: Not just to find the source of the wind disaster. We also have to...

name: 伊里斯
text: 呼——拯救「紫黑魔兽」。
text_loc: Save the Dark Monster.

text: 拯救……那只破坏了商店街的精灵吗？
text_loc: Save what now? The thing that tore through Merchant Town?

name: 伊里斯
text: 小同学，你大概也猜到了，那位被噩梦力量污染的紫黑魔兽，正是这座山脉的守护者——「翼系精灵王」里奥。
text_loc: You've probably already guessed, but the Dark Monster corrupted by the Nightmare energy is actually the guardian of this mountain range. The Wing-Type Jini King: Lyel.

name: 伊里斯
text: 我们要去它的藏身所——风卷的中心看看情况。
text_loc: We're going to where it's been hiding—the center of the whirlwind.

name: 伊里斯
text: 穿过这座圣所，便能抵达翼王的所在。
text_loc: Through this Sanctuary is the only way to reach the King of Flight.

name: 伊里斯
text: 哈哈，别担心，还有伊里斯我保护你。你看，两位翼王的眷属也来到了这里，协助我们。
text_loc: But, don't worry. You've got Irys watching your back. And look, both of the King of Flight's Attendants have come to help.

text: 协助?
text_loc: Help how?

name: 法瑞莎莎
text: 风眠圣所，很久之前，是翼王的信徒为它建立的行宫，里面贯通了自由自在的风。
text_loc: The Windrest Sanctuary was built long ago by the King of Flight's devotees as a place of refuge. The wind that flows through it runs free.

name: 法瑞莎莎
text: 就算我们集齐了钥匙，开启圣所，也还需要一道眷属们才知道的特殊魔法仪式。
text_loc: Even with all the keys gathered and the Sanctuary unsealed, there is still one more step to take; a special ritual known only to the Attendants.

name: 法瑞莎莎
text: 我和麦克达克来到此地，就是为了合力打开禁制，希望你带着我们的祝福和愿望，勇敢往前走。
text_loc: Elson Drake and I came here to open the seal together. Our hope is that you carry our blessings and our wishes with you, and walk forward without fear.

name: 麦克达克
text: 嘎哈！我们可不是来看热闹的！也让我们，成为你的力量吧！嘎嘎！
text_loc: Quack! We didn't come all this way just to watch. Let our presence give you strength out there! Quack quack!

name: 法瑞莎莎
text: 好的，小朋友，不用害怕，放轻松，拿出你的钥匙——
text_loc: There's no need to be nervous. Take a breath, and bring out your keys.

name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>我拿出了从麦克达克那里获得的古怪斗篷，斗篷上放着从法瑞莎莎那里得到的王冠。</>|||<center>这两个东西，虽然一直被称作「钥匙」，长得却一点没有钥匙的样子</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>You pull out the peculiar cloak obtained from Elson Drake, with the crown from Farisha resting on top of it.</> |||<center>These two items are what they meant by "keys" this entire time—though neither looks anything like one.</>|||

name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>法瑞莎莎施展了一个柔和的水法阵，和麦克达克的绿色法阵一起，斗篷和王冠发出了璀璨的光芒。</>|||<CENTER>圣所的门似乎发生了什么变化！</>|||<center>但……没等我看清，一股狂风突然自法阵中喷薄而出，环绕了我。</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>Farisha weaves a gentle water formation, and Elson Drake's green one rises alongside it. The cloak and crown blaze with brilliant light.</> |||<CENTER>Something shifts at the Sanctuary's gate.</> |||<center>But before you can make out what it is, a great gust tears out of the formations and wraps itself around you.</>|||

name: 咒语
text: |||<center>远风破除迷障。</>|||<center>闪星引向彼方。</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>Winds from afar, scatter the veil.</> |||<center>Twinkling stars, carry the traveler onward.</>|||

name: 咒语
text: |||<center>以天空为凭，借风之主名，伟大的翼羽之主！</>|||<center>万风来降，听凭号令，愿风与翼的旅者——雾霭皆明，祛除尘蔽！</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>By the sky, in the name of the Wind's Master—great Sovereign of Wings and Feathers!</> |||<center>Breezes and gales, heed this call. May the traveler of wind and wings find all mists lifted, and all shadows cleared!</>|||

text: 身体很通透，似乎被温暖包裹，这就是眷属们「开启门扉」的仪式吗……
text_loc: The warm sensation moves through you as if something is opening up inside. So this is the Attendants' ritual to unseal the gate...

text: 准备好之后就进入风眠圣所吧！
text_loc: When you're ready, enter Windrest Sanctuary.

name: 魔法石
title: <Blue>圣所记录者</>
text: 魔法石——启动——启动......瞻仰者，请阅览——
text_loc: Memostone activating. Visitor, please observe.

name: 魔法石
title: <Blue>圣所记录者</>
text: 我是承载着记忆的容器，由翼王的信仰者记载于星历一三......沙沙，在千万年后，瞻仰者，你或许会发现我——
text_loc: I am a vessel of memory, inscribed by a follower of the King of Flight in stellar year thirteen... *crackles* Visitor, you may yet find me, in ten thousand years time.

text: 好像和先前的魔法石相似
text_loc: Another Memostone.

text: 这是翼王信仰者的记录？
text_loc: A record left by the followers?

text: 信仰者很久之前就存在？
text_loc: The followers go back that far?

name: 魔法石
title: <Blue>圣所记录者</>
text: 识别瞻仰者的发声——滋滋，识别失败，请注意，本魔法石只能提供特定词汇的解答。
text_loc: Attempting to identify visitor's voice—bzzzt, identification failed. Note: this Memostone can only respond to specific terms.

text: 那就听听这里的故事吧
text_loc: Just play me what's here.

name: 魔法石
title: <Blue>圣所记录者</>
text: 播放继续——「如你所见，这是翼系王者远离家园来到此处，最初的故事——」
text_loc: Resuming playback. "As you see here, this is how it began. The story of the Wing-Type sovereign's long journey from home."

name: 魔法石
title: <Blue>圣所记录者</>
text: 翼王选择这里，是因为风眠山脉存在「风眼」，传说风眼有着独特的作用，能消解翼王体内的紫黑色「魇力」。
text_loc: The King of Flight chose this place because the Windrest Mountains hold a Wind Eye, said to hold a unique power to draw out and dissolve the Malforce that had taken root inside the King.

text: 紫黑色？听描述，「魇力」好像和噩梦能量类似……不过，它居然那么早就污染了翼王？……
text_loc: Dark violet? From the description, Malforce sounds a lot like Nightmare energy. So was it already corrupting the King of Flight back then?

text: 「魇力」？耐人寻味的名字
text_loc: "Malforce"? What a name.

name: 魔法石
