title: <Blue>圣所记录者</>
text: 翼王庇佑我等信众，为风眠山一带施与安宁。我等感激翼王，衷心希望它恢复后，以王者之姿重返家园——「天空城」。
text_loc: The King of Flight watched over us, its faithful followers, and brought peace to the Windrest Mountains. In gratitude, we hope with all our hearts to see the King restored and returned to its home—the Celestial Citadel.

name: 魔法石
title: <Blue>圣所记录者</>
text: 为了表达尊重和感恩，我等信众为翼王在此建立了圣所，作为它消解污染时的安顿之所……
text_loc: As a gesture of devotion and gratitude, we built this Sanctuary for the King, a place for it to rest while purging the corruption.

name: 魔法石
title: <Blue>圣所记录者</>
text: 此外，翼王以精灵王之力铸成的，代表洛克与精灵之誓的「星之结」，也被翼王自天空城挪移至此。
text_loc: And the Star Knot—forged by the King of Flight's sovereign power, a symbol of the bond between Roco and Jini—was also brought here from the Celestial Citadel by the King itself.

text: 星之结？那是什么
text_loc: What is the Star Knot?

name: 魔法石
title: <Blue>圣所记录者</>
text: 识别特定词汇「星之结」。这枚星之结，藏于圣所最深之处——它是翼王的力量中枢，也是消解「魇力」的装置。
text_loc: Identifying term: "Star Knot." The Star Knot rests at the deepest point of the Sanctuary. It is the King of Flight's core of power, and the device which dissolves the Malforce.

name: 魔法石
title: <Blue>圣所记录者</>
text: 心意相通……永不离弃。将洛克和精灵所创造的祈愿源源不断地注入星之结，便能帮助翼王消解污染。
text_loc: Hearts in harmony, never to part. By channeling the wishes of Rocos and Jini into the Star Knot, the King's corruption can be gradually expunged.

text: 我明白了，很久之前，翼王就被「魇力」，也就是噩梦能量所污染，不得不到风眼净化自己。
text_loc: So the King of Flight was already infected by Malforce, namely the Nightmare energy, long ago, and came here to the Wind Eye to purify itself.

text: 如今黑暗再度降临，圣所深处的那枚「星之结」，不知道还在吗？为何不再如千百年前一般，持续提供净化之力呢？
text_loc: But now darkness has come again. Is the Star Knot still intact somewhere deep in the Sanctuary? Why has it stopped providing its cleansing power, the way it did for so many centuries?

text: 或许……壁画还有后续？
text_loc: Maybe there's more to the mural.

name: 魔法石
title: <Blue>圣所记录者</>
text: 启动——启动......我是圣所的见证者，也是翼王的信仰者，前来瞻仰的信徒啊，请阅览——
text_loc: Activating— I am witness to the Sanctuary, and a faithful follower of the King of Flight. Pilgrim, please observe.

text: 完全不同的色调……
text_loc: The colors are different...

text: 内容连得上前一幅壁画？
text_loc: Does it connect to the last one?

name: 魔法石
title: <Blue>圣所记录者</>
text: 识别瞻仰者的发声——滋滋，识别失败，请注意，本魔法石只能提供特定词汇的解答。
text_loc: Attempting to identify visitor's voice—bzzzt, identification failed. Note: this Memostone can only respond to specific terms.

name: 魔法石
title: <Blue>圣所记录者</>
text: 播放继续——「如你所见，这是黑暗之影降临，侵蚀卡洛西亚这片净土的故事——」
text_loc: Resuming playback. "As you see here, this is the story of how the shadow of darkness descended and began to consume the land of Kalosia."

text: 黑暗之影，是噩梦的实体？
text_loc: What's the shadow of darkness?

text: 确实是上幅壁画的延续
text_loc: It picks up from the last mural.

name: 魔法石
title: <Blue>圣所记录者</>
text: 原本翼王已在风眼处借助星之结所聚集的祈愿之力，消除了自身污染。但它无法返回天空城。因为两百年前，新的污染降临了——
text_loc: The King of Flight had already cleansed itself at the Wind Eye, drawing on the wishes gathered by the Star Knot. But it could not return to the Celestial Citadel. Two hundred years ago, a new wave of corruption arrived.

name: 魔法石
title: <Blue>圣所记录者</>
text: 这次，那魇力如同天外来物……比有史以来任何污染都来得更加浓烈，无序地蔓延，不被控制地激增……
text_loc: This Malforce was like nothing that had come before; denser, more violent, spreading without pattern, multiplying beyond all control.

name: 魔法石
title: <Blue>圣所记录者</>
text: 乃至最后拥有了实体，化为邪物在黑云中翻滚。此时，四处涌现出神秘的黑袍巫师，纷纷设坛祝祷——
text_loc: Eventually it took on a new form; a dark thing churning through storm clouds. And with it came robed figures appearing everywhere, setting up altars and performing rites.

text: 这么说，壁画中，云中若隐若现的巨大虚影，就是噩梦力量的来源？它的实体，是一只难以形容的精灵？！它是从哪里生出来的？
text_loc: So the vast shape barely visible through the clouds in the mural... that's the source of the Nightmare energy. Its physical form is some kind of Jini beyond description. But where did it come from?

text: 黑袍巫师——估计就是黑巫师。这个组织在两百年前，居然就已经存在了。
text_loc: Those robed figures have to be the Dark Wizards. To think they were already active two hundred years ago...

name: 魔法石
title: <Blue>圣所记录者</>
text: 但……黑暗终有尽头！如你所见，那个洛克出现了，精灵们都甘愿追随他，决心拼上一切！
text_loc: But darkness does not last forever. As you can see, a Roco appeared. And Jini from across the land chose to follow, ready to give everything.

text: 又是这个人！
text_loc: Him again!

text: 神秘洛克？壁画中所描绘的灾难，和先前在守护地所见，神秘青年和精灵们合力对抗黑暗的记载，是同一个故事。
text_loc: A mysterious Roco? The disaster depicted in these murals is the same story as what we saw recorded at the shrines. A young stranger and a group of Jini, defiantly standing together against the darkness.

text: 沉睡在星盘中的迪莫，似乎动了动……
text_loc: Dimo, asleep inside the Stardial, stirs slightly.

text: 这也是和你相关的回忆吧
text_loc: This must involve you too.

text: 话说回来，这位洛克还真是厉害啊，到处都有他的身影……不会下一张壁画还有吧……
text_loc: That Roco really does get around. There's a trace of him everywhere. Please tell me there isn't another mural...

text: 伊里斯看起来……在等我？这家伙，一进风眠圣所就无影无踪，没想到，在这里闷头看壁画呢……
text_loc: Irys looks like he's been waiting. The moment we stepped inside Windrest Sanctuary, he vanished, and here he is, quietly absorbed in the murals.

name: 伊里斯
text: 哟吼……你也到啦？……这下，我们距离拯救翼王又近了一步。
text_loc: Well, well, you made it. We're one step closer to saving the King of Flight.

name: 伊里斯
text: 若是我的猜想正确的话……
text_loc: If my hunch is right...

name: 伊里斯
text: 只要接下来我们一起合作，或许……不！是一定能救回那家伙！让一切……回到正轨。
text_loc: If we work together from here, maybe... no. We'll pull that poor creature back and set everything right.

text: 就凭我们行吗？
text_loc: Can we really do this?

name: 伊里斯
text: 一定……行的吧？……总之……看，眼前这幅壁画！
text_loc: Of course we can... probably? Anyway, look at this mural in front of us.
Uh...

name: 伊里斯
text: 想必你已经在眷属的守护地见到了另两幅壁画。而这幅便是它们的后续。在邪物弥漫的关键时刻，洛克和精灵们迎来了英雄——
text_loc: You've already seen the other two murals at the Attendants' shrines. This one is what comes after. At the darkest moment, when the shadows were closing in, the hero arrived.

text: 这个洛克我见过的
text_loc: I've seen this Roco before.

name: 伊里斯
text: 见过？呼，他——是拯救卡洛西亚的大英雄。但已经去世很久了……看来你……
text_loc: You have? He is the great hero who saved Kalosia, though he's been gone a very long time now. Which means you...

name: 伊里斯
text: 这位洛克便是——「亚瑟」！翼王和他曾一起对抗噩梦，这种并肩作战的经历，连我都有点羡慕……
text_loc: This Roco is Arthiel. He and the King of Flight once stood side by side against the Nightmare. That bond of shared battle... even I find myself a little envious.

text: 不太记得了
text_loc: I can't quite remember.

text: 虽然不清楚，当听到亚瑟名讳的时候，记忆中突然出现了一些温暖的……涟漪？——虽然未曾谋面，却又有着莫名的熟悉感……
text_loc: It's hazy, but the moment I hear the name Arthiel, something stirs, like a warm ripple moving through my memory. I've never met him, yet somehow it feels like I already know him.

name: 伊里斯
text: 看你这表情……难道……不，果然，你和亚瑟……！！
text_loc: The look on your face... don't tell me... no, I knew it. You and Arthiel...

text: 我和亚瑟？！
text_loc: Me and Arthiel?

name: 迪莫
text: 迪莫迪莫！迪莫迪莫！
text_loc: Dimo! Dimoooo!

name: 黑屏
text: |||<CENTER>迪莫一副急得够呛的样子，上蹿下跳，看了看我，又看了看伊里斯，拼命摇头。</>|||
text_loc: |||<CENTER>Dimo is beside itself, bouncing up and down, looking at you and then Irys, shaking its head with everything it has.</>|||

name: 伊里斯
text: 哈哈！我听明白了，你是想说——这孩子和那位亚瑟……没有关系？
text_loc: Ha! I think I understand. You're saying this kid and Arthiel have nothing to do with each other.

text: 就是，怎么可能是亚瑟……
text_loc: Like I could ever be Arthiel.

text: 我不是亚瑟
text_loc: I'm not Arthiel.

name: 伊里斯
text: 哈，既然是陪伴亚瑟的光之精灵所述，那倒是有一百分的可信度。
text_loc: Ha. If Arthiel's own Jini of Light is saying so, I'll take that as the final truth.

text: 光之精灵？！
text_loc: Jini of Light?

name: 伊里斯
text: 对，原本我还半信半疑，但这一路走来，倒十分确信了……
text_loc: That's right. I had my doubts at first, but everything we've been through together dispelled them long ago.

name: 伊里斯
text: 如果我没猜错的话，你身边的这位蓝色精灵，就是亚瑟的光之精灵……拯救王国的英雄——「迪莫」！！
text_loc: Unless I'm sorely mistaken, the blue Jini traveling with you is Arthiel's Jini of Light. The hero who helped save the Kingdom, Dimo.

text: 迪莫……
text_loc: Dimo...

text: 果然……白树所言居然……
text_loc: The Radiant Tree was right.

text: 在那时，迪莫化为星盘，引导了我。它也正是之前壁画中，与亚瑟并肩作战的古代精灵。
text_loc: Dimo became the Stardial and guided me here. And it's the same ancient Jini from the murals, the one who fought beside Arthiel.

name: 迪莫
text: 迪莫迪莫……迪莫迪莫……（狡黠地笑）
text_loc: Dimooo, Dimooo... *smirks*

text: 但作为亚瑟的老友，迪莫刚刚却又直接地否定了我和亚瑟的关系……呃……
text_loc: But Dimo is Arthiel's oldest companion, and it just flat out denied any connection between me and Arthiel. So... what exactly does that mean?

text: 为什么是我？
text_loc: Then why me?

text: 我确实不如什么英雄王……
text_loc: I'm indeed not the Lightbringer.

name: 伊里斯
text: 哼哼……既然迪莫知道你并非亚瑟，但却依然认可你作为它新的主人。看来，你一定有着一些一般洛克所没有的品质。
text_loc: Hmm. Dimo knows you aren't Arthiel, and yet it chose you as its new champion anyway. That tells me you have something most Rocos don't.

name: 伊里斯
text: 它也一定与你建立了新的友谊，呵呵。
text_loc: And clearly the two of you have built something real together. Haha.

text: 迪莫！
text_loc: Dimo!

name: 迪莫
text: 迪莫……迪莫……
text_loc: Dimo... Dimo...

name: 伊里斯
text: 我更加期待了，也许……我们也能像曾经亚瑟和翼王那样——用光明……呃……冲破黑暗！
text_loc: I find myself looking forward to what's ahead. Maybe we really can do what Arthiel and the King of Flight once did, and cut through the dark currents with the ship of light!

text: 我们三个一起！
text_loc: All three of us together!

text: 我有点担心……
text_loc: I'm a little worried, honestly.

name: 伊里斯
text: 呃……虽然亚瑟当年战力不是我们所能比肩的，但，但是毕竟我们有三份战力！
text_loc: Well, Arthiel's strength was in a different class entirely. But between the three of us, we've got three serious powerhouses.

name: 伊里斯
text: 唔，我算算，你的战力算一的话，那迪莫是二……我……嗯，我算五……
text_loc: Let me work it out. If your combat power is one, then Dimo is two... and I'm five.

text: 你怎么就五了？
text_loc: How do you get five?

name: 伊里斯
text: 哈哈，当然因为伊里斯大人我强……
text_loc: Because that is simply how powerful the magnificent Irys is.

name: 伊里斯
text: 呃，你那表情……不会如今还不信我吧？！那……你看看这个呢？是否能猜到什么？
text_loc: Judging from that look on your face, you still don't believe me. Fine, what do you make of this?

name: 伊里斯
text: 这枚宝贝是伊里斯我的「护身符」……原本是我身体的……一部分，也承载着我的记忆……
text_loc: This little treasure is my good luck charm. It was originally part of my body and carries my memories.

text: 身体的一部分？？
text_loc: Part of his body?

text: 五颜六色，呃……像颗糖
text_loc: Colorful. Like a piece of candy.

name: 伊里斯
text: 看来我还是太过于神秘……让人捉摸不透呀！
text_loc: It seems I'm even more mysterious than I thought. Like a mountain shrouded in mist!

name: 伊里斯
text: ——哼哼，事到如今，我也不必再掩饰实力……就让伊里斯我，给你来点的光彩夺目，眩目震耳的真东西！
text_loc: Heh heh. No more hiding what I'm truly capable of. Let the magnificent Irys show you something genuinely dazzling.

text: 从外形上看……是乳牙吗？
text_loc: A baby tooth, maybe?

name: 伊里斯
text: 很接近，但是猜错啦！
text_loc: Close, but wrong!

text: 似乎很熟悉
text_loc: Sounds familiar.

text: 虽然不清楚，当听到亚瑟名讳的时候，记忆中突然出现了一些温暖的……涟漪？——虽然未曾谋面，却又像是老朋友一般……
text_loc: Something about the name Arthiel stirs something in my memory, like a ripple I can't quite place. I've never met him. And yet somehow it feels like running into an old friend.

text: 有点不太记得
text_loc: It's all a little fuzzy.

name: 伊里斯
text: 仔细回想一下看看？是不是曾经看到过？这个洛克，在麦克达克和莎莎的壁画中也出现过，是拯救卡洛西亚的大英雄。
text_loc: Think hard. Does this face ring a bell? This Roco appears in Elson Drake and Furisha's murals too. He's the hero who saved Kalosia.

text: 我们一起加油！
text_loc: We'll figure it out together!

name: 伊里斯
text: 嗯！一起加油！小家伙，你总是带来希望，有你在……或许……呵呵，来，先看看壁画吧。
text_loc: Yes! Together! You're like a beacon of hope. Having you here... maybe... ha, come on, let's look at the mural first.

text: ——果然光彩夺目！
text_loc: Like I thought, radiant doesn't even cover it!

text: 你是——独角兽？！
text_loc: You're a Unicorn?

name: 伊里斯
text: 哈哈，看来我的伪装还是很不错嘛！甚至为了融入你们，我还学了不少俚语！用洛克话来说，真是「学富八车」！
text_loc: Ha! My disguise was pretty convincing, I have to say. I even picked up some local slang to fit in better. In Roconese, you could call it a "fondue of knowledge"!

text: 都说了，是学富五车！
text_loc: It's "fount," actually!

text: 虽然刚才发表了一番豪言壮语，但果然还是爱开玩笑的伊里斯。
text_loc: Big speech, same old Irys. Still can't help making it a joke.

text: 总之，装洛克可以算是有模有样吧……可是，和最初那时候相比，哪怕耍帅，伊里斯似乎也失去了那股特别的骄傲感……
text_loc: He pulled off the Roco act well enough, I suppose. But there's something different now compared to when we first met—even when he's showing off, there's no longer any trace of that particular brand of inviolate pride.

name: 伊里斯
text: 再次介绍一下，我是……翼王的挚友，彩虹独角兽。我名为——「伊里斯」！
text_loc: Allow me to properly introduce myself. I am the closest companion of the King of Flight, an Irikerion. My name is Irys.

text: 难怪说是「本地人」呢……
text_loc: No wonder he was a local.

name: 伊里斯
text: 风眠圣所，是翼王用来净化污染的休憩地……我上一次来，还是这里被黑巫师侵入之后……
text_loc: Windrest Sanctuary is where the King of Flight came to rest and recover from the corruption. The last time I was here... was after the Dark Wizards broke in.

name: 伊里斯
text: 嗯，是的。它们对翼王的星之结动手了……呜……
text_loc: Yes. They went after the King's Star Knot. Hrngh.

text: 伊里斯……看起来很痛苦。如壁画所绘，吸收信徒祈愿，为翼王清除污染的「星之结」就位于圣所最深处，却似乎失灵了。
text_loc: Irys looks like he's in pain. Just as the murals showed, the Star Knot deep in the Sanctuary was meant to absorb the wishes of believers and cleanse the King of Flight's corruption. But it seems to have gone silent.

text: 伊里斯，你……没事吧……
text_loc: Are you okay, Irys?

name: 伊里斯
text: 黑巫师们污染了星之结。星之结……变成了灰色、紫色、黑色混杂的，肮脏的颜色……
text_loc: The Dark Wizards corrupted the Star Knot. It turned grey, purple, black—all muddled together like some twisted kaleidoscope.

text: 是我的错觉吗？伊里斯在悲伤和愤怒交杂中，闪现了一瞬间的不安。
text_loc: For just a moment, beneath the grief and the anger, something else flickers across Irys's face. Something that looks like fear. Or am I imagining it?

name: 伊里斯
text: 星之结的状态和翼王紧密相关……看到那样的星之结……我……
text_loc: The Star Knot is closely tied to the King of Flight. Their fates are one. Seeing it like that... I...

text: 看着挚友被摧残，一定很绝望吧……
text_loc: That must have been devastating.

text: 伊里斯一定很无力……
text_loc: Irys must have felt so helpless.

name: 伊里斯
text: ……总之，能污染星之结的黑巫师，和此前你遇到过的不一样，不可小觑……我们得做好准备。
text_loc: Whatever the case, Dark Wizards who can corrupt a Star Knot are not like anything you've faced before. We need to be ready.

name: 伊里斯
text: 但你放心……有我在，保准没问题！
text_loc: But don't worry. With me here, we'll be just fine.

text: 真的没问题吗？
text_loc: You sure about that?

text: 没问题，我相信你！
text_loc: I trust you. We've got this.

name: 伊里斯
text: ——哈哈，不管怎样，还是先往深处去吧。让我们看看星之结……究竟变成什么样了……
text_loc: Haha. Either way, let's press on. Time to see what's become of the Star Knot.

text: 其实我早猜到了，哈哈
text_loc: Actually, I had a feeling.

name: 伊里斯
text: 啊？！我还以为我装得挺像的呢，甚至学了不少你们的俚语……
text_loc: Wait, really? I thought my disguise was solid. I even studied your slang!

text: 你那七彩身姿……
text_loc: Your rainbow hair gave it away.

text: 这里看起来像个废墟……周围弥散着浓烈的不适气息。对，和商店街那次类似，是「魇力」带来的凝塞感。
text_loc: This place looks like a ruin. A thick, oppressive feeling hangs in the air, like the heaviness back at Merchant Town. It's Malforce, settling into everything like fog.

text: 这是……星之结的残骸？
text_loc: Isn't this...

name: 伊里斯
text: 这就是……「星之结」。它在过去曾为翼王消解魇力的污染。但……如你所见，现在已经被损毁了。
text_loc: This is the Star Knot. It once cleansed the Malforce from the King of Flight. Now, as you can see, it's been destroyed.

text: ……难道是黑巫师干的？！
text_loc: The Dark Wizards did this?

text: ……翼王都经历了什么！
text_loc: What happened here...

text: 伊里斯侧过脸，似乎回忆起来了什么，表情略带痛苦。
text_loc: Irys turns away slightly, something moving behind his eyes. The memory seems to be a painful one.

name: 伊里斯
text: 魇力给肉体造成的苦痛日夜不断……翼王它为什么……愿意一直承受呢？
text_loc: Why did the King of Flight endure so much pain for so long? What kept it holding on?

name: 伊里斯
text: ……星之结负责吸纳、储存、并供给翼王祈愿之力。这股力量，可以简称为「愿力」，虽然，知道的洛克已经不多了。
text_loc: The Star Knot was meant to absorb, store, and channel Wishpower to the King. Wishpower is a word fewer and fewer Rocos even know anymore.

text: 什么是愿力？
text_loc: What is Wishpower?

name: 伊里斯
text: 如同字面意思，是「愿」所带来的力量，真诚的希望，纯粹的梦想。简单来说，洛克和精灵的契约，就能诞生愿力。
text_loc: Exactly what it sounds like. The power that comes from wishing. Genuine hope. Pure dreams. At its simplest, a pact between Roco and Jini is enough to create it.

text: 这么说，契约也并不稀罕嘛
text_loc: But aren't pacts fairly common?

name: 伊里斯
text: 不，不一样的。如今洛克用「咕噜球」缔造的契约，并不是真正的契约。
text_loc: That's where you'd be wrong. The pacts Rocos make with Buddy Pods today aren't true pacts.

text: 怎样的契约才是真的契约？
text_loc: What makes a pact real?

name: 伊里斯
text: 心意相通……永不离弃，才能诞生出真正的契约，让洛克和精灵，在平等的基础上，成为真正的伙伴。
text_loc: Hearts in harmony, never to part. A true pact is one of genuine equals, a bond freely chosen on both sides.

text: ……永不离弃
text_loc: Never to part.

text: ……心意相通
text_loc: Hearts in harmony.

name: 伊里斯
text: 可惜，能被唤为愿力的纯粹之物……如今，已经极难寻觅了。
text_loc: The problem is that Wishpower, truly pure Wishpower, has become nearly impossible to find.

name: 伊里斯
text: 信众们日渐稀少，愿力枯竭，因此，翼王才难以抵抗「噩梦」所带来的魇力污染……
text_loc: The faithful dwindled. The Wishpower dried up. That's why the King of Flight couldn't resist the Nightmare's Malforce anymore.

name: 伊里斯
text: 唉！
text_loc: *sigh*

text: 随便一只精灵都可以？
text_loc: Any Jini will do?

name: 伊里斯
text: 是，随便一只精灵都可以，随便一位洛克也可以。但如今洛克用「咕噜球」缔造的契约，并不是真正的契约。
text_loc: Yes, any Jini, any Roco. But the pacts Rocos make today with Buddy Pods aren't the genuine article.

name: 伊里斯
text: 星之结和翼王一体，如果……它还能运作，或许，还有希望！唉……让我们着手修复星之结吧。
text_loc: The Star Knot and the King of Flight are one. If it can still be repaired, there may still be hope. Let's see what we can do.

text: ……（拧紧眉头）
text_loc: *frown*

text: 但是，具体怎么修？
text_loc: But how, exactly?

name: 伊里斯
text: 怎么样？你都站在这里了，或许——不，得有反应了吧……？能感觉到吗？
text_loc: How? You're standing right here in front of it. Maybe something will happen... I'd think there'd be some kind of reaction, wouldn't you?

text: 我还以为伊里斯知道怎么修，现在和他大眼瞪小眼。
text_loc: I thought Irys had a plan, but now we're just staring at each other.

text: ——但，星盘？
text_loc: The Stardial?

text: ……我试试吧
text_loc: ...I'll try.

text: 给自己点信心！
text_loc: Come on. Have a little faith in yourself.

name: 黑屏入
text: |||<center>我深吸一口气，把星盘平放在手中，托举到星之结前——</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>You take a slow breath, hold the Stardial flat in your palm, and raise it toward the Star Knot.</>|||

name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>星盘微微颤动，发出了缕缕的微光——我看见，伊里斯看到星盘十分惊讶，他的眼睛亮了。</>|||<center>但——没等我们高兴太久，星盘很快又晦暗了下去，再也不动弹了……</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>The Stardial trembles slightly and lets out a faint glow. Irys stares at it, wide-eyed, something lighting up in his expression.</> |||<center>But before either of you can feel any real hope, the light fades. The Stardial goes dark, and all is still.</>|||

name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>奇迹没有发生。</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>No miracles today, apparently.</>|||

text: 果然没有这么简单吗……
text_loc: I knew it wasn't gonna be that simple.

text: 星之结无法修复了？
text_loc: Is the Star Knot beyond repair?

text: 要不你给我一些提示？
text_loc: Any hints you can give me?

name: 伊里斯
text: 星盘看起来，似乎没什么反应？！怎么会……迪莫也无计可施？！
text_loc: The Stardial barely reacted. How is that possible? And Dimo's out of ideas too?

name: 伊里斯
text: 哪个细节出错了？是不是亚瑟套装略有破损？！还是说……需要其他能量介入？！用你的星星试试呢？！
text_loc: Something's off here. Was it Arthiel's gear? Did something get damaged? Or does it need a different kind of energy? What about your Conjure Star?

text: 这……恐怕不太能行吧！
text_loc: That probably won't work either.

text: 你别急，我们再想想……
text_loc: Let's think this through.

name: 伊里斯
text: 呜……看起来还是我太天真了……最后的希望，也……？
text_loc: Ugh... maybe I was being naive. This was our last hope, and even that...

text: 看来，只要这枚星之结能被复原的话……翼王便能再次被治愈——所以伊里斯才如此孤注一掷……
text_loc: So as long as the Star Knot can be restored, the King of Flight can be healed again. No wonder Irys is willing to stake everything on it.

name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>话音刚落，背后传来了有点熟悉的诡异笑声。</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>The words have barely left his mouth when a disturbingly familiar laugh echoes from behind us.</>|||

name: 库伦
text: 哈哈哈？修复？居然寄希望于一枚失去愿力，如同废铁一般的星之结。你还是这么可爱啊，伊里斯！
text_loc: Repair it? Ha. You're pinning your hopes on a Star Knot which is nothing more than a desiccated husk—dead weight. You never change, do you, Irys.

text: ——库伦！
text_loc: Kullen!

text: 什么，是伊里斯干的？！
text_loc: Wait, you did this, Irys?

name: 库伦
text: 但可惜，无论你们用怎样的魔法，都是徒劳！
text_loc: It doesn't matter what kind of magic you throw at it. None of it will work. Not a single spell.

name: 伊里斯
text_loc: Kullen, you...

name: 库伦
text: 怎么，伊里斯，当时急着打碎「星之结」想救翼王的是你，现在想修复它的也是你……
text_loc: Oh, come now, Irys. You were the one who smashed the Star Knot trying to save the King of Flight, and now you're here trying to put it back together?

name: 库伦
text: 真是……独角兽急跳墙了呀，哈哈哈！
text_loc: How pathetic. And you call yourself an Irikeras?

text: 什么，打碎星之结的……居然是伊里斯？！还是为了——救翼王？
text_loc: Wait. Irys smashed the Star Knot? And it was to save the King of Flight?

name: 伊里斯
text_loc: KULLEN!

name: 库伦
text: 哦，差点忘了，我们还有一位自不量力的小观众呢……
text_loc: Oh, I almost forgot about our rather overconfident spectator.

name: 库伦
text: 你！啧啧……看着伊里斯喊着「友情」、「拯救」的戏码，就相信它能救出翼王，傻傻地跟着来过家家？
text_loc: You. Tsk... you heard Irys go on about "friendship" and "rescue" and actually believed it could save the King of Flight. You just tagged along like this was all some game?

name: 库伦
text: 我奴役翼王这笨家伙，可是特意给它上了黑魔法枷锁的——唔，看来伊里斯也给你上了什么枷锁？所以你才不要命地跟着跑？！哈哈哈！
text_loc: I've had the King of Flight shackled with Dark Magic for a reason. It appears Irys has had some kind of hold over you too. Otherwise, why would you follow him into such treacherous territory?

name: 伊里斯
text: ——库伦！你！不许侮辱翼王！也不能这么说{name}！
text_loc: Kullen! Don't you dare talk about the King of Flight like that. And leave {name} out of this.

name: 库伦
text: 那位大人的计划即将实现，如今的你，又有什么立场阻止我？够了，过家家已经结束了！
text_loc: His plan is nearly complete. What makes you think you can possibly stand in my way? Enough. This heroic playacting of yours is over.

name: 库伦
text: 不妨告诉你，我今日的来意……就是你，伊里斯！！可惜，这位可爱的小朋友也要受到牵连了——哈哈哈哈！
text_loc: I'll tell you exactly why I'm here today. It's for you, Irys. It's a shame this friend of yours has to get caught in the middle. Hahaha!

text: 不好！
text_loc: Oh no!

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片前）
name: 伊里斯
text: 我的小独角兽——居然把你弄醒了。呼，你看……你的脸上都是毛毛。
text_loc: Sorry I woke you up, my little Irikeras. Look at you, your face is all fuzzy.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片前）
name: 伊里斯
text: ——咳咳，咳咳！
text_loc: Cough, cough!

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片前）
text: 伊里斯！你没事吧？
text_loc: Irys! Are you okay?

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片前）
text: 你受伤了？！
text_loc: Are you hurt?

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片前）
name: 伊里斯
text: 不必担心，我是独角兽，恢复起来比你想的快多了。你看！已经完全没事了！
text_loc: Don't worry about me. Irikeras heal faster than you'd think. See? Good as new.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片前）
name: 伊里斯
text: 呃……咳咳咳！
text_loc: Cough, cough, cough.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片前）
text: 你……真没事吧？
text_loc: Are you sure about that?

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片前）
text: 别逞强了
text_loc: Don't push yourself.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片前）
name: 伊里斯
text: 没事……
text_loc: I'm fine...

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片前）
name: 伊里斯
text: 翼王……它……
text_loc: The King of Flight... it...

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片前）
text: 回想起在风眠圣所再次遇到自己被污染的挚友，伊里斯的脸上显露出掩饰不住的悲伤。
text_loc: The memory of rediscovering the King of Flight, still corrupted, inside Windrest Sanctuary—Irys can't hide the grief on his face.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片前）
text: 库伦刚才说……你们战斗过？
text_loc: Kullen said you two fought.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片前）
text: 当时……发生了什么意外？
text_loc: What happened back then?

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片前）
name: 伊里斯
text: 是的。那天，我没能救回里奥……眼看着它已经被折磨得支离破碎，我……
text_loc: Yes. That day, I couldn't save Lyel. Watching it all fall apart in front of me, I...

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片前）
name: 伊里斯
text: 还记得那颗星之结吗？——原本应当璀璨无比，凝聚了洛克们无数愿望的崇高晶体。
text_loc: Do you remember the Star Knot? It was supposed to be a radiant sacred crystal filled with the wishes of countless Rocos.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片前）
name: 伊里斯
text: 曾几何时，我也以为它的本质是美好的，能给精灵们带去幸福，赋予翼王强大的力量。
text_loc: I used to believe it was something beautiful. That it could bring happiness to Jini and give the King of Flight the strength it needed.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片前）
name: 伊里斯
text: 直到，我亲眼看着那枚璀璨的星之结黯淡下去……目之所及……它竟变成了给翼王输送污染的祸源！
text_loc: Then I watched that once lustrous Star Knot go dark. And when I looked closer, it had become the very thing feeding the King its corruption!

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片前）
text: 星之结，听上去如此美好，但如果没有愿力注入，居然反会给翼王输送污染！
text_loc: The Star Knot was meant to be a source of healing. But without Wishpower flowing into it, it became a conduit for poison!

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片后）
name: 伊里斯
text: 黑巫团……它们污染了星之结，翼王也被彻底异化！
text_loc: The Dark Coven poisoned the Star Knot. And after that, the King of Flight changed completely.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片后）
name: 伊里斯
text: 我尝试对抗他们，但翼王身上的污染越来越深。
text_loc: I tried to fight them off, but the corruption was spreading deeper and deeper into the King.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片后）
name: 伊里斯
text: 绝望之时，我只能试图截断污染的源头！
text_loc: When I had nothing left, I did the only thing I could think of; cut it off at the source.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片后）
text: 所以你……
text_loc: So you...

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片后）
name: 伊里斯
text: 是，我摧毁了星之结！但，虽然肮脏的力量暂时停止了供给，黑暗……却没有从翼王身上消散……
text_loc: Yes. I destroyed the Star Knot. The foul energy stopped flowing for a time, but the darkness did not leave the King. It was already too deeply ingrained...

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片后）
name: 伊里斯
text: 最后的希望，只有新的愿力——如果愿力再次充盈于星之结，或许，就能真正解决症结，一切也还有再来的可能……
text_loc: The only real answer left is new Wishpower. If Wishpower could fill the Star Knot again, it might actually solve the problem at its root. There's still a chance, if we can find it.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片后）
name: 伊里斯
text: 所以后来，我一直在山下活动……尝试寻找更多由纯真契约所产生的愿力，以求拯救那家伙！
text_loc: After that, I spent my time in the villages below, searching for any trace of Wishpower born from true pacts. Something, anything that could save Lyel.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片后）
name: 伊里斯
text: 可谁能想到……真正的契约似乎已经消失殆尽。这让我一度失去希望。
text_loc: But true pacts seem to have all but vanished. For a while, I lost hope, like the sky lost its sun.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片后）
name: 伊里斯
text: 幸好，在魔法学院学生的身上，我看到了愿力细碎的闪光。
text_loc: Then I saw it—tiny sparks of Wishpower amongst the Magic Academy students.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片后）
name: 伊里斯
text: 特别是{name}，你……
text_loc: Especially you, {name}.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片后）
name: 伊里斯
text: ——虽然，数量还远远不够，不能让我启动那个魔法……不过都没关系……接下来，哪怕是最后一搏，我也要救那家伙！
text_loc: Though the amount is still nowhere near enough to trigger the magic I need, it doesn't matter. Whatever comes next, I'm giving everything I have to save Lyel.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片后）
text: 我陪你去
text_loc: I'm going with you.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片后）
text: 我该去哪？
text_loc: Where do I go from here?

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片后）
name: 伊里斯
text: 我……很感谢你，但把无辜的你卷进来……我非常抱歉。
text_loc: I'm grateful. Truly. But I'm sorry for dragging you into this, when you had nothing to do with any of it.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片后）
name: 伊里斯
text: 你的出现，究竟是巧合，还是必然呢……
text_loc: Whether your being here is chance or something more, I honestly can't say.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片后）
name: 伊里斯
text: 事到如今，进退都凶险万分——但不管怎样，我会保护你，跟紧我！
text_loc: Regardless, things will be dangerous moving forward, no matter which direction we go. Stay close to me. I'll keep you safe.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片后）
text: 没事，我也想帮助你
text_loc: I want to help. Let me.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片后）
text: 嗯，我想追索风灾真相
text_loc: I want to find out the truth.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片后）
text: 我也想救翼王
text_loc: I want to save the King.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片后）
name: 伊里斯
text: 嗯！眼下最重要的事情，是追击库伦。翼王刚才失控飞走了，找到库伦应该能得到翼王去向的线索。
text_loc: Right. Our top priority is tracking down Kullen. The King of Flight lost control and flew off. If we want to find it, Kullen's trail is our best bet.

task_name: 向伊里斯询问发生了什么（播片后）
name: 伊里斯
text: 幸好，库伦这些黑巫师，常年浸染噩梦力量，走路总是「拖泥带水」，一定会留下气息线索……走！
text_loc: Fortunately for us, Dark Wizards who've spent years steeped in Nightmare energy always leave traces behind. They can never quite shake the stench. Let's move.

name: 伊里斯
text: 咳咳……那些家伙似乎在附近布下了包围网……难道，是在守护什么东西吗？
text_loc: Cough... They seem to have set up some kind of perimeter around this area. Are they guarding something?

name: 伊里斯
text: 没有退路了，只能向前。但……他们人数众多，我们这种状态，咳咳……不好硬碰硬。
text_loc: There's no going back now. We push forward. But there are too many of them to hit head-on, given the shape we're in.

name: 伊里斯
text: 或许咱们可以找找遮挡，慢慢前行。尽量隐蔽身形，不要被他们发现！
text_loc: We look for cover and move carefully. Stay hidden. Don't let them spot us.

name: 阴狠黑巫师
text: 山上的仪式是那位大人和库伦准备的最后手段。
text_loc: The ritual on the mountain acts as the Lord and Kullen's contingency plan.

name: 阴狠黑巫师
text: 可我抓的胚子等级不够格，说距离祭品的等级还差一点。
text_loc: The specimens I caught weren't good enough. Apparently they do not qualify as proper offerings.

text: 是黑巫师，在讨论关于祭品的事情，还提到了库伦！继续听听。
text_loc: Dark Wizards talking about offerings... and Kullen's name keeps coming up. Keep listening.

name: 矮胖黑巫师
text: 啧，那么多胚子，没一个够格成为祭品，要是运气好，碰到只足够有分量的就好了。
text_loc: All those specimens and not one of them meets the grade. If we could just get our hands on something with enough weight to it.

name: 阴狠黑巫师
text: 不用操心，祭坛那边负责仪式的朋友告诉我，成功在即了。
text_loc: Relax. I got word from the people running the altar that success is close.

name: 矮胖黑巫师
text: 啊？——就是说……搞到了好祭品？！
text_loc: What? Does that mean they found a real offering?

name: 阴狠黑巫师
text: 没错。大人在山上弄到了一摊巨大的肥鸭和一块滑溜溜的彩蝶鲨，听说还都是首领级别的胚子。
text_loc: Indeed. Up on the mountain, the master got his hands on a hefty duck and a slippery Fluttershark. Both Elite-level specimens, apparently.

text: 什么？是麦克达克和法瑞莎莎？！
text_loc: Elson Drake and Farisha?

name: 黑巫师们
text: 嗯？鬼鬼祟祟的，是谁！
text_loc: Someone's lurking around. Who's there?

name: 恩佐
text: 真是意外，竟然会以这样的方式，再次见面，{gender:小学弟,小学妹}。
text_loc: Oh, it's you! I didn't think we'd meet again, especially under such circumstances.

text: 恩佐？！
text_loc: Enzir?! What are you doing here?

text: 这话应该我说吧
text_loc: Right back at you.

name: 恩佐
text: 嗯，所幸我听闻响动，及时赶到，总算没有出现预料之外的情况。
text_loc: Lucky for you both, I heard the commotion and was able to get here in time. No unexpected complications.

name: 恩佐
text: 但……毫无准备就闯入这黑巫师的阵地里，你们，未免也有些太冒失了吧？
text_loc: Charging straight into Dark Wizard territory with no preparation? Awfully reckless, even for you.

name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>和恩佐诉说了之前的惊险历程……</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>You fill Enzir in on everything that happened.</>|||

name: 恩佐
text: 呵呵，上次调查中，我不想让你涉险，让你离山。但看来你并不是一个甘于等待的孩子……我果然没有预料错……
text_loc: I see. Last time, I intentionally kept you from danger. But it seems you're not someone content to wait on the sidelines. I had a feeling.

name: 恩佐
text: 恐怕这也是……你会和身边这位大人物卷在一起的原因了，大魔法师——伊里斯老师？！
text_loc: I suppose that's also why you ended up buddies with the Archmage himself, Professor Irys?

name: 伊里斯
text: 等一等！应该惊讶的是我们吧？恩佐同学，你穿成黑巫师的模样，在这里鬼鬼祟祟地做什么？
text_loc: Hold on. Shouldn't we be the ones asking questions here? What exactly are you doing sneaking around dressed as a Dark Wizard?

name: 伊里斯
text: {name}，你不觉得奇怪吗？他是否真是我们熟悉的那个恩佐，有没有……信物什么的？
text_loc: {name}, doesn't this all seem a bit fishy to you? How do we know this is actually Enzir? Does he have any proof of that?

text: 我也觉得奇怪
text_loc: Something does feel strange.

text: 应该不会吧……
text_loc: I don't think so.

name: 恩佐
text: 哼，你的怀疑可以理解，但我没有兴趣参与什么自证清白的戏码。
text_loc: While your suspicion is understandable, I have no interest in proving myself to you.

name: 恩佐
text: 先前奉校方的调查之命，我带{gender:他,她}秘密潜入了这里，也逐渐接近了这场风灾的真实原因。
text_loc: I was sent here by the Academy to investigate. I brought {gender:him,her} along as I worked to uncover the truth behind this windstorm.

name: 恩佐
text: 但在黑巫师的领地里，一般的装束可无法通行。所以，我才进行了……嗯，必要的伪装？
text_loc: And I'd hardly get anywhere in Dark Wizard territory wearing ordinary garb. Hence the disguise.

text: 这下就解释的通了
text_loc: That does explain things.

text: 嗯，我可以证明
text_loc: Right. I can vouch for that.

name: 恩佐
text: 不过……我反倒很好奇，同样也深知这里底细的老师你，为何要将无辜的小同学卷入其中呢？
text_loc: What I want to know is why you, someone who knows exactly what's going on here, would drag an innocent student into all this?

name: 恩佐
text: 究竟是天真，还是鲁莽啊……对了，又或许现在应该叫你，彩虹独角兽——伊里斯大人？
text_loc: Is it because you're careless? Reckless? At any rate, perhaps I should start addressing you as Master Irys the Irikerion?

name: 伊里斯
text: 嗯？！我好像从未告诉过你……！
text_loc: What? I never told you that.

text: 恩佐也知道了？？
text_loc: Enzir, you know about that too?

text: 好像有什么误会……
text_loc: I smell misunderstanding...

name: 恩佐
text: ……我猜，你急着往里冲，应该是奔着黑巫团的头领「库伦」去的吧？
text_loc: My guess is you came charging in here after the Dark Coven's leader, Kullen.

text: 没错……
text_loc: That's right.

text: 他抓走了翼王
text_loc: He took the King of Flight.

name: 恩佐
text: 看来我猜中了。不妨再告诉你们，此刻的他就在……前方黑巫师的秘密祭坛。
text_loc: As I thought. I'll tell you where he is right now; the Dark Wizards' hidden altar, straight ahead.

name: 恩佐
text: 但再往前走，也意味着会进入更密集的包围网，你们真的知道自己将面临何等危险吗？！
text_loc: But moving forward means walking into more densely-packed enemy territory. Do you actually understand what you'd be facing?

text: 那里是……
text_loc: That place is...

text: 非常棘手……
text_loc: This is going to be tough.

name: 恩佐
text: 想要继续深入，是凭你现在这副病怏怏的身子，还是凭你拯救朋友的一腔孤勇……？
text_loc: Are you planning to push ahead on sheer willpower alone? I understand you want to save your friend, but you're barely standing.

name: 恩佐
text: 不要冲动了。我能救你们一次，不代表能救第二次。
text_loc: Don't act on impulse. I pulled you out of trouble once. I can't promise it'll happen a second time.

text: 恩佐……
text_loc: Standing next to Enzir, both Irys and I feel as if we have no idea what we're doing.

name: 恩佐
text: {name}，原本就是我把你带进山……身为学长，自然也有护你安全的责任。
text_loc: {name}, I was the one who brought you into the mountain. As your superior, keeping you safe is my responsibility.

text: 这是何意？
text_loc: What do you mean by that?

text: 恩佐学长……
text_loc: Enzir...

name: 恩佐
text: 而伊里斯——你想救翼王，我想我们的目标其实是一致的。
text_loc: And Irys, you want to save the King of Flight. We're all after the same thing here.

name: 恩佐
text: ——驱散那股邪恶的噩梦力量，解救你的朋友，还有就是，保证{name}的安全。
text_loc: Drive out the Nightmare energy, free your friend, and keep {name} safe.

name: 恩佐
text: 因此，我的建议是——我们三个应该一起行动。
text_loc: So my suggestion is this. All three of us move together.

text: 一起行动？！
text_loc: Together?

name: 恩佐
text: 对于一无所知的你们来说，毋庸置疑，这是目前的最优解。
text_loc: Given how little the two of you know about what's in there, this is the best option right now.

name: 伊里斯
text: 恩佐，你和传闻中一样缜密。看起来……是完全不打算给我其他选项呢。
text_loc: Enzir, you're exactly as sharp as people say. And besides, it doesn't look like you're giving me much of a choice.

name: 伊里斯
text: 好吧……看你的样子，应该已经有什么计划了？
text_loc: Fine. I take it you already have a plan?

name: 恩佐
text: 有是有，但可能……得委屈一下大家了。
text_loc: I do. Though it may require everyone to make a small sacrifice.

text: 不祥的预感……
text_loc: I have a bad feeling about this.

name: 恩佐
text: 嗯，就是和刚才的和我一样，扮装成「黑巫师」的模样了。
text_loc: We all disguise ourselves as Dark Wizards. Same as I've been doing.

text: 感觉有点离谱
text_loc: That feels a little extreme.

text: 好别扭啊！
text_loc: This is so wrong.

name: 恩佐
text: 很抱歉，你们没有选择权。想要顺利抵达黑巫师的祭坛，这是眼下唯一的办法。听我的，好好演。
text_loc: Sorry, but I'm not asking. I'm telling you, it's the only way to reach the altar in one piece. Follow my lead, and sell your performance.

text: <Center>在恩佐的帮助下，我们变身成了黑巫团成员们的样子……</>
text_loc: <Center>With Enzir's help, the three of you transform into convincing Dark Wizard disguises.</>

name: 伊里斯
text: 呜哇，我怎么是个矮冬瓜？！感觉臭臭的！
text_loc: Why am I not the best-looking one? And this thing absolutely reeks.

name: 伊里斯
text: 你们都比我帅多了，你这个魔法怎么回事！
text_loc: You two look way better than me. Something must be wrong with your magic!

name: 恩佐
text: ……嗯，你这个样子，看起来还挺顺眼的。
text_loc: ...Hm. Actually, I think it suits you quite well.

name: 伊里斯
text: ——啊？！你故意的？
text_loc: You did this on purpose, didn't you?!

name: 守门黑巫师
title: 不动如山
text: 喂喂，你们！站住！说的就是你们……呃，新来的？去去去，知不知道规矩？
text_loc: Hey, you lot, stop right there. Yes, you. New arrivals? Keep it moving. Don't you know how things work around here?

name: 黑巫师
title: 伊里斯假扮
text: 可恶……你们这群家伙……
text_loc: Jeez... these people...

name: 守门黑巫师
title: 不动如山
text: 你们在窃窃私语什么？
text_loc: What are you whispering about?

text: （别，别在这里露馅啊！）
text_loc: (Don't blow our cover now.)

name: 黑巫师
title: 恩佐假扮
text: 我们几个是刚调上来的，大人，还不清楚什么规矩，都，都听您的！
text_loc: We just got reassigned here, sir. We're not familiar with how things run here, and, um, we'll do whatever you say.

text: （这谄媚的……还挺有模有样）
text_loc: (That's surprisingly convincing.)

name: 守门黑巫师
title: 不动如山
text: 什么规矩，库伦大人就是规矩！库伦大人想要的完美祭品，找到了没？嗯？！
text_loc: You wanna know how things run here? Lord Kullen's all you need to know about! Have you found the offering he asked for or not?

name: 守门黑巫师
title: 不动如山
text: 快，给我速速带祭品过来！两手空空还想进去……真是疯了！
text_loc: Get moving, and bring me an offering. And make it perfect! You think you can waltz in here empty-handed? Are you out of your minds?

text: 「祭品」，看来得先四处看看了解情况，才好弄清楚进入祭坛的办法……
text_loc: An offering? Guess we need to scope this place out and figure out how it works before we can get near that altar.

name: 看守黑巫师
text: 没有几个好胚了，这些祭品不知道库伦大人看不看得上，总之，当务之急是先搬进去再说……唉，苦差事！
text_loc: Barely any decent specimens left. Who knows if Lord Kullen will even approve these offerings, but first things first, let's get them moved in... ugh, I hate this job.

name: 黑巫师
title: 伊里斯假扮
text: 呜……老大，你好！
text_loc: Uh... greetings, boss!

name: 看守黑巫师
text: 你们……是来取祭品的？很面生啊……
text_loc: Are you three here to pick up offerings? I don't recognize you.

text: 我们是新来的
text_loc: We're new here.

name: 看守黑巫师
text: 我就说嘛！哼，新来的，就得多干活！
text_loc: Knew it. New arrivals do all the grunt work around here.

name: 看守黑巫师
text: 愣着干嘛？你们仨，给我搬！
text_loc: Well, don't just stand there. Start hauling already.

name: 黑巫师
title: 恩佐假扮
text: 放心，你去休息吧，这里交给我们就好。
text_loc: Sure thing. Go take a break, we've got this.

name: 看守黑巫师
text: 那可就拜托你们了，这几个胚，你们选选，选出最好的一个，作为祭品，搬运过去！
text_loc: Fine, you can take over. Look through this batch of specimens and pick the best one to bring through as an offering.

name: 黑屏
text: <center>看守的黑巫师放心地离开了。</>
text_loc: <center>The guard Dark Wizard heads off, satisfied.</>

name: 黑巫师
title: 伊里斯假扮
text: 太可恶了！这些精灵全都奄奄一息……黑巫师，他们都干了什么！！
text_loc: This is unbelievable. These Jini are barely alive. What have the Dark Wizards done to them?

name: 黑巫师
title: 恩佐假扮
text: 你别激动……为了我们的计划，先忍忍……
text_loc: Stay calm. We have to stick to the plan.

text: 伊里斯奋力地挥起了小拳头！
text_loc: Irys indignantly raises a tiny fist in anger.

name: 黑屏
text: <center>恩佐的话音刚落，伊里斯已然出手，三下五除二，把精灵全放了。</>
text_loc: <center>Before Enzir even finishes speaking, Irys has already acted. In a matter of seconds, every Jini is free.</>

name: 黑巫师
title: 恩佐假扮
text: 唉——！真是一点都拦不住你！你把精灵都放了，我们怎么交差？怎么混进祭坛？
text_loc: What the...! There's just no stopping you, is there? How are we supposed to explain this? What about our plan?

name: 黑巫师
title: 伊里斯假扮
text: 我实在不忍心看着这些小家伙们在笼子里受苦……管不了这么多了！
text_loc: To heck with the plan! I can't stand watching these Jini suffer in cages!

name: 黑巫师
title: 伊里斯假扮
text: 刚才一路过来，还看到了好多被关着的精灵，我必须得去一趟。你们就别去了，免得被发现。
text_loc: I saw more caged Jini on the way in. I've gotta go. You two stay here, I'll go alone. Otherwise it'll draw too much attention.

name: 黑巫师
title: 恩佐假扮
text: 哼，怎么可能让你单独行动。我们一起去吧。
text_loc: Not a chance I'm letting you go alone. Come on, let's go.

name: 黑巫师
title: 伊里斯假扮
text: 恩佐，谢谢你！原来你是个好人啊！
text_loc: Thanks, Enzir. You really are one of the good guys.

text: 哥们，你不认识我们了？
text_loc: Hey, don't I know you?

name: 看守黑巫师
text: 哥……哥们？难道真的是我记错了？唉，兄弟，你来了，也算是帮了我呀！
text_loc: Wait, do I know you? Maybe I'm mixing people up. Either way, you're doing me a real favor by showing up like this!

name: 看守黑巫师
text: 嘿嘿，兄弟，你们几个，刚好帮我搬祭品……哎哟，腿痛，手痛，脑袋也痛……
text_loc: Ha, perfect timing. You guys can haul the offerings for me... oh, my legs, my arms, my head... the pain is overwhelming!

text: 警报——警报！！！
text_loc: Alert! Alert!

text: 有祭品被释放！紧急状态！所有祭品处理员！马上过来集合！！
text_loc: Offerings have been released! All offering handlers report immediately!

name: 黑巫师
title: 恩佐假扮
text: 哼，他们这次反应倒是快，看来是真看重这批祭品啊。
text_loc: That was quick. Looks like this batch of offerings really mattered to them.

name: 黑巫师
title: 恩佐假扮
text: 现在如果不去集合，反而会引起怀疑。
text_loc: If we don't show up for the assembly, it'll look suspicious.

name: 黑巫师
title: 恩佐假扮
text: 我们先去看看情况吧。
text_loc: Let's go see what's happening.

name: 小喽啰黑巫师
text: 这……这只是我提交的祭品……老大！我没干啊！
text_loc: This... this is just the offering I'm submitting. I swear it wasn't me!

name: 守门黑巫师
title: 不动如山
text: 嗯……确实是祭品……可这么差的胚子，你拿得出手，库伦大人也看不上眼！你退下！
text_loc: Hmph... it may technically be an offering, but Lord Kullen wouldn't give something this soddy a second glance. Get out of here.

name: 黑屏
title: 要换NPC
text: <center>黑巫师们排着队，一个个地提交自己的胚子……</>|||<center>终于，轮到了我们。</>
text_loc: <center>Dark Wizards file forward one by one, presenting their specimens.</> |||<center>Finally, it's your turn.</>

name: 守门黑巫师
title: 不动如山
text: 还剩你们三个的，弄来了吗？噢……细细看看，你们怎么这么鬼鬼祟祟啊……难道……
text_loc: Last group. What've you got? Hmm, you three look awfully suspicious. Don't tell me...

text: 恩佐的眼神，似乎在说，我们确实没有祭品，但……发挥智慧，或许能搞到祭品。
text_loc: Enzir's expression says it all: we don't have an offering, but there might be a way to get one.

text: 伊里斯在叹气？……
text_loc: Is Irys... sighing?

text: 看伊里斯的样子，似乎看到黑巫师就让他无比恶心，也不愿意再忍耐了……怎么办呢？
text_loc: One look at Irys and it's clear: being surrounded by Dark Wizards has pushed him to his limit. He's done pretending. What do we do?

text: 或许，我们有现成的好“胚子”
text_loc: We have a prime specimen.

name: 黑巫师
title: 恩佐假扮
text: 大人，我们找到了一枚库伦大人会满意的极品好胚，所以耽搁了一点时间，您等我们准备一下。
text_loc: Sir, we found an exceptional specimen that Lord Kullen is guaranteed to approve of. All we need is a moment to get ready.

name: 黑屏
text: <center>恩佐向我们使了个眼神，似乎想去一旁商量对策……</>
text_loc: <center>Enzir catches your eye. Looks like he wants to step aside and figure something out.</>

text: 不忍了，教训他们！
text_loc: Screw this, time to throw down!

name: 黑巫师
title: 伊里斯假扮
text: 哼！装作是你们这群脏东西的同类，我也厌烦了……
text_loc: Argh! I'm sick of pretending to be one of you filthy oafs.

name: 黑巫师
title: 伊里斯假扮
text: 和你们多说一句都是浪费口舌，更别说在这里受气，上吧！{name}！
text_loc: I'm not wasting another word on you sorry lot. {name}, let's take them out.

name: 黑巫师
title: 伊里斯假扮
text: 呃？我怎么不知道……我们有这样的极品好胚……
text_loc: Huh? Since when have we had specimens this good?

name: 黑巫师
title: 恩佐假扮
text: 远在天边，近在眼前！
text_loc: It was right under your nose.

name: 黑巫师
title: 伊里斯假扮
text: 嗯？我怎么没看到？
text_loc: What are you talking about? I don't see anything.

name: 黑巫师
title: 伊里斯假扮
text: 等等……你是说……？啊？？！
text_loc: Wait, you don't mean... No!

text: <center>在恩佐的软磨硬泡下，伊里斯只好变成彩虹独角兽的样子，「自愿」地被塞进了祭品笼</>
text_loc: <center>After considerable persuasion from Enzir—or being pushed into a corner, rather—Irys shifts back into his Irikerion form and "voluntarily" gets loaded into an offering cage.</>

name: 黑巫师
title: 恩佐假扮
text: 嗯，这就对了。伊里斯，一会你要悲鸣、挣扎、流泪，明白了吗？
text_loc: Now listen. When they come to check on you, really ham it up. Wail, struggle, cry, the whole nine yards. Understand?

name: 伊里斯
text: 怎么可能明白？！恩佐，你给我记着！！
text_loc: I'm gonna get you for this, Enzir!

name: 黑巫师
title: 恩佐假扮
text: 看来它已经完全理解了。走吧，把伊里斯交上去吧。
text_loc: Yes, just like that! Perfect! Okay, let's move. Time to hand Irys over.

text: 虽然很不情愿，但似乎这也是眼前唯一的方法了……只希望伊里斯不会受到伤害。
text_loc: This is the worst cockamamie scheme I've ever been part of. But it's all we've got. I just hope Irys doesn't get hurt.

name: 伊里斯
title: <Blue>假装紧张</>
text: 呜呜……嘶哈嘶哈！！（蹄子抹泪）
text_loc: Waaah! *hisses and wipes tears*

name: 守门黑巫师
title: 不动如山
text: 如此完美的胚子！悲鸣、挣扎、流泪，还身负重伤。想必一定是非常地痛苦啊，足够成为祭品的最后一块拼图！
text_loc: Ooooh! Crying. Full of spunk. Injured. Exactly the qualities Lord Kullen asked for. The perfect finishing piece! This is the one!

text: 就是就是
text_loc: Absolutely.

name: 黑巫师
title: 恩佐假扮
text: 多亏了前辈的教诲。现在我们可以把祭品送进去了吧？
text_loc: We owe it all to your helpful instructions, sir. May we bring the offering in now?

name: 守门黑巫师
title: 不动如山
text: 当然可以！这毛色，这质量……这胚子！你们几个新人的抓捕水平值得夸赞！
text_loc: That coat, such quality... this specimen is perfect! You new recruits actually came through. Color me impressed.

name: 黑巫师
title: 恩佐假扮
text: 谢谢你！伊里斯！我不会忘记你这次的牺牲……
text_loc: Thank you for this, Irys. I won't forget your sacrifice.

name: 伊里斯
title: <Blue>假装紧张</>
text: 你还是忘了吧，好吗？
text_loc: I'd prefer you, and everyone here, forget this as soon as possible.

name: 黑屏
text: <center>伊里斯被送进去了，警报解除了。黑巫师们得到了完美的祭品，也松懈下来，顺势减弱了守卫。</>
text_loc: <center>Irys is delivered inside, and the previous alert is called off. With the perfect offering secured, the Dark Wizards relax, and the guard thins out.</>

name: 伊里斯
text: 你们总算来了，我都活动了一圈筋骨了。
text_loc: About time. I put in a full workout while I was waiting for you two.

text: 伊里斯！你没事吧？
text_loc: Irys! Are you okay?

name: 伊里斯
text: 有事？哼，三下五除二搞定！！
text_loc: Fine. Only took about 10 seconds to put them down.

name: 恩佐
text: 没事就好。接下来……
text_loc: Good. Now we keep moving.

name: 伊里斯
text: 嗯——走吧！
text_loc: Let's go.

text: 黑衣人们提到的仪式就在眼前了……还是先恢复黑衣人的样貌比较安全。
text_loc: The Dark Wizards mentioned a ritual up ahead. Better switch back into our disguises.

name: 恩佐
text: 刚才你疯了吗？那只怪物不是你我能抗衡的，救你出来，已经是我的极限了。
text_loc: Are you out of your mind? That creature is way above our skill level. It took everything I had to get your out of there.

text: 可！伊里斯他！
text_loc: But Irys is still in there!

name: 恩佐
text: ……呼，{name}，保持理智。就算刚才你过去了，也没有任何办法救伊里斯！
text_loc: {name}. Use your head. Even if you'd gone in, there was nothing you could have done for Irys.

name: 恩佐
text: 这个伊里斯，果然是厉害角色，所以对噩梦来说，才那么有价值……？
text_loc: It makes sense that something like the Nightmare would find a Jini like Irys valuable.

name: 恩佐
text: 以大魔法师的身份活跃在洛克世界，连学院也对它恭敬有加，今天……我终于见识了它的真面目。
text_loc: Operating as a Archmage in the Roco world, respected even by the Academy. And today I finally saw what it really is.

text: 你刚才为什么不救他？
text_loc: Why didn't you save Irys too?

text: 你刚才为什么救我？
text_loc: Why did you save me?

name: 恩佐
text: 能救你已经是我的极限了。而且，我想伊里斯它……也不想你被吞噬进去吧。
text_loc: I only had enough strength to get you out. And I think Irys would rather you weren't dragged in all this alongside him.

text: ……对不起，我不该揣测你
text_loc: Sorry for assuming.

text: 我不应该这么恶意地揣测恩佐，毕竟他救了我。
text_loc: I shouldn't have assumed the worst about Enzir. He did just save me, after all.

name: 恩佐
text: 没想到发生了这么多意料外的事情。明明你不该深入到这么危险的地方。算了，这可能也是你的「价值」所在。
text_loc: Everything's gone sideways. You weren't supposed to end up somewhere this dangerous. Then again, maybe that's exactly what makes you worthy.

text: 我的价值？
text_loc: Worth something?

text: 什么叫不该出现？
text_loc: What do you mean?

name: 恩佐
text: 没事，这是我对你的……呃，一种认同？
text_loc: Nothing. Think of it as a compliment.

name: 恩佐
text: 总之，被掳走的眷属精灵……以及那只足以毁灭天地的黑化翼王……我觉得，目前的风灾，不是你我能掌控的程度。
text_loc: In any case, the Attendant Jini has been taken, and the King of Flight is now corrupted beyond recognition... what we're dealing with is well beyond anything you or I can control.

name: 恩佐
text: 但事到如今，我们恐怕没有回头路了。
text_loc: But there's no going back now. For either of us.

text: 你不想回去？
text_loc: You don't want to go back?

name: 恩佐
text: 是，我对翼王的力量，非常感兴趣……同时，令翼王陷入疯狂的噩梦能量也是很好的研究素材。接下来，如果有更好的样本——
text_loc: Yes, the King of Flight's power genuinely fascinates me. And the Nightmare energy driving it to madness even more so. If there's a better specimen to be found here...

text: 轰隆——轰隆——
text_loc: BOOM— BOOM—

name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>话音刚落，山巅传来了巨大的闷响。</>|||<center>山顶的风卷也变得更加狂暴……连空气也变得浑浊了起来。</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>The words have barely left his mouth when something massive shakes the peak above.</> |||<center>The storm at the summit surges. The air turns thick and sinister.</>|||

name: 恩佐
text: ……你看，情况更糟糕了。你确定要继续向前吗？告诉我，你的选择。
text_loc: Things just went from bad to worse. Are you still sure you're still up for this? Be honest with me.

text: 我想去，我也对力量感兴趣
text_loc: Power fascinates me too.

name: 恩佐
text: 是，力量……我很高兴，你和我想得一样。在这场灾变中，去接触不可思议的精灵们，获得它们的力量，才是最值得做的事情。
text_loc: Power. Good. I'm glad we're on the same page there. In a disaster like this, getting close to Jini of this magnitude and taking in what they're capable of is the only thing worth doing.

name: 恩佐
text: 我能明白你的感情。面对灾难，无法保护自己重要的朋友……因此，想要更多的力量……
text_loc: I understand that feeling. Facing something this overwhelming, yet being unable to protect the people who matter to you... it'd make anyone desire greater power.

text: 重要的朋友？
text_loc: The people who matter?

text: 力量？
text_loc: Power?

name: 恩佐
text: 我的自言自语罢了……但答应我，如果遇到刚才那样的危险，你要理智判断，可以吗？
text_loc: Forget I said anything. Just promise me that if you find yourself in real danger again, you'll make the rational call. Okay?

text: 恩佐……果然是个温柔的洛克吧？
text_loc: Turns out Enzir has a gentler side to him.

text: ……好，谢谢你
text_loc: Yeah. Thank you.

name: 恩佐
text: 风卷变得剧烈之后，我感觉这附近发生了微妙的变化。可能和上次的探查有所不同，前路会更加危险！
text_loc: Ever since the windstorm intensified, I've sensed a subtle shift in the area. It may be different from our last expedition—the road ahead could be far more dangerous.

name: 恩佐
text: 我们得做好准备，不仅是力量，还有心的准备……我想，距离那真相，或许不远了。
text_loc: We need to be ready not just in terms of physical strength, but mental fortitude as well. I have a feeling we may be closer to the truth than we think.

name: 恩佐
text: 等你准备好了，我们在山口处汇合吧。
text_loc: Once you're ready, meet me at the mountain pass.

text: 我想去，我要去救伊里斯
text_loc: I have to get Irys back.

name: 恩佐
text: 看来伊里斯对你而言，是很重要的伙伴，是我估算错误了。
text_loc: So Irys means that much to you. I misjudged that.

text: 是，伊里斯是我的伙伴
text_loc: Yes. Irys is my companion.

text: 就是一个不靠谱的家伙啦……
text_loc: Not the most reliable, but...

name: 恩佐
text: 呵，你很担心它。我多少能理解……面对灾难，无法保护自己重要之人的心情。
text_loc: Ha. You're worried about him. I understand that more than you might think—the feeling of watching a disaster unfold and being powerless to protect someone you care about.

name: 恩佐
text: 或许在这点上，我们有相似之处？无论如何，万一遇到危险，一定要做理性的判断。
text_loc: Maybe we're not so different in that way. Whatever you decide, if danger comes, make the rational call.

text: ……是这样吗
text_loc: Is that so?

text: 能救我一人……真的是恩佐的全力吗？感觉难以分辨。
text_loc: Was saving me really such a strain on you? Hard to be sure.

text: 风卷的真相就在眼前！
text_loc: The truth is right there.

name: 恩佐
text: ……呼，{name}，保持理智。就算刚才你过去了，也没法和那怪物抗衡！
text_loc: {name}. Use your head. Even if you'd gone in, you couldn't have fought that thing.

task_name: 准备完成后与恩佐汇合
name: 恩佐
text: 你来了？山顶白雪皑皑，看起来非常寒冷，要想向上攀登，我们得做好准备。
text_loc: You made it. The peak is buried in snow, so it's going to be brutal up there. Before we go any further, we need to be ready.

task_name: 准备完成后与恩佐汇合
text: 准备好了
text_loc: I'm ready.

task_name: 准备完成后与恩佐汇合
name: 恩佐
text: 很好，那我们现在就出发吧。之前曾与你一同在此冒险，但山上的气息似乎变得更加危险了，千万要小心。
text_loc: Good. Let's move. The mountain felt different the last time I scouted it out. Now that the storm has intensified, the path ahead will be more dangerous than ever. Stay sharp.

task_name: 与恩佐查看被控制的试炼精灵
name: 黑巫师
title: 祭祀终焉
text: 接下来，只要将你们三个，也投入那脏兮兮的「祭祀之地」……狩猎，就结束了……仪式，就开始了！
text_loc: Once the three of you are thrown into that filthy ritual ground... the hunt ends, and the ceremony begins.

task_name: 与恩佐查看被控制的试炼精灵
name: 恩佐
text: 是登天之路的试炼精灵！但与之前遇到的时候相比，魔力气息有所不同……看来，眼前这些……才是它们的本体？
text_loc: Trial Jini from the Ascending Path! But their energy signatures are different from before. These must be their true forms.

task_name: 与恩佐查看被控制的试炼精灵
name: 黑巫师
title: 祭祀终焉
text_loc: Huh? Who's there?

task_name: 与恩佐查看被控制的试炼精灵
name: 黑巫师
title: 祭祀终焉
text: 噢，是在祭台妄图阻挡仪式的洛克？唉，你们来的倒巧，可惜……已经来不及了！
text_loc: Oh. The Rocos who tried to stop the ritual at the altar. You picked an interesting time to show up. Unfortunately, you're too late.

task_name: 与恩佐查看被控制的试炼精灵
name: 黑巫师
title: 祭祀终焉
text: 你以为，在祭台那你们做到了什么？不……恰恰相反，一切正如噩梦大人的计算……
text_loc: You think what you did at the altar changed anything? Everything has gone exactly as He intended.

task_name: 与恩佐查看被控制的试炼精灵
name: 黑巫师
title: 祭祀终焉
text: 最后的仪式就要开始了，一切——都太晚了。你们无法阻止大人的回归！
text_loc: The final ritual is upon us. It is over. You cannot stop His return.

task_name: 与恩佐查看被控制的试炼精灵
name: 黑巫师
title: 祭祀终焉
text: 哈哈哈——
text_loc: Hahaha—

task_name: 与恩佐查看被控制的试炼精灵
name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>黑巫师狂笑着，祭坛产生了反应。</>|||<center>没等我们回过神，便带着试炼精灵们，隐去了身姿。</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>The Dark Wizard cackles as the altar ignites with energy.</> |||<center>Before you can react, they vanish with the Trial Jini.</>|||

text: 看起来可以使用星星魔法砸开它……
text_loc: Looks like there's a way to break through it with Starry Magic...

name: 恩佐
text: 翼王……竟变得如此虚弱……
text_loc: The King of Flight... reduced to this.

name: 恩佐
text: 真是有趣，难道强如精灵王，也抵御不住噩梦能量的侵袭，将生命消耗殆尽了？
text_loc: Fascinating. Not even a Jini King could resist the Nightmare energy's consumption, and was drained completely.

text: 那只怪物呢？
text_loc: What about the monster?

name: 恩佐
text: 嗯，说起来，这里倒是安静的可怕，似乎一切都已被那只怪物吞噬光了。
text_loc: It's eerily quiet here. That creature must have absorbed everything in its path.

name: 恩佐
text: 除了……！眼前这只虚弱不堪的翼王，呵呵，如果还能称之为翼王的话。
text_loc: Everything, that is, except... the King of Flight. If such a name can be used to describe this barely-standing husk.

text: 你的意思是？
text_loc: What do you mean?

name: 恩佐
text: 不出意外，黑巫师们的祭祀恐怕已近终章，那只怪物收归完所有力量，躲进了「另一个世界」里。
text_loc: If I'm right, the Dark Wizard ritual has reached its final phase. The monster has drawn in all the power it needs and retreated into another world.

name: 恩佐
text: 想必你的朋友伊里斯，也被带进了那个我们无法触碰的世界里……
text_loc: Your friend, Irys, was almost certainly pulled in along with it. A world neither of us can reach from out here.

text: 怎么才能进去？
text_loc: How do we get in?

text: 你怎么知道的
text_loc: How do you know that?

name: 恩佐
text: 哼，是否如我预料这般，稍后一试便知……
text_loc: We'll know soon enough whether I'm right.

name: 恩佐
text: 而门扉就在前方，或者说，就在眼前这只「翼王」的躯体里。
text_loc: The way in is straight ahead. Or more precisely, it's inside the King of Flight itself.

name: 恩佐
text: 你退后……！门，就要开启了……
text_loc: Step back. The door is about to open.

text: 我们——做到了？！我……亲手，击败了黑化的翼王？一切……结束了？！
text_loc: Did we... actually do it? I beat the corrupted King of Flight. With my own hands. Is it over?

text: 轻易的好像有点不真实……对了，伊里斯在哪里？！
text_loc: That felt almost too easy. Wait, where's Irys?

name: 恩佐
text: 感觉……有点诡异。
text_loc: Something isn't right.

text: ——这是哪里？！
text_loc: Where am I?

text: 黑漆漆的，还能听到一些尖锐的呜咽声……怎么回事。
text_loc: All around is darkness. Somewhere close, a sharp, hollow sound can be heard, like something crying out. What is this place?

text: 天空中挂着鲜红的眼睛，散发着诡异的气息。可，不知怎么的……
text_loc: A pair of crimson eyes hang in the sky above, radiating something deeply unsettling. And yet, somehow...

text: 对！眼睛背后似乎有熟悉的气息……和风眠圣所的星之结相似？！
text_loc: Behind those eyes lies something familiar. Something that reminds me of the Star Knot in Windrest Sanctuary.

text: 那是……伊里斯！找到他了！
text_loc: It's Irys. I found him

name: 伊里斯
title: <Blue>阴暗的一面</>
text: 打碎星之结的是你呀，伊里斯！无法拯救里奥的，也是你啊，伊里斯！
text_loc: You smashed the Star Knot, Irys. You couldn't save Lyel, and it was you. All you.

name: 伊里斯
title: <Blue>阴暗的一面</>
text: 你明明知道洛克们早已不堪信任，却还苦苦期待他来？呵，真好笑。
text_loc: You've known all along that Rocos can't be trusted, and now you're sitting here waiting for one to save you? Pathetic.

text: 那个紫黑色的影子……是伊里斯，却又不是伊里斯，更加悲哀和绝望，像是它灵魂中的暗影……也许星星魔法能驱散它。
text_loc: That dark shape... it looks like Irys, but it isn't. It's sadder. More broken. Like a dark concentration of everything Irys has buried inside. Maybe Starry Magic can drive it out.

text: ——没错，眼前出现的……的的确确是伊里斯！……但，是污染缠身的伊里斯。
text_loc: Yes, that's unmistakably Irys standing there, but he's been corrupted somehow.

name: 伊里斯
text: 咳咳……你反复让我回想起那刻……痛苦摧毁不了我……你也无法污染我！
text_loc: Cough... You keep pulling that moment back to the surface. Pain can't break me. And neither can you.

text: 伊里斯……醒醒！醒醒！
text_loc: Irys... wake up!

name: 伊里斯
text: 什么，你说{gender:他,她}……不会来救我？
text_loc: What? You're saying {gender:he,she} won't come for me?

name: 伊里斯
text: 咳咳——我根本不希望{gender:他,她}会来！本就是我……把{gender:他,她}卷入这场灾难中……
text_loc: Cough—I never wanted {gender:him,her} to come! I was the one who dragged {gender:him,her} into all of this.

text: 伊里斯喃喃呓语，在昏昏沉沉中，努力抵抗着噩梦的侵蚀。他似乎期待着我来，又不希望我来。
text_loc: Irys is muttering, half-conscious, fighting the Nightmare's pull. He seems to want me here, and yet wishes I weren't at the same time.

text: 大力把他摇醒
text_loc: Shake him awake.

text: 轻轻拍拍它
text_loc: Give him a gentle pat.

name: 伊里斯
text: 咳咳……没想到，魘力的污染还能让我产生……幻觉？
text_loc: Cough... I didn't think the corruption could cause hallucinations.

text: 狠狠掐他
text_loc: Pinch him hard.

text: 揪它的毛毛
text_loc: Pull his fur.

name: 伊里斯
text: {name}，你……怎么能来这么危险的地方！你……亮得有点晃眼了。
text_loc: {name}... How did you get here? You're... really something, you know that?

name: 伊里斯
text: 怎么轮到你耍帅了……真是的……我浑身都是污染吧……
text_loc: The student has become the master. Look at me... I've been corrupted, haven't I?

text: 伊里斯，振作起来
text_loc: Irys, pull yourself together.

text: 伊里斯，你是最强战力！
text_loc: Irys, you can do this!

text: 哪怕在黑暗中，周身缠满污染，伊里斯，你没有察觉到，你依旧散发着温暖的光芒。
text_loc: Irys. Even here in the dark, draped in this foul energy, you may not realize it, but you're still giving off warmth.

name: 伊里斯
text: 咳咳！这里魘力漫溢，会不断侵蚀意志……我的伤口也更加严重了……趁现在还没丧失理智……你听好了。
text_loc: Cough! The Malforce here is relentless; it'll break you down. My wounds are getting worse. Listen to me, while I still have my wits about me.

text: 你没事吧……
text_loc: Are you okay?

text: 好的，我在听！
text_loc: I'm here. Tell me.

name: 伊里斯
text: 这里，是翼王的「灵魂之河」，咳咳——咳——精灵王的空间，是居所，也是他意识的一部分。
text_loc: This place is the King of Flight's River of Souls—cough—a Jini King's domain. It's both a home and a piece of its consciousness.

name: 伊里斯
text: 在充盈愿力的过去，这里曾是翼系精灵灵魂的归处。现在却充满了魇力，变成了可怖的墓地。
text_loc: When Wishpower still flowed freely, this was where Wing-Type Jini souls found solace. Now it's saturated with Malforce. An eerie graveyard.

name: 伊里斯
text: 不仅是我被囚禁……风眠山几乎所有生灵，都被吸入了此处，是的，眷属它们也……咳咳！
text_loc: It's not just me trapped here. Nearly every living thing in the Windrest Mountain was pulled in. The Attendants too... cough.

text: 它为什么要吃你们？
text_loc: Why is it consuming everyone?

name: 伊里斯
text: 黑巫团扩散污染，目的是将我们全部腐蚀，献祭给噩梦……他们要把翼王当作容器，为了让噩梦重回世间！咳咳——
text_loc: The Dark Coven spread the corruption to corrode us all and offer us to the Nightmare. They want to use the King of Flight as a vessel, to bring the Nightmare back into the world.

name: 伊里斯
text: 虽然还勉强保持着理智，但污染很快便会侵蚀我的灵魂，时间已经不多了。
text_loc: I can still think straight for the time being. But the Malforce will eat through my soul before long. We're running out of time.

text: 伊里斯，别说丧气话！
text_loc: Don't talk like that, Irys.

text: 我们两个，一定有办法！
text_loc: We'll find a way, together.

name: 伊里斯
text: 不行的。你能来……我已经很高兴了。在你身上看到的愿力闪光，是真切存在的，我的相信，也是有意义的。
text_loc: It won't work. But you being here... that alone means the world to me. The spark of Wishpower I saw in you was real. It shows I was right to believe in you.

text: ……真好，没让你失望呢
text_loc: Glad I didn't let you down.

text: 你知道，我一定会来的
text_loc: You know I'd come for you.

name: 伊里斯
text: 可即便你是一个充满奇迹的孩子……现在的情况，也远远超过我们的能力。
text_loc: Even so, as miraculous as you are, what we're up against right now is completely beyond us.

name: 伊里斯
text: 这里的污染，迟早也会将你吞噬殆尽。所以，你得赶紧出去……只要逃出去，就还有希望！
text_loc: The corruption here will eventually consume you too. You need to get out while you can. As long as you escape, there's still hope.

name: 伊里斯
text: ——答应我，离开这里！不要回头！！
text_loc: Promise me. Get out of here, and don't look back.

text: 伊里斯和恩佐给我指示了完全相反的道路，一个让我进，一个让我退。
text_loc: Irys and Enzir are pointing me in opposite directions. One wants me to push forward. The other wants me to turn back.

name: 伊里斯
text: ……我好困呀，想……睡会了……
text_loc: I'm so tired. I just need... to rest a little...

text: ……伊里斯？
text_loc: ...Irys?

text: 伊里斯……我都来到了这里，怎么可能丢下你呢？！
text_loc: Irys, I came all the way here. I'm not leaving without you.

name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>你，我，麦克达克，法瑞莎莎……如果不是大家一起的话——</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>You, me, Elson Drake, Farisha... it wouldn't mean anything if it wasn't all of us together.</>|||

name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>不是大家一起，回到那个有翼王庇护的风眠山的话，就没有意义了，不是吗？</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>Together, we'll go back to the Windrest Mountain, with the King of Flight watching over us. That's what matters. Right?</>|||

name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>你们把勇气和信任，一次又一次地，传递给了我——</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>You've always had faith in me, and given me courage.</>|||

name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>我也想要，回应大家的愿望——</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>I want to live up to those expectations! I don't want to disappoint you!</>|||

text: 伊里斯，我不清楚你口中「愿力的闪光」究竟为何，能握住的实感……仅仅是和你相处的点滴而已。
text_loc: Irys, I can't explain what "a spark of Wishpower" even means. The only thing I can hold onto are the moments we've spent together.

name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>内心不断涌现出酸楚而温柔的涟漪之时，手中的星盘也泛起了温柔的光芒。</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>As something bittersweet and warm rises up inside, the Stardial in your hand stirs with a soft glow.</>|||

name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>不要成为幻影，也不要消失于这片无声无息的黑暗……</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>Don't become a ghost. Don't disappear into this silent darkness.</>|||

text: 因为，你还有需要拯救的伙伴！！有这么一只精灵，和你在等待我一样——等待着你！
text_loc: There's someone out there waiting for you, just like you waited for me. You still have a friend to save.

text: 不要轻易言弃，翼王还在等你！！
text_loc: Don't give up! Lyel is waiting!

name: 伊里斯
text_loc: The Jini of Light?

name: 伊里斯
text: 身体里的污染正在慢慢减弱……这就是……你和光之精灵共鸣，所迸发的愿力？……
text_loc: The corruption inside me is fading... is this the Wishpower that burst out when you and the Jini of Light resonated with one another?

name: 伊里斯
text: 你说得对，翼王和朋友们，还在等待着我们……哪怕是微弱的希望，也值得被坚持！
text_loc: You're right. The King of Flight and our friends are still out there waiting for us. Even if the hope is small, it's worth holding onto!

text: 是的呢
text_loc: Absolutely!

name: 伊里斯
text: ——{name}，请陪伴我前行！
text_loc: {name}, stay with me. Let's go forward together.

task_name: 继续前进，寻找其它伙伴
name: 麦克达克
title: <Blue>阴暗的一面</>
text: 只要遇到问题就知道逃避。你总是这样嘎，看起来悠然自得，其实就是个胆小鬼。
text_loc: Always running from your problems. That's just who you are, quack—you look so carefree on the outside, but underneath you're simply a coward.

task_name: 继续前进，寻找其它伙伴
name: 麦克达克
title: <Blue>阴暗的一面</>
text: 比起爸爸，你根本就配不上国王的位置。
text_loc: You could never be your father. You call yourself a king?

task_name: 继续前进，寻找其它伙伴
name: 麦克达克
text: 嘎嘎……（看起来被话语动摇了）
text_loc: Quack quack... *trembles*

task_name: 继续前进，寻找其它伙伴
text: 是麦克达克阴暗的一面……和刚才一样，用星星魔法解救它吧。
text_loc: That's Elson Drake's shadow self. Same as before, use Starry Magic to set him free.

text: 麦克达克……看起来完全被污染了……奄奄一息地……状态很差……
text_loc: Elson Drake seems completely consumed by the corruption. He's barely moving and breathing...

name: 麦克达克
text: …………（一动不动）
text_loc: ...... *lies motionless*

text: 麦克达克……
text_loc: Elson Drake...

text: 胖鸭……
text_loc: Duck...

text: 麦麦……
text_loc: Elson...

text: 曾经活蹦乱跳的国王陛下，居然变成了这副模样……
text_loc: The King who was always so full of life, reduced to such a state...

text: 我们还是来晚了吗？
text_loc: Are we too late?

name: 伊里斯
text: 来晚了？嗯……我看看。这家伙，就算是遇到饥荒也能靠脂肪挺过很久呢……现在这副样子，我猜，估计是在——「装死」？
text_loc: Too late? Hmm... let me take a look. Even if there were a famine, he could live off his reserves for a long time. My guess is that he's playing dead.

name: 伊里斯
text: 麦克达克虽然身躯……魁梧，但也是鸭子。装死，是鸭子的「紧张性麻痹」，一种防御机制……
text_loc: Elson Drake may be... generously proportioned, but he's still a duck. Playing dead, aka tonic immobility, is a duck's go-to defense mechanism.

text: 你果然是本地专家……
text_loc: You really are an expert.

text: 什么是紧张性麻痹？
text_loc: What's tonic immobility?

name: 伊里斯
text: 没事，对付这家伙我很拿手，看我的。
text_loc: Don't worry. I know exactly how to handle him. Watch.

name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>伊里斯狡黠地摆了摆手，娴熟地抓起一根麦克达克视若珍宝的鸭羽——狠狠地揪了出来！</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>Irys grins and reaches out with practiced ease, seizing one of Elson Drake's most prized feathers and yanking it clean out.</>|||

name: 麦克达克
text: 嘎嘎——疼，疼疼疼……！行，严刑拷打！哼，想破坏我的信念？邪门歪道……不能伤本王分毫！！
text_loc: Owowow! You won't break my will! Torture me all you like with these cheap tricks... you still won't land a scratch on this King!

name: 麦克达克
text: 但既然连伊里斯都没声儿了……眼下最好的策略还是……知道了，我投降！我投降！
text_loc: But since it appears even Irys has gone quiet, the smart play right now is... to give in. Fine, I surrender!

text: ……光速投降
text_loc: That was quick.

name: 麦克达克
text: 虽然但是，你可以直接吃我，但不能破坏我珍贵的鸭羽！那可是咱作为鸭王的尊严！哼，烹调的时候，得撒上特等的香料！
text_loc: You can eat me if you want, but nobody touches my feathers! These are the pride and joy of a Duck King! And if you're going to cook me, at least use decent seasoning!

text: 我们来了！
text_loc: We're here!

name: 伊里斯
text: 咳咳——
text_loc: Cough—

name: 麦克达克
text: 啊？伊里斯？——呃！我眼花了？这不是我好兄弟伊里斯吗？你活啦？！还有……{name}？
text_loc: Irys? Am I seeing things? My good pal Irys, you're alive? And {name}?

name: 麦克达克
text: 还以为要鸭入血盆大口，幸好你们来了，呜呜！刚刚……大鸭夫能屈能伸，不要在意这些细节！嘎嘎——疼——
text_loc: I thought I was about to get gobbled up whole! Thank feathers you're here! As for what you saw just now, a great duck knows when to bend. No need to dwell on such things. Quack—

name: 伊里斯
text: 不用解释……我知道，你作为眷属平时吊儿郎当，但关键的时候一定会用自己的方式，信守对翼王的承诺……
text_loc: You don' have to explain yourself. I know. You may act careless, but when it counts, you always come through for the King of Flight in your own way.

name: 伊里斯
text: ……我答应你，我们一定会救出翼王！然后，大家一起出去！
text_loc: I promise you—we're going to get the King of Flight out. And then we're all leaving together.

name: 伊里斯
text: 现在，当务之急是脱离险境……麦克达克，你也被这里弥漫的魇力污染了吧？是不是……动不了了？
text_loc: Right now, our priority is getting out of immediate danger. Elson Drake, you've been breathing in the Malforce here too, haven't you? Can you move?

name: 伊里斯
text: {name}，拜托你……也为麦克达克净化污染吧……
text_loc: {name}, would you cleanse the corruption from Elson Drake too?

name: 麦克达克
text: 嘎嘎嘎？凭这个小孩——？！净化我？不对，我以前，似乎也怀疑过{gender:他,她}。
text_loc: Quack? This kid is going to cleanse me? I guess I doubted {gender:him,her} before, didn't I?

text: 那是，你说话可不好听
text_loc: Yeah, you weren't so nice.

text: 嘿嘿，你该相信我的
text_loc: You should've believed in me.

name: 麦克达克
text: 没想到，如今还要承蒙你的照顾……挺不好意思的嘎。
text_loc: I didn't expect to be on the receiving end of your help. This is a little embarrassing, quack.

name: 麦克达克
text: 嘎嘎，本鸭收回之前的话！我就说嘛，你这家伙——不愧是我认可的朋友鸭！
text_loc: I take back everything I said! I knew it all along that you're exactly the kind of friend I approve of!

name: 麦克达克
text: 身体变得轻松了嘎！！！！谢谢你嘎！！！！
text_loc: I feel as light as a feather! Thank you, quack!

name: 伊里斯
text: 翼王……一直保护我们，独自消解污染，现在也轮到我们履行自己的使命了。
text_loc: The King of Flight has been protecting everyone, absorbing the corruption alone. Now it's our turn to hold up our end.

name: 伊里斯
text: 应该还有别的伙伴在等着我们。继续前进吧！
text_loc: There are other friends still waiting for us. Let's keep moving.

task_name: 继续前进，寻找其它伙伴
name: 法瑞莎莎
title: <Blue>阴暗的一面</>
text: 你的预言从来没有错误……承认吧，你从预言中看到的只有绝望。###大家都会堕入深渊，和你的预言一样！！
text_loc: Your predictions have never once been wrong, so admit it. What you saw in your vision was nothing but despair. ###Everyone is going to fall into the abyss, just like your prophecy foretold.

task_name: 继续前进，寻找其它伙伴
name: 法瑞莎莎
text: 不……我不要……
text_loc: No... I don't want that...

task_name: 继续前进，寻找其它伙伴
name: 法瑞莎莎
title: <Blue>阴暗的一面</>
text: 你觉得恐惧，对吗？来吧，拥抱黑暗的未来……
text_loc: You feel afraid, don't you. Come on. Embrace your future, bereft of light.

task_name: 继续前进，寻找其它伙伴
text: 法瑞莎莎也被自己的阴暗面蛊惑了……得赶快去帮助她！
text_loc: Farisha is being consumed by her own shadow too. We need to get to her.

text: 法瑞莎莎看起来浑身缠满了污染……十分虚弱。
text_loc: Farisha looks completely wrapped in corruption, and is barely holding on.

name: 法瑞莎莎
text: 是你来了吗……黑夜中弥漫的光……占卜中出现的面孔，我所预知的未来……是你。
text_loc: You came! The light drifting through the dark... the face from my visions. The future I foresaw... it's you.

text: 我们都来了，莎莎
text_loc: We're all here, Farisha.

name: 法瑞莎莎
text: 你来了，但未来还是——一片黑暗。
text_loc: You may be here, but the future is still nothing but darkness.

name: 伊里斯
text: 莎莎，你还真是很少说出……这样不吉利的结果呢……
text_loc: Farisha, you really shouldn't say things like that out loud.

text: 看来命运也不站在我们这边
text_loc: Fate is not on our side.

text: 即便获胜的可能性很低……
text_loc: Even with the odds against us...

name: 伊里斯
text: 翼王被……折磨成那样，我们都有责任去拯救它，而这孩子，就是关键。
text_loc: The King of Flight has been put through so much. We all share the responsibility of saving it, and this child is the key.

name: 伊里斯
text: 和占卜结果不同，我不会让{name}独自去面对所谓的「命运」……哪怕未来是晦暗的，我也会保护{gender:他,她}！
text_loc: Whatever the reading says, I'm not leaving {name} to face this "destiny" alone. Even if the future is dark, I'll protect {gender:him,her} no matter what.

name: 法瑞莎莎
text: 我倒觉得……咳咳，或许单凭这孩子没法成为关键，因为有你，伊里斯……
text_loc: If you ask me... cough ... maybe this child alone isn't the key. Because you're here too, Irys.

text: 伊里斯如此活跃，它那份想要拯救翼王的心愿，以及对洛克和精灵的信任，都完整地传递给了我。
text_loc: Irys: the way he moves, the force of his will in saving Lyel, his belief in Rocos and Jini. It has all has come through to me, completely intact.

name: 伊里斯
text: 我们会共同面对！{name}，拜托你……也为法瑞莎莎净化污染吧……
text_loc: We'll face it together. {name}, if you would, please cleanse the corruption from Farisha too.

text: 我……在你所描绘的未来里？
text_loc: Am I in the future you saw?

name: 法瑞莎莎
text: 你在那里，但未来还是——一片黑暗。
text_loc: You're there. But the future is still nothing but darkness.

name: 麦克达克
text: 嘎嘎？什么光之精灵暗之精灵，回头也是悬崖，咱们不如一起往前冲！鸭子准备好了！
text_loc: Quack? Light Jini, shadow Jini, doesn't matter. We're up against the wall, so might as well charge forward together. This duck is ready!

name: 伊里斯
text: 没错，继续前进吧。我有预感……这一切……马上就要结束了。
text_loc: That settles it. We keep moving. I have a feeling that all of this is soon coming to a close.

text: 在这种污秽的地方——却突然出现了光明……在黑暗中久了，感觉有些刺目——
text_loc: A sudden burst of light appears amongst the corrupted space. After so long in the dark, it almost hurts to look at.

text: 这个模糊的影子……看不清面影，但那衣着的轮廓……似乎……
text_loc: The silhouette is blurry, and I can't make out the face. But the outline of those clothes...

text: 你能也带我逃离……这个空间吗？我被困在这里很久了。
text_loc: Can you take me with you? I've been trapped here for a very long time.

text: 你是谁？
text_loc: Who are you?

text: 你手中拿着我的星盘，背包里是我的旧日装束，哈哈，你还不知道我是谁吗？
text_loc: Ha. That's my Stardial you're holding, and my old things are in your pack. You still don't know who I am?

text: 你是……亚瑟？！
text_loc: Are you... Arthiel?

name: 亚瑟
text: 是的……想不到居然在这种地方，和你相遇了……
text_loc: Yes. Of all the places we'd meet, I certainly didn't expect it would be somewhere like this.

text: 你不是已经……
text_loc: But you're already...

text: 你为何能在这里存在？
text_loc: How are you still here?

name: 亚瑟
text: 我的肉体不在了，灵魂被困于此处……已数百年了。
text_loc: My body is long gone, but my soul has been trapped here for centuries.

name: 亚瑟
text: 曾经，我把噩梦封印于此，但作为代价，我也没能逃出去。
text_loc: I sealed the Nightmare in this place once. But once I'd done that, I couldn't escape.

text: 我该怎么救你？
text_loc: How do I save you?

name: 亚瑟
text: 我想，现今能连接你和我的唯一物件就是……星盘。星盘的光，可以超越时间和概念。
text_loc: The only thing that can connect us now is the Stardial. Its light can reach across time, along with anything else that stands between us.

name: 亚瑟
text: ……把它交给我，我是它的主人，能够帮你唤起星盘真正的力量。
text_loc: Hand it to me. I'm its true owner; I can help you draw out its real power.

text: 他似乎是要我走上前去，同他一起分享这个星盘，似乎这样做，能让星盘放射出更强大的光芒。
text_loc: He seems to want me to step forward and share the Stardial with him, so that it will shine even brighter.

text: 上前给他
text_loc: Step forward and give it to him.

text: ……虽说有点突然，但这确实是他曾经的东西……物归原主也无可厚非。
text_loc: It's a little sudden, but it was his once. Returning it to its owner doesn't seem wrong.

text: 还没等我有什么动作，星盘就自行从背包中飞了出来！
text_loc: Before I even move, the Stardial launches itself out of the pack on its own.

text: 不给他
text_loc: Don't give it to him.

text: 莫名出现在此处，并且直指我的星盘，他真的是……「亚瑟」？
text_loc: First he appears out of nowhere, then he goes straight for my Stardial... is this really Arthiel?

text: 太险了，之前遇见的那只怪物，居然伪装成了亚瑟的模样——！
text_loc: That was close. Whatever was just standing there, it wasn't Arthiel. It was the creature we fought, wearing his face.

text: 你到底是谁？！
text_loc: Who are you, really?

name: 噩梦
text: 哦？你们不是一直在谈论我吗？有人叫我邪物，有人叫我魇力之主，但我允许你直呼我的大名——噩梦……
text_loc: You've all been talking about me this whole time. Some decry me an abomination. Some call me the Lord of Malforce. But I'll let you call me by my true name, Nightmare.

name: 噩梦
text: 很惊讶？呵呵，一些登场前的小插曲罢了，还希望你……不要嫌弃，我拙劣的表演……
text_loc: Surprised? Ha. This is merely a preamble before the main event. I do hope you'll forgive my rather unrefined performance.

text: 翼王是你害成这样的？
text_loc: You corroded the King of Flight?

text: 是你散播了魇力？
text_loc: You're the source of Malforce?

name: 噩梦
text: 我的力量本就诞生于契约的裂缝里，诞生于精灵伤痕累累的心，诞生于它们的憎恨与愤怒……
text_loc: My power was given life amongst the cracks of broken pacts. In the wounded hearts of Jini. Within their hatred and their rage.

name: 噩梦
text: 嗯~只能说品味不同，对我来说，这些才是可口的食粮呢……
text_loc: Everyone's taste differ, but for me, that's what I consider a fine meal.

name: 噩梦
text: 翼王那么痛苦，皆因它的体内积攒了大量魇力，无法被净化。我又不是始作俑者，又怎么能怪我呢？
text_loc: The King of Flight's suffering came from the Malforce building up inside it with nowhere to go. I had nothing to do with that, so why blame me?

text: ……可恶！
text_loc: You monster!

name: 噩梦
text: 哦？顺带一提，你以为它赖以依靠的星之结……只会吸收正面的愿力？不不不，「魇力」自然也包含在内。
text_loc: Oh, and by the way, did you think the Star Knot only absorbed positive Wishpower? Think again. Malforce flows right in too.

name: 噩梦
text: 你应该听到了这空间里灵魂的哀嚎吧？那是精灵的哭声！它们恨那些背弃契约的洛克！
text_loc: You must have heard the souls wailing in this space. Those are the howls of Jini whom cry out against every Roco who ever forsook their pact.

text: 那些拒绝我的精灵……
text_loc: Those Jini who were refused...

text: 那些愤怒扭曲的精灵……
text_loc: Those Jini warped by anger...

name: 噩梦
text: 那些负面的魇力——也在星之结里生根、发芽！翼王无条件选择相信洛克和精灵的契约牢不可破，只能说太天真啦。
text_loc: All that negative Malforce took root in the Star Knot and festered. The King of Flight chose to believe, unconditionally, that the bond between Roco and Jini could never break. A naïve belief, to say the least.

text: 所以……噩梦是推动者，却不是源头，那些侵蚀精灵灵魂的魇力，其实起源于我们的内心……
text_loc: So the Nightmare is the accelerant, not the original source. The Malforce eating away at Jini souls... it started from inside us.

name: 噩梦
text: 无所谓了！倒是你……凭什么手中拿着亚瑟的装束，还伴随着他的光之精灵……？！
text_loc: Never mind all that. What I want to know is: why are you carrying Arthiel's things? And why does his Jini of Light follow you?

text: 啊？我……
text_loc: What? I...

name: 噩梦
text: 也罢，亚瑟将我在此监禁数百年，我的这份愤怒……不妨在你身上清算！！
text_loc: No matter. Arthiel is the one who imprisoned me here for centuries. That particular grievance—I think I'll settle it with you.

name: 噩梦
text: 就凭你们是无法击败我的！
text_loc: You can't defeat me! Not like this!

text: 噩梦不是已经消失了吗？怎么回事？和大家聊聊吧。
text_loc: The Nightmare is gone, so why is it still dark in here? Something's wrong. Talk with everyone.

name: 麦克达克
text: 嘎嘎——噩梦……消失了！可这条臭水沟，怎么还是这么黑呀！你们说，翼王大人……究竟怎么了？
text_loc: Quack, the Nightmare vanished! But this stinky hole is still pitch black. What's going on with the King of Flight?

name: 法瑞莎莎
text: 星之结碎裂了，那是净化翼王的唯一途径，我们……该怎么办？
text_loc: The Star Knot is shattered. It was the only way to cleanse the King of Flight. What are we supposed to do now?

name: 伊里斯
text: 哎，你们就别乱猜了……或许，也是时候向你们说出前因后果了。
text_loc: Alright, stop guessing. I think it's time I told you everything.

name: 麦克达克
text: ——嘎嘎？你难道知道些什么？！
text_loc: Wait, quack? You knew something this whole time?

name: 法瑞莎莎
text: ……！伊里斯……你？
text_loc: Irys... you...

name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>伊里斯深吸一口气，闭上了眼睛，像是下定了什么决定似的。</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>Irys takes a slow breath and closes his eyes, like someone who has come to a decision after long deliberation.</>|||

name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>在大家疑惑的目光中，伊里斯讲述了星之结黑化、碎裂的前因后果。</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>While everyone watches in silence, Irys explains the corruption of the Star Knot, and how it came to be destroyed.</>|||

name: 伊里斯
text: 星之结彻底黑化，翼王也随之崩溃……我作为朋友，只想尽快帮它从痛苦中解脱……
text_loc: The Star Knot was completely corrupted, and the King of Flight collapsed along with it. As a friend, all I wanted was to end its suffering as quickly as I could.

name: 法瑞莎莎
text: 伊里斯……你没有做错！我能……理解你的痛苦……毕竟，你们是最好的朋友……
text_loc: Irys... you didn't do anything wrong. I understand the pain you were carrying. You two were close friends, after all.

name: 伊里斯
text: 我打碎了星之结，也无济于事……！毕竟，能真正净化翼王的，还是「愿力」——
text_loc: I destroyed the Star Knot, but it still wasn't enough. That's because the only thing that can actually cleanse Lyel is Wishpower.

text: 愿力，才是翼王的希望！
text_loc: Wishpower is Lyel's only hope.

name: 伊里斯
text: 嗯，现如今信仰者散失，所谓心意相通、永不离弃，才能诞生出的「真正契约」……也越来越少。
text_loc: Now the faithful have scattered. The true pact—hearts in harmony, never to part—those are almost impossible to find anymore.

name: 伊里斯
text: 但不知为何，我能明白……翼王宁愿承受污染也不放弃星之结，是在坚持什么……它，从未放弃对愿力再生的希望！
text_loc: But somehow I always understood why Lyel refused to let go of the Star Knot even through all that suffering. It never gave up hope that Wishpower could return.

name: 伊里斯
text: 最终，我也找到了那个闪光的孩子，是你……{name}！
text_loc: And in the end, I found the one who carries that spark; you, {name}.

text: 我？
text_loc: Me?

name: 伊里斯
text: 说实话，刚开始我还有所怀疑……迪莫这家伙怎么追随着你？你看起来小小一只，嘴上还不饶人。
text_loc: Honestly, at first I wasn't sure why Dimo was following someone like you. You seemed so insignificant, and quite fond of talking back.

text: 嘿嘿
text_loc: Heh heh.

text: 喂喂，也没有吧！
text_loc: Hey, I'm not that bad!

name: 伊里斯
text: 但在与你同行的这些日子里，我逐渐感受到——和你这家伙，建立了某种特殊的默契！
text_loc: But while traveling with you these past few days, something shifted. I realized that there's a kind of understanding between you two which I've personally never felt before.

name: 伊里斯
text: 这就是他们所说的「契约」吗？我从未与洛克完成过这件事，是你，让我感受到了这种奇妙的力量。
text_loc: Is this what they call a pact? I've never formed one with a Roco. But you're the one who showed me what that feeling actually is.

text: 你是我的朋友，伊里斯！
text_loc: You're my friend, Irys.

name: 伊里斯
text: ……哈哈！我似乎……也知道该怎么做了，不要放弃希望，还有——最后的办法！
text_loc: Ha! I think I finally know what to do. Don't give up hope. There's still a way.

name: 伊里斯
text: 伙伴们，我决定使用一次……属于独角兽的「重生」魔法……
text_loc: Everyone, I've made my decision. I'm going to use the magic that belongs to Irikeras alone—Rebirth.

text: 重生？
text_loc: Rebirth?

name: 麦克达克
text: 嘎嘎嘎嘎嘎？伊里斯你……原来一直考察那孩子，是想用那个魔法？就是说——嘎？！！
text_loc: Quack quack? Irys, are you saying you were testing the kid this whole time because you wanted to use that magic? Quack?

name: 法瑞莎莎
text: 伊里斯！那个魔法不是……你难道要？不行！
text_loc: Irys, you can't be serious!
Rebirth magic?

text: 什么是……属于独角兽的「重生」魔法——？看着麦克达克和法瑞莎莎的反应……这个魔法，似乎有点不对劲……
text_loc: Judging by how Elson Drake and Farisha are reacting... something isn't quite right with this Rebirth magic.

name: 伊里斯
text: {name}，在噩梦制造的幻影中徘徊时，我一直在想，如果能早点和你缔结契约，该多好~
text_loc: {name}, while I was wandering through the Nightmare's illusions, I kept thinking about how much better it would have been if we'd formed a pact sooner.

name: 伊里斯
text: 但现在似乎也不晚——接下来的事情，需要我们的默契来共同完成！
text_loc: But maybe it's not too late. With what's coming next, we'll have to work together in order to pull it off.

text: 我该怎么做？
text_loc: What do I need to do?

name: 伊里斯
text: 只需要记住我的名字就好，放心吧！
text_loc: All you need to do is remember my name. Trust me.

name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>{name}，如果生命迟早会燃烧殆尽。</>|||<center>成为沙砾，成为尘埃。</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>{name}, if life must one day burn itself out.</> |||<center>Into dust. Into nothing.</>|||

name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>那我也会奢望，你和我的故事……在这个尽头里重生。</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>Then even so, I hope that, in the end, our story will be reborn.</>|||

name: 黑屏
text: |||<center>循着记忆的线索，你一定能抵达那里。</>|||
text_loc: |||<center>Follow the thread of memory, and you will find your way back.</>|||

text: 此时此刻的风眠山顶……
text_loc: At the summit of Windrest Mountain, right now...

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 佩西阿姨，这孩子真的还能醒吗——这都三四天了，还直直地仰着，该不会成植物洛了吧……
text_loc: Penny, is this kid ever going to wake up? {gender:He,She};'s been stiff as a board for four days straight now. That ain't normal! I'd hate to see someone so young become a vegetable.

name: 佩西
text: 没事的，噜噜先生，萌萌的治疗，你不用担心。咦——你怎么在薅自己珍贵的护心毛？
text_loc: They'll be fine, Hoolu. You have Momo's treatment to thank for that. Wait, why are you plucking your own chest fluff?

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 因为在下紧张咕！担心咕！害怕咕！不自觉地，就开始揪自己的毛——一根又一根……
text_loc: I'm nervous, hoo! Worried, hoo! Scared, hoo! I can't help it... once I start pulling, I can't stop...

text: 哈哈……咳咳咳！
text_loc: Haha... cough cough!

text: 别揪了，我这不活了吗！
text_loc: Stop! I'm right here, I'm fine!

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 嗯——？！{name}阁下！你醒来了咕！呜呜，你醒来了咕！！呜呜呜——
text_loc: Hm? {name}! You're awake, hoo! Oh, by the feathers!

text: 我一点事都没有！
text_loc: I'm right as rain!

name: 噜噜
title: 金牌向导
text: 怎么会没事呢？——本来孩子的脑子就不是很灵光，这下更是雪上加霜！呜呜，真没有摔坏吧！在下摸摸……
